Suami berhujah isteri tidak menyumbang secara kewangan kepada perniagaan dan patut menerima bahagian nominal sahaja. Bukti menunjukkan isteri menguruskan rumah tangga selama 15 tahun sementara suami membina perniagaannya.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Dispute over harta sepencarian following divorce. The wife claimed a 50% share of the matrimonial home and the husband's business assets. The husband argued the wife had not contributed financially to the business and should receive only a nominal share. Evidence showed the wife managed the household for 15 years while the husband built his business.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Ahmad bin Ibrahim v Ramlah binti Yusof
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Bahagian harta sepencarian yang sesuai untuk isteri suri rumah. Sama ada sumbangan tidak langsung (pengurusan rumah tangga, penjagaan anak) melayakkan pasangan kepada bahagian signifikan aset perniagaan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Appropriate share of harta sepencarian for a homemaker wife. Whether indirect contributions (household management, childcare) entitle a spouse to a significant share of business assets.
sya_case_laws.legislation: S.58 Act 303
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes Jurnal Hukum utama yang menetapkan sumbangan tidak langsung sebagai asas untuk tuntutan harta sepencarian terhadap aset perniagaan.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key Jurnal Hukum case establishing indirect contributions as a basis for harta sepencarian claims against business assets.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan tuntutan harta sepencarian yang melibatkan aset perniagaan di mana satu pasangan adalah suri rumah, sentiasa tumpukan pada memperincikan sumbangan tidak langsung, seperti pengurusan rumah tangga dan penjagaan anak, dan bagaimana ini membolehkan kejayaan kewangan pasangan yang lain. Sediakan bukti yang kukuh yang menunjukkan tempoh dan sifat sumbangan ini. Berhati-hati bahawa walaupun sumbangan tidak langsung diiktiraf, bahagian yang diberikan mungkin masih kurang daripada 50%, jadi uruskan jangkaan pelanggan dengan sewajarnya. Petua strategik adalah untuk menekankan faktor 'membolehkan' untuk mengaitkan sumbangan tidak langsung secara langsung dengan pertumbuhan aset perniagaan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling harta sepencarian claims involving business assets where one spouse was a homemaker, always focus on detailing the indirect contributions, such as household management and childcare, and how these enabled the other spouse's financial success. Prepare robust evidence demonstrating the duration and nature of these contributions. Be aware that while indirect contributions are recognized, the share awarded may still be less than 50%, so manage client expectations accordingly. A strategic tip is to emphasize the 'enabling' factor to link indirect contributions directly to the growth of business assets.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Penyingkiran statutori bidang kuasa hendaklah ditafsirkan secara ketat; hak asasi dan perlindungan perlembagaan tidak mudah digantikan.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Statutory ouster of jurisdiction is to be strictly construed; fundamental rights and constitutional protections are not lightly displaced.
sya_case_laws.citation: [2005] 6 MLJ 289 (Court of Appeal) — cited for jurisdictional principles
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Walaupun utamanya kes tanah adat, alasan Mahkamah Rayuan mengenai had penyingkiran bidang kuasa statutori telah dirujuk dalam cabaran jenayah Syariah berikutnya berkaitan sempadan enakmen jenayah Negeri.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: While primarily a native customary land case, the Court of Appeal's reasoning on the limits of statutory jurisdictional ouster has been cited in subsequent Shariah criminal challenges concerning the boundaries of State criminal enactments.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Kerajaan Negeri Selangor v Sagong bin Tasi (related Shariah jurisdictional principles applied)
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Prinsip: apabila statut bertujuan menyingkirkan semakan kehakiman atau bidang kuasa alternatif, mahkamah akan mentafsirkan penyingkiran secara sempit.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Principle: when a statute purports to oust judicial review or alternative jurisdiction, the courts will construe the ouster narrowly.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 8; State enactments
sya_case_laws.case_name_bm: Kerajaan Negeri Selangor lwn Sagong bin Tasi (prinsip bidang kuasa Syariah berkaitan diterapkan)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Sering digunakan oleh peguam pembela dalam kes jenayah Syariah yang mencabar keluasan enakmen Negeri. Pengimbang berguna kepada bacaan bidang kuasa yang luas.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Frequently invoked by defence counsel in Shariah criminal cases challenging the breadth of State enactments. A useful counterweight to broad jurisdictional readings.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mencabar bidang kuasa jenayah Syariah, mula-mula sahkan sama ada klausa penyingkiran dalam enakmen Negeri adalah eksplisit; jika ya, gunakan prinsip tafsiran ketat dari Sagong. Secara strategik, hujahkan bahawa hak asasi dan perlindungan perlembagaan menuntut tafsiran sempit terhadap sebarang penyingkiran yang didakwa. Berhati-hati bahawa dakwaan bidang kuasa yang luas oleh pihak pendakwaan sering mengundang hujah balas berdasarkan duluan ini.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When challenging Shariah criminal jurisdiction, first verify if the State enactment's ouster clause is explicit; if so, apply the strict construction principle from Sagong. Strategically, argue that fundamental rights and constitutional protections demand a narrow reading of any purported ouster. Be mindful that broad jurisdictional claims by the prosecution often invite a counter-argument based on this precedent.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah meneliti struktur BBA dan pematuhannya terhadap prinsip kewangan Islam. Menangani isu ibra' (rebat) dan kaedah pengiraan yang betul.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Court examined the BBA structure and its compliance with Islamic finance principles. Addressed issues of ibra' (rebate) and the proper calculation method.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian perbankan Islam melibatkan kontrak Bay' Bithaman Ajil (BBA). Pelanggan mencabar pengiraan harga jualan bank dan kesahihan struktur BBA.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Islamic banking dispute involving a Bay' Bithaman Ajil (BBA) contract. The customer challenged the bank's calculation of the selling price and the validity of the BBA structure.
sya_case_laws.case_name: TM Feroze Khan v Meera Hussain
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada kontrak BBA mematuhi prinsip Syariah. Sama ada pengiraan harga jualan adalah betul.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the BBA contract complied with Shariah principles. Whether the selling price calculation was proper.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Financial Services Act 2013 (Act 759)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes penting dalam jurisprudens perbankan Islam Malaysia. Mempengaruhi penyelesaian pertikaian kewangan Islam seterusnya.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Significant case in Malaysian Islamic banking jurisprudence. Influenced subsequent Islamic finance dispute resolution.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan pertikaian perbankan Islam yang melibatkan kontrak BBA, sentiasa sahkan terma-terma tepat perjanjian kemudahan terhadap prinsip-prinsip Syariah, terutamanya berkaitan pengiraan harga jualan dan sebarang klausa ibra' (rebat). Teliti metodologi bank untuk mengira harga jualan dari awal, kerana ini adalah titik pertikaian yang kerap. Kesilapan umum adalah terlepas pandang bagaimana kadar keuntungan awal mungkin terkumpul, mewujudkan percanggahan dalam harga jualan akhir; pastikan anak guam anda memahami sepenuhnya implikasi struktur BBA yang dipilih. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada teras pertikaian terletak pada pematuhan Syariah kontrak atau hanya pelaksanaannya.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling Islamic banking disputes involving BBA contracts, always verify the precise terms of the facility agreement against Shariah principles, especially regarding the selling price calculation and any ibra' (rebate) clauses. Scrutinize the bank's methodology for calculating the selling price from the outset, as this is a frequent point of contention. A common pitfall is overlooking how initial profit rates might compound, creating discrepancies in the final selling price; ensure your client fully understands the implications of the chosen BBA structure. Strategically, consider whether the dispute's core lies in the contract's Shariah compliance or merely its execution.

sya_case_laws.tags: hibah, wasiat, marad al-maut, faraid, estate planning, Jurnal Hukum
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah memutuskan bahawa hibah yang dibuat semasa marad al-maut (sakit maut) dianggap sebagai wasiat dan oleh itu tertakluk kepada had satu pertiga dan persetujuan waris lain. Untuk hibah yang sah, mestilah ada: (1) tawaran yang jelas (ijab), (2) penerimaan (qabul), (3) pengambilan milikan (qabd), dan ini mesti berlaku semasa pemberi dalam keadaan sihat.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court held that a hibah made during marad al-maut (death illness) is treated as a wasiat and therefore subject to the one-third limit and consent of other heirs. For a valid hibah, there must be: (1) clear offer (ijab), (2) acceptance (qabul), (3) taking of possession (qabd), and these must occur while the donor is in good health.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian hibah yang penting di mana waris mencabar kesahihan hibah yang dibuat oleh si mati semasa hayatnya. Hartanah telah diisytiharkan sebagai hibah kepada seorang anak, tetapi pengisytiharan dibuat semasa pemberi sedang sakit tenat. Waris lain mencabar hibah tersebut, berhujah ia sebenarnya wasiat terselindung yang bertujuan untuk mengelak peraturan pengagihan faraid.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A landmark hibah (gift inter vivos) dispute where heirs challenged the validity of a hibah made by the deceased during his lifetime. The property had been declared as hibah to one child, but the declaration was made while the donor was terminally ill. Other heirs challenged the hibah, arguing it was actually a disguised wasiat (will) intended to circumvent faraid distribution rules.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Wan Azmi bin Wan Hamzah v Yam Tunku Puan Zanariah
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Kesahihan hibah yang dibuat semasa sakit tenat (marad al-maut). Sama ada hibah sedemikian dianggap sebagai wasiat. Syarat hibah yang sah termasuk qabd (pengambilan milikan).
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Validity of hibah made during terminal illness (marad al-maut). Whether such hibah is treated as wasiat. Requirements for valid hibah including qabd (taking possession).
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Islamic Law Administration enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti Jurnal Hukum yang kritikal mengenai perbezaan antara hibah dan wasiat, khususnya mengenai pemberian yang dibuat semasa sakit tenat. Bacaan penting untuk pengamal perancangan harta pusaka Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Critical Jurnal Hukum authority on the distinction between hibah and wasiat, particularly regarding gifts made during terminal illness. Essential reading for Islamic estate planning practitioners.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan kes hibah, sentiasa sahkan status kesihatan pemberi hibah pada masa hibah dibuat untuk memastikan sama ada ia berada dalam kategori marad al-maut, yang akan mengklasifikasikannya semula sebagai wasiat. Penting sekali, semak jika terdapat qabd (pengambilan milik) yang sebenar oleh penerima; ketiadaannya, terutamanya jika digabungkan dengan penyakit kritikal, akan melemahkan kesahihan hibah secara signifikan dan menguatkan dakwaan ia adalah wasiat yang menyamar. Nasihatkan pelanggan bahawa hibah semasa sakit tenat umumnya dihadkan kepada satu pertiga daripada harta tanpa persetujuan waris lain, meniru peraturan wasiat.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with hibah cases, always verify the donor's health status at the time of the hibah to ascertain if it falls under marad al-maut, which reclassifies it as a wasiat. Crucially, check for actual qabd (taking possession) by the donee; its absence, especially when combined with terminal illness, significantly weakens the hibah's validity and strengthens claims of it being a disguised wasiat. Advise clients that hibah during terminal illness is generally capped at one-third of the estate without other heirs' consent, mirroring wasiat rules.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Kontrak BBA yang bukan jualan dan jualan semula sebenar tidak boleh dikuatkuasakan. Bank hanya berhak memungut jumlah pokok (jumlah kemudahan asal) tanpa keuntungan. Mencetuskan tindak balas industri yang besar.
sya_case_laws.held_en: BBA contracts that did not constitute genuine sale and resale were unenforceable. Banks were entitled only to recover the principal sum (the original facility amount) without profit. Provoked considerable industry response.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Beberapa kemudahan BBA telah ingkar. Mahkamah diminta mempertimbangkan sama ada kontrak BBA mematuhi keperluan Syariah bagi dua transaksi jualan berbeza (pembelian oleh bank kemudian jualan semula kepada pelanggan) atau sama ada ia pada dasarnya pinjaman berfaedah.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Multiple BBA facilities were in default. The court was asked to consider whether the BBA contracts properly observed the Shariah requirement of two distinct sale transactions (purchase by bank then resale to customer) or whether they were in substance interest-bearing loans.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Arab-Malaysian Finance Berhad v Taman Ihsan Jaya Sdn Bhd & Ors
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada kemudahan BBA yang tidak melibatkan jualan dan jualan semula sebenar aset adalah patuh Syariah dan boleh dikuatkuasakan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether BBA facilities that did not involve genuine sale and resale of an asset were Shariah-compliant and enforceable.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Central Bank of Malaysia Act 2009, ss.56-57; Islamic Banking Act 1983
sya_case_laws.case_name_bm: Arab-Malaysian Finance Berhad lwn Taman Ihsan Jaya Sdn Bhd & Lain-Lain
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Mencetuskan penggubalan seksyen 56-57 Akta Bank Negara Malaysia 2009, mewajibkan mahkamah sivil merujuk persoalan Syariah dalam pertikaian kewangan Islam kepada Majlis Penasihat Syariah BNM yang keputusannya mengikat mahkamah.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Triggered the enactment of section 56-57 of the Central Bank of Malaysia Act 2009, requiring civil courts to refer Shariah questions in Islamic finance disputes to the BNM Shariah Advisory Council whose ruling binds the court.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengurus kes mungkir BBA sebelum 2009, sentiasa semak sama ada kemudahan tersebut melibatkan jualan/penjualan semula aset yang tulen; jika tidak, tuntutan bank mungkin terhad kepada jumlah pokok. Untuk kes selepas 2009, pastikan sebarang persoalan pematuhan Syariah dirujuk secara rasmi kepada Majlis Penasihat Syariah BNM. Nasihatkan pelanggan bahawa mahkamah kini terikat dengan keputusan MPS mengenai perkara tersebut, yang mempengaruhi strategi litigasi. Kesilapan strategik adalah mengandaikan pendekatan 'pra-2009' untuk kes 'pasca-2009', mengabaikan keputusan MPS yang mengikat.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling BBA default cases predating 2009, always check if the facility involved a genuine asset sale/resale; otherwise, the bank's claim might be limited to the principal. For cases post-2009, ensure any Shariah compliance questions are formally referred to the BNM Shariah Advisory Council. Advise clients that courts are now bound by the SAC's rulings on such matters, impacting litigation strategy. A strategic pitfall is assuming the 'pre-2009' approach for 'post-2009' cases, ignoring the binding SAC rulings.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah memutuskan bahawa iwadh untuk khuluk tidak perlu terhad kepada pemulangan mahar. Jumlah tertakluk kepada persetujuan antara pihak-pihak, dan mahkamah mempunyai budi bicara untuk menentukan jumlah yang adil jika pihak-pihak tidak dapat bersetuju.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Court held that the iwadh for khuluk need not be limited to the return of mahr. The amount is subject to agreement between the parties, and the court has discretion to determine a fair amount if the parties cannot agree.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang isteri berdarah diraja memohon khuluk daripada suaminya. Kes ini melibatkan pihak berprofil tinggi dan pertimbangan kewangan yang signifikan mengenai jumlah pampasan. Mahkamah perlu menentukan kadar iwadh (pampasan) yang sesuai yang perlu dibayar oleh isteri sebagai ganti pembebasannya daripada perkahwinan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A royal wife sought khuluk from her husband. The case involved high-profile parties and significant financial considerations regarding the compensation amount. The court had to determine the appropriate quantum of iwadh (compensation) payable by the wife in exchange for her release from the marriage.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Tengku Puteri Zainah v Dato' Seri DiRaja Syed Nadzir
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Kadar iwadh yang sesuai untuk khuluk. Sama ada iwadh mesti sama dengan mahar atau boleh menjadi jumlah yang berbeza.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Appropriate quantum of iwadh for khuluk. Whether iwadh must equal the mahr or can be a different amount.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Islamic Family Law Enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti penting mengenai fleksibiliti penentuan iwadh dalam prosiding khuluk. Menjelaskan bahawa pampasan boleh dirundingkan.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important authority on the flexibility of iwadh determination in khuluk proceedings. Clarified that compensation is negotiable.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati tentang khuluk, sentiasa pastikan jumlah iwadh pilihan anak guam dan sama ada pihak yang satu lagi bersetuju. Jika tidak, sediakan hujah untuk kuantum yang adil dengan mengambil kira semua keadaan, bukan hanya mas kahwin. Kes ini membenarkan fleksibiliti melangkaui mas kahwin, menawarkan peluang strategik untuk rundingan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When advising on khuluk, always ascertain the client's preferred iwadh amount and whether the other party is agreeable. If not, prepare arguments for a fair quantum considering all circumstances, not just the mahr. This case allows for flexibility beyond just the mahr, offering a strategic opening for negotiation.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah memutuskan bahawa nafkah mestilah tetap dan mencukupi untuk memenuhi keperluan munasabah isteri mengikut kemampuan suami. Bayaran tidak tetap kepada pihak ketiga tidak merupakan nafkah yang mencukupi. Fasakh diluluskan.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court held that maintenance must be regular and sufficient to meet the wife's reasonable needs according to the husband's means. Irregular payments to third parties do not constitute adequate nafkah. Fasakh was granted.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri memohon fasakh atas alasan suami gagal menyediakan nafkah selama lebih setahun dan telah berlaku kasar. Suami membantah, mendakwa beliau telah menyediakan nafkah melalui bayaran tidak tetap kepada keluarga isteri. Mahkamah Syariah perlu menentukan apa yang merupakan nafkah yang mencukupi dan sama ada bayaran tidak tetap layak.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The wife applied for fasakh on the grounds that the husband had failed to provide maintenance for over a year and had been abusive. The husband contested, claiming he had provided maintenance through irregular payments to the wife's family. The Shariah court had to determine what constitutes adequate maintenance and whether irregular payments qualify.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Siti Hajar binti Mohd v Mohd Fauzi bin Ahmad
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada bayaran tidak tetap kepada keluarga isteri merupakan nafkah yang mencukupi di bawah undang-undang Islam. Standard nafkah yang diperlukan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether irregular payments to wife's family constitute adequate maintenance under Islamic law. Standard of maintenance required.
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti penting Jurnal Hukum mengenai standard nafkah dan apa yang merupakan nafkah yang mencukupi. Menjelaskan bahawa bayaran mestilah langsung dan tetap.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important Jurnal Hukum authority on the standard of maintenance and what constitutes adequate nafkah. Clarified that payments must be direct and regular.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan tuntutan nafkah, sentiasa sahkan keteraturan dan secara langsung pembayaran; sumbangan tidak teratur kepada ahli keluarga tidak mungkin dianggap mencukupi. Pastikan anda mengukur keperluan munasabah isteri berbanding dengan kemampuan suami untuk kes yang kukuh. Secara strategik, tumpukan pada mendokumentasikan kekerapan pembayaran dan penerima untuk mencabar atau mempertahankan tuntutan 'nafkah yang mencukupi'. Perangkap: mengandaikan sebarang bentuk sumbangan kewangan memenuhi keperluan nafkah.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling maintenance claims, always verify the regularity and directness of payments; irregular contributions to family members are unlikely to be considered adequate. Ensure you quantify the wife's reasonable needs relative to the husband's means for a strong case. Strategically, focus on documenting the payment frequency and recipient to challenge or defend against 'adequate maintenance' claims. Pitfall: assuming any form of financial contribution satisfies the nafkah requirement.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Tinggi memberikan hak penjagaan kepada ibu tetapi memutuskan bahawa penukaran agama anak-anak adalah sah.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The High Court granted custody to the mother but held that the conversion of the children was valid, as the court interpreted 'parent' in Article 12(4) to mean either parent.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang isteri Hindu memohon hak penjagaan dua orang anaknya selepas suaminya memeluk Islam dan menukar agama anak-anak secara unilateral.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Hindu wife applied for custody of her two children after her husband converted to Islam and unilaterally converted the children. She also challenged the validity of the children's conversion done without her consent.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Shamala Sathiyaseelan v Dr Jeyaganesh Mogarajah
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Kesahihan penukaran agama secara unilateral anak bawah umur oleh seorang ibu bapa.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Validity of unilateral conversion of minor children by one parent. Whether the civil court can determine custody when the children have been converted to Islam.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 12(4); Guardianship of Infants Act 1961
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes awal mengenai penukaran unilateral anak-anak, kemudian secara berkesan dibatalkan oleh Mahkamah Persekutuan dalam Indira Gandhi (2018).
sya_case_laws.significance_en: An early case on unilateral conversion of children, later effectively overruled by the Federal Court in Indira Gandhi (2018) which required both parents' consent.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan kes-kes lama mengenai penukaran sepihak, pengamal undang-undang mesti segera menyemak sama ada kedudukan undang-undang telah digantikan oleh keputusan Mahkamah Persekutuan yang lebih baru. Kes ini, walaupun penting dari segi sejarah, tidak lagi mencerminkan undang-undang semasa mengenai persetujuan ibu bapa untuk penukaran. Sentiasa utamakan keputusan mahkamah tertinggi yang terkini mengenai perkara-perkara bidang kuasa yang sensitif tersebut.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When encountering older cases on unilateral conversion, practitioners must immediately check if the legal position has been superseded by later Federal Court decisions. This case, though significant historically, no longer reflects current law on parental consent for conversion. Always prioritize the most recent apex court rulings on such sensitive jurisdictional matters.

sya_case_laws.tags: mut'ah, consolatory gift, quantification, Jurnal Hukum
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah menganugerahkan RM50,000 sebagai mut'ah, menetapkan pendekatan berstruktur untuk kuantifikasi. Faktor utama: (1) tempoh perkahwinan, (2) status kewangan suami, (3) umur isteri dan prospek masa depan, (4) sumbangan semasa perkahwinan, (5) keadaan perceraian. Jumlah tersebut sepatutnya menghiburkan dan memberi pampasan, bukan menghukum.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court awarded RM50,000 as mut'ah, establishing a structured approach to quantification. Key factors: (1) length of marriage, (2) husband's financial status, (3) wife's age and future prospects, (4) contributions during marriage, (5) circumstances of divorce. The amount should console and compensate, not punish.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri memohon mut'ah (pemberian saguhati) sebanyak RM100,000 selepas diceraikan secara talaq. Suami, seorang ahli perniagaan, berhujah jumlah tersebut berlebihan. Mahkamah memeriksa faktor-faktor yang perlu dipertimbangkan dalam mengkuantifikasikan mut'ah termasuk tempoh perkahwinan (18 tahun), keupayaan kewangan suami, sumbangan isteri, dan keadaan perceraian.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The wife sought mut'ah (consolatory gift) of RM100,000 after being divorced by talaq. The husband, a businessman, argued the amount was excessive. The court examined the factors to consider in quantifying mut'ah including the duration of the marriage (18 years), the husband's financial capacity, the wife's contributions, and the circumstances of the divorce.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Fatimah binti Hassan v Mohd Razali bin Ismail
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Metodologi untuk mengkuantifikasikan mut'ah. Faktor-faktor berkaitan termasuk tempoh perkahwinan, kemampuan suami, dan sumbangan isteri.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Methodology for quantifying mut'ah. Relevant factors including duration of marriage, husband's means, and wife's contributions.
sya_case_laws.legislation: S.56 Act 303
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes Jurnal Hukum utama mengenai metodologi kuantifikasi mut'ah. Menetapkan ujian lima faktor berstruktur untuk menentukan jumlah mut'ah yang sesuai.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Leading Jurnal Hukum case on mut'ah quantification methodology. Established a structured five-factor test for determining appropriate mut'ah amounts.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menuntut atau membela kuantum mut'ah, pastikan hujahan anda menangani dengan teliti setiap satu daripada lima faktor yang ditetapkan dalam kes ini, dengan memberikan bukti yang jelas bagi setiap perkara. Bagi pemohon, sediakan dokumentasi secara proaktif yang menunjukkan kemampuan kewangan suami dan sumbangan isteri. Bagi responden, fokuskan pada menangkis tuntutan yang terlalu tinggi sambil mencadangkan alternatif yang munasabah berdasarkan faktor yang sama, dengan menekankan prinsip 'bukan untuk menghukum'.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When claiming or defending a mut'ah quantum, ensure your submissions rigorously address each of the five factors established in this case, providing clear evidence for each point. For applicants, proactively prepare documentation illustrating the husband's financial capacity and the wife's contributions. For respondents, focus on discrediting inflated claims while proposing a reasonable alternative based on the same factors, highlighting the 'not to punish' principle.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa wakaf yang sah di bawah undang-undang Islam dikecualikan daripada peraturan common law terhadap perpetuiti.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court held that a valid wakaf under Islamic law is exempt from the common law rule against perpetuities. Islamic law permits perpetual endowments (wakaf) and this is recognized in Malaysian law.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Cabaran terhadap kesahihan amanah wakaf (endowmen Islam) yang telah diwujudkan bertahun-tahun yang lalu. Isu ialah sama ada peraturan terhadap perpetuiti di bawah common law terpakai untuk membatalkan wakaf.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A challenge to the validity of a wakaf (Islamic endowment) trust that had been created many years ago. The issue was whether the rule against perpetuities under common law applied to invalidate the wakaf.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Pedley v Majlis Ugama Islam Pulau Pinang
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada peraturan common law terhadap perpetuiti terpakai kepada wakaf Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the common law rule against perpetuities applies to an Islamic wakaf. The legal nature and requirements of a valid wakaf.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Administration of Islamic Law enactments; Trustee Act 1949
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti muktamad Malaysia yang menetapkan bahawa wakaf Islam dikecualikan daripada peraturan common law terhadap perpetuiti.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The definitive Malaysian authority establishing that Islamic wakaf is exempt from the common law rule against perpetuities. Essential for all wakaf and Islamic endowment matters.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan perkara wakaf, sentiasa merujuk Pedley v Majlis Ugama Islam Pulau Pinang untuk menetapkan bahawa kaedah common law terhadap perpetuities tidak terpakai kepada wakaf yang sah. Sahkan sifat undang-undang dan keperluan wakaf di bawah undang-undang Islam terlebih dahulu, kerana pengecualian hanya terpakai kepada wakaf yang benar-benar sah. Kesilapan umum adalah menganggap pengecualian itu terpakai secara universal tanpa meneliti pembentukan awal wakaf dan pematuhannya kepada prinsip Syariah.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with wakaf matters, always cite Pedley v Majlis Ugama Islam Pulau Pinang to establish that the common law rule against perpetuities does not apply to a valid wakaf. Verify the wakaf's legal nature and requirements under Islamic law first, as the exemption only applies to a genuinely valid wakaf. A common pitfall is assuming the exemption applies universally without scrutinizing the wakaf's initial formation and adherence to Shariah principles.

sya_case_laws.judge: Gopal Sri Ram, Zulkefli Ahmad Makinudin, Hasan Lah JJCA
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan memutuskan bahawa mahkamah Syariah mempunyai bidang kuasa untuk menentukan sama ada si mati adalah seorang Islam pada masa kematian.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Court of Appeal held that the Shariah court has jurisdiction to determine whether the deceased was a Muslim at the time of death. If the deceased was Muslim, the estate must be distributed according to faraid.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian mengenai harta pusaka si mati yang didakwa telah memeluk Islam sebelum kematian. Ahli keluarga bukan Islam mempertikaikan penukaran agama tersebut.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A dispute over the estate of a deceased who had allegedly converted to Islam before death. Non-Muslim family members contested the conversion and challenged the claim by the State Islamic Religious Council (MAIS) that the estate must be distributed according to faraid.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Majlis Agama Islam Selangor v Bong Boon Chuen & Others
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada si mati meninggal sebagai seorang Islam. Mahkamah mana (sivil atau Syariah) yang mempunyai bidang kuasa untuk menentukan status agama si mati.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the deceased died a Muslim. Which court (civil or Shariah) has jurisdiction to determine the religious status of a deceased person.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Administration of Islamic Law enactments; Probate and Administration Act 1959
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti utama mengenai isu bidang kuasa dalam pertikaian harta pusaka yang melibatkan status agama si mati.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key authority on jurisdictional issues in estate disputes involving the religious status of the deceased. Frequently cited in cases where conversion to Islam is contested after death.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan pertikaian harta pusaka di mana penukaran agama si mati kepada Islam dipertikaikan, sentiasa sahkan terlebih dahulu sama ada status agama telah ditentukan oleh Mahkamah Syariah, kerana ia mempunyai bidang kuasa eksklusif dalam perkara ini. Jika perkara bidang kuasa penting ini terlepas pandang, sebarang prosiding berikutnya di mahkamah sivil mengenai pembahagian faraid untuk harta pusaka Muslim boleh dicabar. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan untuk memfailkan permohonan di Mahkamah Syariah dengan segera untuk memastikan status agama si mati bagi mengelakkan pertikaian bidang kuasa.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling estate disputes where a deceased's conversion to Islam is contested, always first verify if the religious status has been determined by the Shariah court, as it holds exclusive jurisdiction on this matter. If this crucial jurisdictional point is overlooked, any subsequent proceedings in a civil court regarding faraid distribution for a Muslim estate may be challenged. Strategically, consider filing an application in the Shariah court promptly to ascertain the deceased's religious status to pre-empt jurisdictional disputes.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah menangani sifat kontrak BBA dan memutuskan bahawa ibra' harus diberikan sebagai amalan dan muhibah, walaupun ia mungkin bukan hak undang-undang yang ketat. Kes ini menyerlahkan ketegangan antara realiti komersial produk perbankan Islam dan konsep Syariah yang mendasarinya.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court addressed the nature of BBA contracts and held that ibra' should be granted as a matter of practice and good faith, though it may not be a strict legal entitlement. The case highlighted tensions between the commercial reality of Islamic banking products and their underlying Shariah concepts.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pemaju mencabar kesahihan kemudahan pembiayaan Islam Bai Bithaman Ajil (BBA) atas alasan bahawa harga jualan di bawah BBA adalah tidak munasabah dan bank telah gagal mematuhi prinsip Syariah. Kes ini memeriksa sama ada konsep ibra' (rebat untuk penyelesaian awal) adalah ciri yang melekat pada kontrak BBA.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The developer challenged the validity of a Bai Bithaman Ajil (BBA) Islamic financing facility on the grounds that the selling price under the BBA was unconscionable and that the bank had failed to comply with Shariah principles. The case examined whether the concept of ibra' (rebate for early settlement) was an inherent feature of BBA contracts.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Arab-Malaysian Finance Bhd v Taman Ihsan Jaya Sdn Bhd
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada harga jualan BBA adalah tidak munasabah. Sama ada ibra' adalah hak kontrak dalam BBA. Peranan mahkamah sivil dalam menilai pematuhan Syariah.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether BBA selling price is unconscionable. Whether ibra' is a contractual right in BBA. Role of civil courts in assessing Shariah compliance.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Banking Act 1983, Islamic Financial Services Act 2013
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes utama mengenai ibra' dalam kontrak BBA. Mempengaruhi panduan Bank Negara Malaysia seterusnya mengenai ibra'. Membawa kepada perubahan industri daripada BBA kepada produk berasaskan tawarruq.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key case on ibra' in BBA contracts. Influenced subsequent Bank Negara Malaysia guidelines on ibra'. Led to industry shift from BBA to tawarruq-based products.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan pertikaian pembiayaan BBA, sentiasa sahkan sama ada aspek ibra' dicabar. Nasihatkan pelanggan bahawa walaupun bukan suatu hak undang-undang yang ketat, mahkamah menjangkakan bank memberikan ibra' secara jujur. Sedarilah bahawa industri telah beralih daripada BBA kepada tawarruq; pastikan anda memahami implikasinya untuk perjanjian lama.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with BBA financing disputes, always verify if the ibra' aspect is being challenged. Advise clients that while not a strict legal entitlement, courts expect banks to grant ibra' in good faith. Be aware that the industry has largely shifted away from BBA to tawarruq; ensure you understand the implications for older agreements.

sya_case_laws.tags: mut'ah, consolatory gift, quantum, assessment criteria
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah menetapkan panduan untuk penilaian mut'ah: tempoh perkahwinan, kemampuan kewangan suami, sumbangan isteri, keadaan perceraian, umur dan prospek isteri.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Court established guidelines for mut'ah assessment: duration of marriage, husband's financial capacity, wife's contributions, circumstances of divorce, wife's age and prospects.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri menuntut mut'ah (pemberian saguhati) apabila berlaku perceraian. Mahkamah mempertimbangkan kadar yang sesuai berdasarkan tempoh perkahwinan, kemampuan suami, dan sumbangan isteri.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Wife claimed mut'ah (consolatory gift) upon divorce. The court considered the appropriate quantum based on the marriage duration, husband's means, and wife's contributions.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Jumaaton & Satu Lagi v Raja Hizaruddin
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Berapakah kadar mut'ah yang sesuai? Apakah faktor yang perlu dipertimbangkan oleh mahkamah?
sya_case_laws.issues_en: What is the appropriate quantum of mut'ah? What factors should the court consider?
sya_case_laws.legislation: Act 303 s.56
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti utama mengenai panduan kadar mut'ah. Sering dirujuk dalam tuntutan mut'ah seterusnya.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key authority on mut'ah quantum guidelines. Frequently cited in subsequent mut'ah claims.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menuntut mut'ah, sentiasa rujuk Jumaaton & Satu Lagi v Raja Hizaruddin untuk garis panduan penilaian. Sediakan bukti komprehensif tentang tempoh perkahwinan, kedudukan kewangan suami, dan sumbangan isteri untuk menyokong kuantum. Ketahui bahawa mahkamah akan menimbang semua faktor, termasuk keadaan perceraian dan prospek isteri. Secara strategik, tumpukan pada bukti nyata sumbangan dan kemampuan suami untuk membayar bagi mencapai keputusan yang memihak.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When claiming mut'ah, always reference Jumaaton & Satu Lagi v Raja Hizaruddin for the assessment guidelines. Prepare comprehensive evidence on marriage duration, husband's financial standing, and wife's contributions to substantiate the quantum. Be aware that the court will weigh all factors, including the circumstances of divorce and wife's prospects. Strategically, focus on tangible proof of contribution and the husband's capacity to pay to achieve a favorable outcome.

sya_case_laws.tags: purdah, religious freedom, Article 11, employment, dress code
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa walaupun Islam adalah hak pemohon untuk dianuti dan diamalkan, memakai purdah bukan keperluan wajib dalam Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court held that while Islam is the applicant's right to profess and practice, wearing purdah is not a mandatory requirement of Islam. The right to freedom of religion is not absolute and is subject to restrictions on public order, public health, and morality.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang penjawat awam wanita Muslim mencabar pemecatannya kerana memakai purdah ke tempat kerja, berhujah ia adalah kewajipan agamanya di bawah Islam dan dilindungi oleh Perkara 11.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Muslim woman civil servant challenged her dismissal for wearing purdah (face veil) to work, arguing it was her religious obligation under Islam and protected by Article 11 of the Federal Constitution.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Halimatussaadiah bte Hj Kamaruddin v Public Services Commission Malaysia
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada memakai purdah adalah keperluan Islam yang dilindungi oleh hak perlembagaan kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether wearing purdah is a requirement of Islam protected by the constitutional right to freedom of religion. Whether an employer can impose dress code restrictions on religious attire.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 11
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti utama mengenai had kebebasan beragama di bawah Perkara 11, khususnya mengenai kod pakaian di tempat kerja.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The leading authority on the limits of religious freedom under Article 11, particularly regarding dress code in the workplace. Established the distinction between mandatory and voluntary religious practices.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati mengenai pakaian keagamaan di tempat kerja, sentiasa sahkan sama ada amalan tersebut adalah kewajipan agama yang mandatori atau sukarela, kerana perbezaan ini adalah penting untuk perlindungan perlembagaan. Nasihati pelanggan bahawa kebebasan beragama tidak mutlak dan boleh tertakluk kepada sekatan majikan, terutamanya dalam perkhidmatan awam. Pertimbangkan konteks khusus ketenteraman awam, kesihatan awam, atau moral apabila menilai potensi cabaran terhadap kod pakaian. Petua strategik adalah untuk meneroka sebarang mekanisme aduan dalaman atau akomodasi alternatif sebelum mengambil tindakan undang-undang, kerana mahkamah cenderung untuk mempertahankan budi bicara majikan dalam amalan keagamaan yang tidak mandatori.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When advising on religious attire in the workplace, always verify if the practice is a mandatory religious obligation or a voluntary one, as this distinction is crucial for constitutional protection. Counsel clients that freedom of religion is not absolute and can be subject to employer restrictions, especially in public service. Consider the specific context of public order, public health, or morality when assessing potential challenges to dress codes. A strategic tip is to explore any internal grievance mechanisms or alternative accommodations before resorting to litigation, as the courts tend to uphold employer discretion in non-mandatory religious practices.

sya_case_laws.tags: nasab, legitimacy, minimum gestation, six months
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah menggunakan undang-undang Islam dan memutuskan bahawa tempoh minimum kehamilan ialah enam bulan qamariah. Anak yang lahir kurang daripada enam bulan selepas perkahwinan tidak boleh dinasabkan kepada suami.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court applied Islamic law and held that the minimum period of gestation is six lunar months (qamariah). A child born less than six months after the marriage cannot be attributed to the husband.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Plaintif mendakwa sebagai anak sah bapa yang didakwanya. Isu ialah sama ada anak yang lahir kurang daripada enam bulan selepas perkahwinan ibu bapa boleh dianggap anak sah di bawah undang-undang Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The plaintiff claimed to be the legitimate child of his alleged father. The issue was whether a child born less than six months after the parents' marriage could be considered a legitimate child under Islamic law.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Ainan bin Mahmud v Syed Abu Bakar
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Tempoh minimum kehamilan di bawah undang-undang Islam bagi tujuan menetapkan paterniti sah (nasab).
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The minimum period of gestation under Islamic law for purposes of establishing legitimate paternity (nasab).
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic law principles on nasab (lineage)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti asas pra-kemerdekaan mengenai nasab di bawah undang-undang Islam. Peraturan tempoh kehamilan minimum enam bulan yang ditetapkan di sini terus digunakan di mahkamah Syariah Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The foundational pre-independence authority on nasab (lineage/legitimacy) under Islamic law. The six-month minimum gestation rule established here continues to be applied in Malaysian Shariah courts.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan kes kesahihan nasab, sentiasa sahkan tarikh perkahwinan berbanding tarikh lahir anak menggunakan dokumen yang diperakui untuk mengesahkan sama ada tempoh kehamilan enam bulan qamariah dipenuhi. Berhati-hati bahawa perkahwinan semula atau perceraian selepas itu sebelum kelahiran anak mungkin merumitkan paterniti, memerlukan penyiasatan terperinci mengenai status perkahwinan ibu. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada sebarang bukti perubatan boleh mencabar atau menyokong tempoh kehamilan konvensional dalam keadaan luar biasa, walaupun mahkamah Syariah biasanya berpegang teguh pada tempoh minimum yang ditetapkan. Pastikan semua dokumen adalah asli atau salinan yang diperakui, kerana percanggahan boleh menyebabkan kelewatan yang ketara atau penolakan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling legitimacy cases, always verify the marriage date against the child's birth date using certified documents to confirm if the six-lunar-month gestation period is met. Be mindful that subsequent re-marriages or divorces before the child's birth may complicate paternity, requiring detailed investigation into the mother's marital status. Strategically, consider if any medical evidence could challenge or support the conventional gestation period in exceptional circumstances, though Shariah courts typically adhere strictly to the established minimum. Ensure all documents are original or certified true copies, as discrepancies can lead to significant delays or dismissal.

sya_case_laws.tags: wasiat, Islamic will, one-third rule, non-heir bequest
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah menggunakan peraturan undang-undang Islam bahawa wasiat dihadkan kepada satu pertiga harta pusaka bersih untuk bukan waris.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court applied the Islamic law rule that wasiat is limited to one-third of the net estate for non-heirs. Any bequest exceeding one-third requires the consent of all heirs. Without such consent, the excess is void.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian mengenai kesahihan wasiat yang bertujuan untuk mewasiatkan lebih daripada satu pertiga harta pusaka kepada bukan waris. Waris lain mencabar wasiat tersebut kerana melebihi had yang dibenarkan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A dispute over the validity of a wasiat (Islamic will) that purported to bequeath more than one-third of the estate to a non-heir. Other heirs challenged the bequest as exceeding the permitted limit.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Abdul Shaik bin Md Ibrahim v Hussein Ibrahim
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Had satu pertiga wasiat di bawah undang-undang Islam. Sama ada wasiat melebihi satu pertiga boleh disahkan dengan persetujuan waris.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The one-third limit on wasiat under Islamic law. Whether a wasiat exceeding one-third can be validated with heirs' consent.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Administration of Islamic Law enactments; Probate and Administration Act 1959
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kenyataan kehakiman yang jelas mengenai peraturan satu pertiga untuk wasiat dan keperluan persetujuan waris untuk wasiat berlebihan.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A clear judicial statement on the one-third rule for wasiat and the requirement for heirs' consent for excess bequests.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menggubal atau menasihati mengenai wasiat, sentiasa sahkan persetujuan semua waris sah jika pemberian melebihi satu pertiga daripada harta pusaka; kegagalan mendapatkan persetujuan penuh menjadikan lebihan itu batal. Utamakan mendapatkan persetujuan yang jelas dan didokumenkan daripada semua waris untuk mengelakkan cabaran di masa hadapan. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada untuk menggubal wasiat berasingan untuk bahagian yang mematuhi satu pertiga dan bahagian yang memerlukan persetujuan. Nasihatkan pelanggan bahawa wasiat tanpa persetujuan waris untuk pemberian berlebihan adalah sangat terdedah.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When drafting or advising on a wasiat, always verify the consent of all legal heirs if the bequest exceeds one-third of the estate; failure to obtain full consent renders the excess void. Prioritise obtaining explicit, documented consent from all heirs to avoid future challenges. Strategically, consider whether to draft separate wasiat for the one-third compliant portion and the portion requiring consent. Advise clients that a wasiat without heir consent for excess bequests is highly vulnerable.

sya_case_laws.tags: mut'ah, consolatory gift, divorce, quantum, lifestyle
sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Dato' Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah memutuskan bahawa mut'ah hendaklah dinilai berdasarkan: (1) kemampuan kewangan suami, (2) gaya hidup isteri semasa perkahwinan, (3) tempoh perkahwinan, (4) keadaan perceraian.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Appeal Court held that mut'ah should be assessed based on: (1) the husband's financial means, (2) the wife's lifestyle during marriage, (3) the length of the marriage, (4) the circumstances of the divorce. Awarded substantial mut'ah reflecting the husband's wealth.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Selepas perceraian talaq, isteri menuntut mut'ah (pemberian saguhati). Isu ialah kuantum mut'ah yang perlu dianugerahkan, mengambil kira kekayaan suami yang besar dan status isteri.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Following a talaq divorce, the wife claimed mut'ah (consolatory gift). The issue was the quantum of mut'ah to be awarded, considering the husband's substantial wealth and the wife's status.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Tengku Puteri Zainah binti Tengku Eskandar v Dato' Seri Diraja Wan Mohd Tahir bin Hj Ibrahim
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Prinsip untuk menentukan kuantum mut'ah. Sama ada kemampuan kewangan suami dan gaya hidup lazim isteri perlu dipertimbangkan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The principles for determining the quantum of mut'ah. Whether the husband's financial capacity and the wife's accustomed lifestyle should be considered.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (State of Terengganu) Enactment, s.58
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah yang penting menetapkan prinsip untuk menilai kuantum mut'ah.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: An important Shariah appellate authority establishing principles for assessing mut'ah quantum. Frequently cited in high-value mut'ah claims.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan tuntutan mut'ah bernilai tinggi, sentiasa silang rujuk kemampuan kewangan suami yang didedahkan dan gaya hidup isteri yang biasa terhadap empat prinsip yang ditetapkan dari Tengku Puteri Zainah. Pastikan anda mengumpulkan bukti komprehensif mengenai kedua-dua aspek ini untuk menyokong atau mencabar kuantum. Satu perangkap biasa ialah kurang menyediakan bukti untuk gaya hidup isteri semasa perkahwinan, yang sangat penting untuk memaksimumkan anugerah. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan untuk merundingkan penyelesaian dengan membentangkan kes yang kuat berdasarkan faktor-faktor ini, memanfaatkan penekanan duluan terhadap anugerah besar dalam senario bernilai tinggi yang serupa.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling high-value mut'ah claims, always cross-reference the husband's disclosed financial capacity and the wife's accustomed lifestyle against the four established principles from Tengku Puteri Zainah. Ensure you gather comprehensive evidence on both these aspects to support or challenge the quantum. A common pitfall is under-preparing evidence for the wife's lifestyle during the marriage, which is crucial for maximizing the award. Strategically, consider negotiating a settlement by presenting a strong case on these factors, leveraging the precedent's emphasis on substantial awards in similar high-net-worth scenarios.

sya_case_laws.tags: ta'liq, conditional divorce, breach of ta'liq, fasakh
sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Dato' Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah memutuskan bahawa isteri telah membuktikan pelanggaran syarat ta'liq atas imbangan kebarangkalian.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Court of Appeal held that the wife had proved the breach of ta'liq conditions on the balance of probabilities. The divorce was confirmed based on breach of the standard ta'liq conditions.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri memohon perceraian atas alasan suami telah melanggar ta'liq (syarat yang dilampirkan pada sijil nikah). Suami gagal memberi nafkah selama lebih tiga bulan dan telah melakukan penderaan fizikal terhadap isteri.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The wife applied for divorce on the ground that the husband had breached the ta'liq (conditions attached to the marriage certificate). The husband had failed to provide maintenance for more than three months and had physically abused the wife.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Jumaaton binti Awang & Another v Raja Hizaruddin bin Raja Nong Chik
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Keperluan untuk membuktikan pelanggaran syarat ta'liq. Standard pembuktian yang diperlukan untuk perceraian ta'liq.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The requirements for proving breach of ta'liq conditions. The standard of proof required for ta'liq divorce.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (Federal Territories) Act 1984 (Act 303), s.50
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah yang utama mengenai prosiding perceraian ta'liq.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A leading Shariah appellate authority on ta'liq divorce proceedings, setting out the evidentiary requirements for proving breach of ta'liq conditions.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan permohonan cerai ta'liq, sentiasa semak sama ada kes anak guam anda selaras dengan 'syarat ta'liq standard' kerana kes ini menekankan kepentingannya. Sediakan bukti kukuh yang menunjukkan kegagalan suami menyediakan nafkah atau penderaan fizikal, kerana 'atas imbangan kebarangkalian' adalah taraf pembuktian yang diperlukan. Tip strategik utama adalah untuk mendokumentasikan semua pelanggaran secara berkaedah dari semasa ke semasa, kerana kegagalan berterusan mengukuhkan kes anda. Pastikan bukti anda secara langsung merujuk kepada syarat-syarat khusus seperti yang digariskan dalam sijil perkahwinan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a ta'liq divorce application, always check if your client's case aligns with the 'standard ta'liq conditions' as this case highlights their importance. Prepare robust evidence demonstrating the husband's failure to provide maintenance or physical abuse, as the 'balance of probabilities' is the required standard of proof. A key strategic tip is to methodically document all breaches over time, as sustained failure strengthens your case. Ensure your evidence directly addresses the specific conditions as outlined in the marriage certificate.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Tinggi memutuskan bahawa mahkamah Syariah tidak mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas orang bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The High Court held that the Shariah court has no jurisdiction over non-Muslims. The constitutional provisions establishing Shariah courts limit their jurisdiction to persons professing the religion of Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang wanita bukan Islam dipanggil untuk hadir di hadapan mahkamah Syariah berkaitan perkahwinannya dengan seorang lelaki Islam. Beliau mencabar bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah ke atas dirinya sebagai seorang bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A non-Muslim woman was summoned to appear before the Shariah court in connection with her marriage to a Muslim man. She challenged the Shariah court's jurisdiction over her as a non-Muslim.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Kelthie Teoi a/p Lian Hoe v The Syariah Judge, Ipoh, Perak & Others
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada mahkamah Syariah mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas seorang bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the Shariah court has jurisdiction over a non-Muslim person.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 121(1A); State Administration of Islamic Law enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Menetapkan prinsip jelas bahawa mahkamah Syariah tidak mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas orang bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Established the clear principle that Shariah courts have no jurisdiction over non-Muslims, a principle consistently upheld in subsequent cases.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila bukan Islam terlibat dalam hal keluarga di Mahkamah Syariah, sentiasa sahkan sama ada bukan Islam tersebut telah disaman atau hadir secara sukarela. Kes ini menekankan hak bukan Islam untuk mencabar bidang kuasa Mahkamah Syariah ke atas mereka. Jika bukan Islam mencabar bidang kuasa, rujuk preseden ini secara proaktif untuk menyokong kedudukan mereka, terutamanya di peringkat awal yang mungkin. Ingat bahawa bidang kuasa mahkamah adalah terhad kepada orang yang menganut agama Islam.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When a non-Muslim is involved in a family matter before the Shariah Court, always verify if the non-Muslim was summoned or appeared voluntarily. This case highlights a non-Muslim's right to challenge the Shariah Court's jurisdiction over them. If the non-Muslim challenges jurisdiction, proactively cite this precedent to support their position, especially at the earliest possible stage. Remember that the court's jurisdiction is limited to persons professing the religion of Islam.

sya_case_laws.tags: maintenance, high income, accustomed standard of living, quantum
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah mengesahkan bahawa nafkah mesti mencerminkan taraf hidup yang biasa dinikmati isteri semasa perkahwinan, bukan sekadar keperluan asas. Golongan berpendapatan tinggi menanggung kewajipan nafkah yang lebih tinggi secara berkadar. Perbelanjaan pendidikan di institusi yang mantap adalah tuntutan yang sah.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court affirmed that maintenance must reflect the wife's accustomed standard of living during the marriage, not merely basic necessities. High-income earners bear proportionally higher maintenance obligations. Educational expenses at established institutions are legitimate claims.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang suami yang mempunyai pendapatan tinggi diperintahkan membayar nafkah yang besar untuk isteri dan anak-anaknya. Beliau merayu terhadap kadar atas alasan jumlah tersebut berlebihan. Mahkamah perlu menentukan metodologi yang betul untuk menilai nafkah berdasarkan kemampuan suami dan taraf hidup yang biasa dinikmati isteri di bawah s.59 AUKI.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A husband who earned a high income was ordered to pay substantial maintenance for his wife and children. He appealed against the quantum on the grounds that the amount was excessive. The court had to determine the proper methodology for assessing maintenance based on the husband's means and the wife's accustomed standard of living under s.59 AUKI.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Isa Abdul Rahman v Norizan binti Bakar
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Metodologi untuk menilai kadar nafkah. Mengimbangi kemampuan suami terhadap taraf hidup yang biasa dinikmati isteri. Perbelanjaan pendidikan dan perubatan anak-anak.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Methodology for assessing maintenance quantum. Balancing husband's means against wife's accustomed standard of living. Children's educational and medical expenses.
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes penting mengenai metodologi kadar nafkah untuk keluarga berpendapatan tinggi. Menetapkan bahawa taraf hidup yang biasa dinikmati adalah penanda aras, bukan keperluan minimum.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important case on maintenance quantum methodology for high-income families. Established that accustomed standard of living is the benchmark, not minimum needs.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengemukakan tuntutan nafkah, sentiasa tekankan taraf hidup isteri yang lazim semasa perkahwinan, bukan hanya keperluan asas, terutamanya jika suami adalah berpendapatan tinggi. Sediakan bukti terperinci tentang gaya hidup keluarga, termasuk perbelanjaan untuk pendidikan di institusi yang mapan. Untuk pembelaan, teliti tuntutan taraf hidup lazim untuk memastikan ia benar-benar mencerminkan tempoh perkahwinan dan bukan tuntutan yang dibesar-besarkan selepas perpisahan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When presenting a maintenance claim, always emphasize the wife's accustomed standard of living during the marriage, not just basic needs, especially if the husband is a high-income earner. Prepare detailed evidence of the family's lifestyle, including expenses for education at established institutions. For the defense, scrutinize the accustomed standard of living claim to ensure it is genuinely reflective of the marriage period and not an inflated post-separation demand.

sya_case_laws.tags: polygamy, civil court, Shariah court, jurisdiction
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa mahkamah sivil tidak mempunyai bidang kuasa untuk campur tangan dalam perkara dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court held that the civil court has no jurisdiction to interfere in matters within the Shariah court's jurisdiction, including polygamous marriages. Article 121(1A) bars civil court intervention.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri mendapat injunksi mahkamah sivil untuk menghalang suami berkahwin lagi. Suami merayu, berhujah bahawa perkara tersebut terletak dalam bidang kuasa eksklusif mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The wife obtained a civil court injunction to prevent her husband from marrying a second wife. The husband appealed, arguing that the matter fell within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Shariah court.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Mohamed Habibullah bin Mahmood v Faridah Dato Talib
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada mahkamah sivil boleh memberikan injunksi untuk menghalang perkahwinan poligami yang terletak dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the civil court can grant an injunction to prevent a polygamous marriage that falls within Shariah court jurisdiction.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 121(1A); Islamic Family Law (Federal Territories) Act 1984
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Mengukuhkan prinsip pengecualian bidang kuasa di bawah Perkara 121(1A) dalam konteks permohonan poligami.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Reinforced the jurisdictional exclusion principle under Article 121(1A) in the context of polygamy applications.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan permohonan untuk menghalang perkahwinan poligami, sentiasa sahkan jika perkara itu berada di bawah bidang kuasa Mahkamah Syariah, kerana Mahkamah Sivil secara jelas dilarang campur tangan di bawah Perkara 121(1A). Secara strategik, pengamal undang-undang hendaklah segera membangkitkan cabaran bidang kuasa jika anak guam disaman secara salah di mahkamah sivil berhubung perkara Syariah. Pastikan semua permohonan berkaitan poligami difailkan dengan betul di Mahkamah Syariah yang sesuai untuk mengelakkan penolakan kerana kekurangan bidang kuasa. Kes ini menekankan kepentingan memahami batasan bidang kuasa yang jelas antara Mahkamah Sivil dan Mahkamah Syariah di Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When faced with an application to prevent a polygamous marriage, always verify if the matter falls under Shariah court jurisdiction, as civil courts are expressly barred from intervention under Article 121(1A).  Strategically, practitioners should immediately raise jurisdictional challenges if a client is wrongly sued in a civil court over a Shariah matter.  Ensure all polygamy-related applications are correctly filed in the appropriate Shariah court to avoid dismissal due to lack of jurisdiction. This case underscores the importance of understanding the clear jurisdictional boundaries between civil and Shariah courts in Malaysia.

sya_case_laws.tags: tudung, hijab, religious dress, employment, freedom of religion
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Tinggi memutuskan bahawa walaupun kebebasan beragama dilindungi di bawah Perkara 11, ia tertakluk kepada sekatan. Memakai purdah bukan keperluan wajib (fardu ain) Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The High Court held that while freedom of religion is protected under Article 11, it is subject to restrictions. Wearing purdah is not an obligatory requirement (fardu ain) of Islam but a commendable practice. The government's dress code restriction was reasonable.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang penjawat awam wanita Islam diberi amaran kerana memakai purdah (penutup muka yang menutup semua kecuali mata) ke tempat kerja.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Muslim female government servant was issued a warning for wearing purdah (face veil covering all but the eyes) to work. She challenged the dress code restriction as violating her constitutional right to freedom of religion.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Hjh Halimatussaadiah bte Hj Kamaruddin v Public Services Commission, Malaysia & Another
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada peraturan kod pakaian kerajaan boleh menyekat pakaian keagamaan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether government dress code regulations can restrict religious dress. The scope of Article 11 protection for religious practices.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 11; General Orders
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti awal yang membezakan antara amalan keagamaan wajib dan sunat dalam konteks perlindungan perlembagaan kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: An early authority distinguishing between obligatory and commendable religious practices in the context of constitutional protection of religious freedom.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati mengenai sekatan amalan keagamaan, mula-mula pastikan sama ada amalan itu fardu ain atau amalan yang terpuji, kerana kes ini menyerlahkan kesan undang-undang perbezaan tersebut. Sentiasa sahkan peraturan kod pakaian tertentu berbanding dengan keperluan agama yang dituntut untuk mengenal pasti sebarang percanggahan langsung. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan jika terdapat cara alternatif untuk klien mematuhi kepercayaan agama mereka tanpa melanggar peraturan tempat kerja, dengan menumpukan pada akomodasi dan bukannya cabaran secara langsung. Perangkap biasa ialah terlepas pandang peruntukan 'tertakluk kepada sekatan' dalam Perkara 11, yang sering membenarkan batasan yang munasabah terhadap kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When advising on religious practice restrictions, first ascertain if the practice is fardu ain or a commendable act, as this case highlights the distinction's legal impact. Always verify the specific dress code regulations against the claimed religious requirement to identify any direct conflict. Strategically, consider if there are alternative ways for the client to adhere to their religious beliefs without violating workplace rules, focusing on accommodation rather than outright challenge. A common pitfall is overlooking the 'subject to restrictions' proviso in Article 11, which often allows for reasonable limitations on religious freedom.

sya_case_laws.tags: death penalty, Article 3, Islam as religion of the Federation, constitutional law
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa Perkara 3(1) tidak menjadikan undang-undang Islam sebagai undang-undang tertinggi Persekutuan. Islam sebagai 'agama Persekutuan' terhad kepada tujuan adat istiadat dan ritual.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court held that Article 3(1) does not make Islamic law the supreme law of the Federation. Islam as the 'religion of the Federation' is confined to ceremonial and ritualistic purposes. The Constitution is secular in nature and Islamic law applies only in matters specified in the State List.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Perayu-perayu yang disabitkan dengan pengedaran dadah dan dijatuhkan hukuman mati, mencabar hukuman mati mandatori sebagai bertentangan dengan Islam yang merupakan agama Persekutuan di bawah Perkara 3 Perlembagaan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The appellants, convicted of drug trafficking and sentenced to death, challenged the mandatory death penalty as contrary to Islam which is the religion of the Federation under Article 3 of the Constitution. They argued that Islamic law prescribes specific punishments and the death penalty for drug trafficking is not among them.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Che Omar bin Che Soh v Public Prosecutor
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Makna dan skop Perkara 3(1) — 'Islam ialah agama bagi Persekutuan'. Sama ada Perkara 3 menghendaki semua undang-undang mematuhi prinsip Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The meaning and scope of Article 3(1) — 'Islam is the religion of the Federation'. Whether Article 3 requires all laws to comply with Islamic principles.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 3; Dangerous Drugs Act 1952
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Pengumuman paling berwibawa mengenai makna Perkara 3 — Islam sebagai agama Persekutuan.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The most authoritative pronouncement on the meaning of Article 3 — Islam as the religion of the Federation. Established that Malaysia's constitutional framework is fundamentally secular with Islam's role being ceremonial.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila memetik kes ini, sahkan konteks khusus hujah anda dengan teliti kerana tafsirannya terhadap Perkara 3 adalah sempit. Perhatikan bahawa walaupun ia mengehadkan aplikasi undang-undang Islam, duluan ini juga mengesahkan peranan istiadat Islam. Pertimbangkan pindaan perlembagaan atau keputusan mahkamah persekutuan yang berikutnya yang mungkin membezakan atau memperhalusi skop keputusan ini. Secara strategik, gunakannya untuk berhujah demi sifat sekular undang-undang persekutuan di mana sesuai, atau untuk menyerlahkan tafsiran sejarah Perkara 3.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When citing this case, verify the specific context of your argument carefully as its interpretation of Article 3 is narrow. Note that while it limits the application of Islamic law, this precedent also confirms Islam's ceremonial role. Consider subsequent constitutional amendments or federal court decisions that might distinguish or refine this ruling's scope. Strategically, use this to argue for the secular nature of federal law where appropriate, or to highlight the historical interpretation of Article 3.

sya_case_laws.tags: serban, turban, school rules, religious freedom, education
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan memutuskan bahawa memakai serban bukan keperluan wajib Islam (bukan fardu ain). Peraturan pakaian seragam sekolah memenuhi tujuan pendidikan dan pentadbiran yang sah.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Court of Appeal held that wearing a serban is not an obligatory requirement of Islam (not fardu ain). School uniform rules serve legitimate educational and administrative purposes and do not violate Article 11.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pelajar sekolah Islam dibuang kerana memakai serban ke sekolah yang melanggar peraturan pakaian seragam sekolah. Ibu bapa mereka mencabar pembuangan tersebut.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Muslim school students were expelled for wearing serban (turban) to school in violation of school uniform rules. Their parents challenged the expulsion as violating the students' freedom of religion under Article 11 and right to education under Article 12.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Meor Atiqulrahman bin Ishak v Fatimah Sihi & Others
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada peraturan sekolah mengenai pakaian seragam boleh mengatasi hak perlembagaan untuk mengamalkan agama.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether school rules on uniform can override the constitutional right to practice religion. Whether wearing a serban is a mandatory Islamic practice.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Articles 8, 11, 12; Education Act 1996
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan penting mengenai pakaian keagamaan di institusi pendidikan.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important appellate authority on religious dress in educational institutions. Established the distinction between mandatory and voluntary religious practices in the context of school regulations.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati mengenai pakaian keagamaan di sekolah, sahkan terlebih dahulu jika amalan tertentu dianggap 'fardu ain' (wajib) mengikut Syariah, membezakannya daripada amalan sukarela. Kes ini menekankan bahawa peraturan pakaian seragam sekolah secara amnya mengatasi amalan keagamaan yang tidak wajib untuk tujuan pendidikan yang sah. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada mana-mana dasar sekolah mungkin dilihat secara tidak langsung memaksa pelajar untuk meninggalkan amalan keagamaan asas, dan bukannya hanya mengawal amalan sukarela.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When advising on religious dress in schools, first verify if the specific practice is considered 'fardu ain' (obligatory) as per Shariah, distinguishing it from voluntary acts. This case highlights that school uniform rules generally supersede non-obligatory religious practices for legitimate educational purposes. Strategically, consider whether any school policy might be perceived as indirectly coercing a student away from a fundamental religious observance, rather than merely regulating a voluntary practice.

sya_case_laws.tags: faraid, family settlement, ibra', sulh, estate planning
sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Dato' Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah memutuskan bahawa selepas bahagian faraid ditentukan dan disahkan, waris bebas untuk mengagihkan semula sesama mereka dengan persetujuan bersama (ibra' atau takharuj).
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Court of Appeal held that after the faraid shares have been determined and certified, heirs are free to redistribute among themselves by mutual agreement (ibra' or takharuj). The agreement must be voluntary and with full knowledge of their respective entitlements.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Waris-waris kepada harta pusaka Islam yang besar telah memasuki perjanjian penyelesaian keluarga (sulh/ibra') untuk mengagihkan harta secara berbeza daripada nisbah faraid yang ketat.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Heirs to a substantial Muslim estate had entered into a family settlement agreement (sulh/ibra') to distribute the estate differently from the strict faraid proportions. Some heirs later challenged the agreement, arguing that faraid distribution is mandatory and cannot be varied by agreement.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Tunku Naquiyuddin ibni Tunku Ja'afar v Tunku Nadzimuddin ibni Tunku Ibrahim
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada waris faraid boleh bersetuju untuk mengagihkan harta secara berbeza daripada nisbah faraid.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether faraid heirs can agree to distribute the estate differently from faraid proportions. Validity of family settlement (sulh/ibra') in Islamic estate distribution.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Administration of Islamic Law enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah utama mengesahkan kesahihan penyelesaian keluarga selepas faraid.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key Shariah appellate authority affirming the validity of post-faraid family settlements. Important for Islamic estate planning practitioners.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati anak guam mengenai pembahagian harta pusaka, pastikan sama ada bahagian faraid telah ditetapkan dan diperakui secara rasmi sebelum mencadangkan perjanjian penyelesaian. Pastikan mana-mana perjanjian 'ibra' atau 'takharuj' menyatakan dengan jelas bahawa ia adalah secara sukarela dan semua pihak menyedari sepenuhnya hak faraid sebenar mereka untuk mengelakkan cabaran di masa hadapan. Petua strategik adalah untuk mendokumentasikan pengakuan setiap waris mengenai hak mereka dan sifat sukarela perjanjian itu, sebaik-baiknya disaksikan, untuk mengukuhkan penyelesaian terhadap tuntutan paksaan atau kejahilan. Teliti bahasa perjanjian untuk secara jelas menggambarkan persetujuan bersama untuk menyimpang daripada faraid yang ketat, merujuk kes ini untuk menekankan kesahihannya.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When advising clients on estate distribution, ascertain if the faraid shares have been officially determined and certified before proposing a settlement agreement. Ensure any 'ibra' or 'takharuj' agreement clearly states it is voluntary and that all parties are fully aware of their actual faraid entitlements to prevent future challenges. A strategic tip is to document each heir's acknowledgment of their entitlements and the voluntary nature of the agreement, preferably witnessed, to fortify the settlement against claims of duress or ignorance. Scrutinize the agreement's language to explicitly reflect mutual consent to deviate from strict faraid, referencing this case to underscore its validity.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah mengaplikasikan prinsip faraid dengan teliti, mengenal pasti bahagian Al-Quran setiap waris. Menyediakan pengiraan terperinci untuk pembahagian.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Court applied faraid principles meticulously, identifying each heir's Quranic share. Provided detailed calculations for the distribution.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian pentadbiran harta pusaka melibatkan pembahagian harta pusaka Islam menurut prinsip faraid. Isu mengenai pengenalpastian waris dan bahagian masing-masing.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Estate administration dispute involving distribution of a Muslim estate according to faraid principles. Issues regarding the identification of heirs and their respective shares.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Re Dato' Bentara Luar, Deceased; Haji Yahya v Hassan
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Pemakaian peraturan faraid dalam pembahagian harta pusaka. Pengenalpastian waris Al-Quran dan waris baki.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Application of faraid rules in estate distribution. Identification of Quranic heirs and residuary heirs.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Islamic Law Administration Enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes utama mengenai pemakaian praktikal peraturan faraid di mahkamah Malaysia. Sering dirujuk untuk pengiraan faraid.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Leading case on practical application of faraid rules in Malaysian courts. Frequently cited for faraid calculations.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan pembahagian faraid, sahkan dengan teliti semua waris berpotensi dan hubungan mereka dengan si mati untuk memastikan pengenalpastian yang tepat sama ada waris Quranic atau waris asabah. Sentiasa semak semula pengiraan berbanding dengan duluan ini kerana ia memberikan contoh kukuh aplikasi terperinci prinsip faraid oleh mahkamah. Petua strategik adalah untuk menyediakan jadual pembahagian yang jelas dan terperinci merujuk metodologi kes ini, menjangkakan penelitian mahkamah terhadap setiap bahagian. Berhati-hati bahawa sebarang kesilapan pengenalpastian atau pengiraan boleh menyebabkan pertikaian dan rayuan yang berpanjangan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling faraid distribution, meticulously verify all potential heirs and their relationships to the deceased to ensure accurate identification as Quranic or residuary heirs. Always double-check calculations against this precedent as it provides a robust example of the court's detailed application of faraid principles. A strategic tip is to prepare a clear, itemised distribution table referencing this case's methodology, anticipating court scrutiny on every share. Be mindful that any misidentification or calculation error can lead to prolonged disputes and appeals.

sya_case_laws.tags: harta sepencarian, direct contribution, equal share, matrimonial property
sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Dato' Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah menganugerahkan isteri 50% daripada harta sepencarian, mengiktiraf sumbangan kewangan langsung dan sumbangan tidak langsung yang signifikan sebagai suri rumah sepanjang perkahwinan yang panjang.
