sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Appeal Court awarded the wife 50% of the harta sepencarian, recognizing both her direct financial contributions and her significant indirect contributions as homemaker over the long marriage.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Selepas perceraian, isteri menuntut bahagian sama rata harta perkahwinan bernilai beberapa juta ringgit, berhujah beliau telah membuat sumbangan kewangan langsung dan sumbangan domestik tidak langsung sepanjang perkahwinan yang panjang.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Following divorce, the wife claimed an equal share of matrimonial property worth several million ringgit, arguing she had made both direct financial contributions and indirect domestic contributions throughout the lengthy marriage.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Dato' Kadar Shah bin Tun Sulaiman v Datin Fauziah bte Haron
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada isteri berhak kepada pembahagian sama rata (50:50) harta sepencarian apabila sumbangan langsung dan tidak langsung ditetapkan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the wife is entitled to equal (50:50) division of harta sepencarian where both direct and indirect contributions are established.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (Federal Territories) Act 1984 (Act 303), s.58
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah yang signifikan menetapkan pembahagian sama rata harta sepencarian apabila isteri menunjukkan sumbangan langsung dan tidak langsung dalam perkahwinan yang panjang.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A significant Shariah appellate authority establishing equal division of harta sepencarian where the wife demonstrates both direct and indirect contributions in a long marriage.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menggunakan kes ini, sentiasa sahkan sifat dan tahap spesifik sumbangan kewangan langsung dan sumbangan domestik tidak langsung yang dibuat oleh pemohon sepanjang perkahwinan. Tumpukan pada menyatakan dengan jelas hubungan antara sumbangan-sumbangan ini dengan pemerolehan/penyelenggaraan aset perkahwinan. Petua strategik adalah untuk menekankan tempoh perkahwinan, kerana perkahwinan yang lebih panjang sering mengukuhkan hujah untuk pembahagian sama rata.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When using this case, always verify the specific nature and extent of both direct financial and indirect domestic contributions made by the claimant throughout the marriage. Focus on clearly articulating the nexus between these contributions and the acquisition/maintenance of the matrimonial assets. A strategic tip is to highlight the duration of the marriage, as longer marriages often strengthen arguments for equal division.

sya_case_laws.tags: legislative power, Islamic law, federal-state division, Schedule 9
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung mengkaji skop kuasa perundangan negeri ke atas undang-undang Islam di bawah Jadual Kesembilan.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court examined the scope of state legislative power over Islamic law under the Ninth Schedule. While states have jurisdiction over Islamic personal and family law, this does not create immunity from federal criminal law for state officers.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pegawai penguatkuasa agama negeri Kelantan didakwa di bawah undang-undang persekutuan kerana pemenjaraan salah. Mereka mencabar pemakaian undang-undang persekutuan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Kelantan state religious enforcement officers were prosecuted under a federal law for wrongful confinement. They challenged the federal law's application, arguing that enforcement of Islamic law falls under state authority.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Mamat bin Daud v Government of Malaysia
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Pembahagian kuasa perundangan antara pihak berkuasa persekutuan dan negeri berkenaan undang-undang Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The division of legislative power between federal and state authorities in respect of Islamic law. Whether federal criminal law applies to state religious enforcement officers acting under state Islamic law.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Ninth Schedule, State List, Item 1
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti penting mengenai pembahagian kuasa persekutuan-negeri berkenaan undang-undang Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: An important authority on the federal-state division of powers regarding Islamic law and the limits of state authority over Islamic law enforcement.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila memetik Mamat bin Daud, sentiasa bezakan antara kuasa negeri untuk menggubal undang-undang Islam dan penguatkuasaan undang-undang tersebut, terutamanya apabila undang-undang jenayah persekutuan terlibat. Sahkan sama ada tindakan pegawai itu benar-benar dalam bidang kuasa Syariah mereka, atau jika mereka melangkaui bidang yang dikhaskan secara eksklusif untuk perundangan persekutuan. Pendekatan strategik adalah dengan secara serentak menghujahkan pembahagian kuasa dan fakta-fakta khusus yang menunjukkan sama ada pegawai itu bertindak ultra vires kuasa yang diberikan oleh negeri atau hanya melakukan kesalahan di bawah undang-undang persekutuan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When citing Mamat bin Daud, always distinguish between the state's power to enact Islamic law and the enforcement of that law, particularly when federal criminal law is involved. Verify if the officer's actions were truly within their Shariah remit, or if they transgressed into areas exclusively reserved for federal legislation. A strategic approach is to concurrently argue both the division of powers and the specific facts demonstrating whether the officer acted ultra vires their state-granted authority or merely committed an offence under federal law.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah membezakan kontrak perbankan Islam daripada perbankan konvensional. Mengaplikasikan prinsip kewangan Islam dalam menentukan hak dan kewajipan pihak-pihak.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Court distinguished Islamic banking contracts from conventional banking. Applied Islamic finance principles in determining the rights and obligations of the parties.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Bank Islam memohon untuk mendapatkan semula jumlah tertunggak di bawah kemudahan pembiayaan Islam. Defendan mencabar pemakaian prinsip perbankan konvensional kepada kontrak Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Bank Islam sought to recover outstanding amounts under an Islamic financing facility. The defendant challenged the application of conventional banking principles to Islamic contracts.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Bank Islam Malaysia Bhd v Adnan bin Omar
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada prinsip perbankan konvensional terpakai kepada kontrak perbankan Islam. Sifat pengaturan pembiayaan Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether conventional banking principles apply to Islamic banking contracts. The nature of Islamic financing arrangements.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Financial Services Act 2013
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes penting awal yang menetapkan sifat tersendiri kontrak perbankan Islam dalam undang-undang Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Early important case establishing the distinct nature of Islamic banking contracts in Malaysian law.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan pertikaian pembiayaan Islam, sentiasa mulakan dengan membezakan kontrak tersebut daripada perjanjian perbankan konvensional. Sahkan prinsip kewangan Islam khusus yang terpakai untuk kemudahan tersebut, kerana ini akan menentukan hak dan kewajipan pihak-pihak. Petua strategik utama ialah menekankan sifat kontrak yang berbeza dari awal, menonjolkan bagaimana duluan ini mewajibkan analisis undang-undang yang berbeza.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with Islamic financing disputes, always start by distinguishing the contract from conventional banking agreements. Verify the specific Islamic finance principles applicable to the facility, as these will dictate the parties' rights and obligations. A key strategic tip is to emphasize the distinct nature of the contract from the outset, highlighting how this precedent mandates a different legal analysis.

sya_case_laws.tags: hadhanah, custody, remarriage, children welfare, Jurnal Hukum
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah memutuskan bahawa perkahwinan semula tidak secara automatik membatalkan kelayakan hadhanah ibu. Pertimbangan utama adalah kebajikan anak-anak (maslahah). Mahkamah membenarkan ibu mengekalkan hak penjagaan, mempertimbangkan umur anak-anak, hasrat mereka, dan kestabilan susunan sedia ada.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court held that remarriage does not automatically disqualify the mother from hadhanah. The paramount consideration is the welfare of the children (maslahah). The court allowed the mother to retain custody, considering the children's ages, their expressed wishes, and the stability of the existing arrangement.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian hadhanah di mana ibu berkahwin semula dan bapa memohon untuk memindahkan hak penjagaan kepada dirinya. Ibu berhujah perkahwinan semulanya tidak secara automatik membatalkan kelayakannya untuk hak penjagaan. Anak-anak (berumur 5 dan 7) menyatakan keutamaan untuk kekal bersama ibu mereka.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A hadhanah (custody) dispute where the mother remarried and the father applied to transfer custody to himself. The mother argued her remarriage did not automatically disqualify her from custody. The children (aged 5 and 7) expressed preference to remain with their mother.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Zakaria bin Othman v Norsiah binti Abdullah
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada perkahwinan semula ibu secara automatik membatalkan kelayakan hadhanah. Berat yang perlu diberikan kepada keutamaan anak-anak.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether mother's remarriage automatically disqualifies her from hadhanah. Weight to be given to children's preference.
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti Jurnal Hukum yang signifikan bahawa perkahwinan semula ibu bukan halangan automatik kepada hadhanah. Kebajikan anak-anak adalah pertimbangan utama.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Significant Jurnal Hukum authority that mother's remarriage is not an automatic bar to hadhanah. Welfare of children is the paramount consideration.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan pertikaian hadhanah di mana seorang ibu telah berkahwin semula, sentiasa berhujah bahawa perkahwinan semula bukan pembatal kelayakan secara automatik, merujuk Zakaria bin Othman. Utamakan bukti yang menunjukkan kebajikan kanak-kanak (maslahah) jika mereka kekal bersama ibu, terutamanya jika kanak-kanak cukup umur untuk menyatakan pilihan. Secara praktikal, bersedia untuk membentangkan bukti kestabilan aturan semasa dan mengapa ia memberi manfaat kepada kanak-kanak. Pengamal muda mungkin terlepas pandang bahawa kehendak kanak-kanak yang dinyatakan, walaupun pada usia muda, boleh mempengaruhi keputusan mahkamah dengan ketara, jadi pastikan ini pada peringkat awal.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a hadhanah dispute where a mother has remarried, always argue that remarriage is not an automatic disqualifier, referencing Zakaria bin Othman. Prioritise evidence demonstrating the child's welfare (maslahah) if they remain with the mother, especially if the children are old enough to express a preference. Practically, prepare to present evidence of the stability of the current arrangement and why it benefits the child. A junior practitioner might miss that the children's expressed wishes, even at young ages, can significantly sway the court's decision, so ascertain this early.

sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Dato' Mohd Na'im bin Mokhtar CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah memutuskan bahawa nusyuz mesti dinilai secara kontekstual. Isteri yang meninggalkan rumah perkahwinan kerana salah laku suami tidak secara automatik nusyuz.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Court of Appeal held that nusyuz must be assessed contextually. A wife who leaves the matrimonial home due to the husband's misconduct (abuse, abandonment) is not automatically nusyuz. The wife's departure must be without reasonable cause to constitute nusyuz.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Suami memohon pengisytiharan bahawa isteri nusyuz (derhaka) untuk membebaskan dirinya daripada kewajipan nafkah.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The husband sought a declaration that the wife was nusyuz (disobedient/recalcitrant) to relieve himself of maintenance obligations. The wife had left the matrimonial home and refused to return, citing the husband's conduct.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Azmi bin Mohamad Azam Shah v Azlinah binti Abdul Majid
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Definisi dan skop nusyuz (keingkaran isteri) dalam konteks moden.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The definition and scope of nusyuz (wifely disobedience) in modern context. Whether leaving the matrimonial home constitutes nusyuz if justified by the husband's misconduct.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (State of Selangor) Enactment 2003, s.59-66
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah yang progresif mengenai konsep nusyuz.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A progressive Shariah appellate authority on the concept of nusyuz, moving away from a rigid interpretation and recognizing that a wife's departure from the matrimonial home may be justified.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila membuat dakwaan nusyuz, perincikan tindakan spesifik isteri dan pastikan tiada sebab yang munasabah, seperti penderaan atau pengabaian, kerana mahkamah akan meneliti konteks dan bukan sekadar tindakan meninggalkan rumah. Untuk pembelaan, sentiasa siasat dan hujah sebarang salah laku suami yang mendorong isteri pergi. Pengamal undang-undang muda harus ingat bahawa membuktikan isteri meninggalkan rumah sahaja tidak mencukupi; justifikasi adalah penting.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When alleging nusyuz, meticulously detail the wife's specific actions and ensure no justifiable cause, like abuse or abandonment, is present, as the court will scrutinize the context rather than just the act of leaving home. For the defense, always investigate and plead any misconduct by the husband that prompted the wife's departure. Junior practitioners should note that simply proving the wife left the matrimonial home is insufficient; justification is key.

sya_case_laws.tags: fasakh, cruelty, maintenance failure, divorce grounds
sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah mengekalkan fasakh, memutuskan bahawa isteri telah membuktikan, atas imbangan kebarangkalian, bahawa kekejaman berterusan suami dan kegagalan memberi nafkah merupakan alasan sah untuk pembubaran kehakiman.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Court of Appeal upheld the fasakh, ruling that the wife had proved, on the balance of probabilities, that the husband's sustained cruelty and failure to maintain constituted valid grounds for judicial dissolution.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri memohon fasakh (pembubaran kehakiman) atas alasan kekejaman suami, kegagalan berulang memberi nafkah, dan salah laku perkahwinan lain sepanjang beberapa tahun perkahwinan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The wife applied for fasakh (judicial dissolution) on grounds of the husband's cruelty, habitual failure to provide maintenance, and other matrimonial misconduct over several years of marriage.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Wan Kanuriah binti Wan Abdul Malek v Wan Ahmad Faisal bin Wan Ibrahim
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Alasan dan keperluan keterangan untuk fasakh di bawah seksyen 52 enakmen.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The grounds and evidentiary requirements for fasakh under section 52 of the enactment. Whether cumulative matrimonial misconduct justifies fasakh.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (State of Kelantan) Enactment 2002, s.52
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah penting mengenai ambang keterangan untuk fasakh.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: An important Shariah appellate authority on the evidentiary threshold for fasakh, particularly regarding sustained cruelty and maintenance failure as grounds for judicial dissolution.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila bergantung pada kes ini untuk fasakh, pastikan alasan anak guam anda sejajar secara khusus dengan kekejaman berterusan atau kegagalan nafkah berulang, kerana ini adalah elemen utama yang dibuktikan di sini. Sahkan bahawa semua keperluan keterangan untuk salah laku perkahwinan kumulatif, seperti yang dibincangkan, dipenuhi dengan teliti untuk menunjukkan imbangan kebarangkalian. Petua strategik adalah untuk menyatakan dengan jelas bagaimana kesan kumulatif salah laku, dan bukannya insiden terpencil, membentuk alasan untuk fasakh.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When relying on this case for fasakh, ensure your client's grounds align specifically with sustained cruelty or habitual failure to maintain, as these were the key proven elements here. Verify that all evidentiary requirements for cumulative matrimonial misconduct, as discussed, are meticulously met to demonstrate the balance of probabilities. A strategic tip is to clearly articulate how the cumulative effect of misconduct, rather than isolated incidents, establishes the grounds for fasakh.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan memutuskan bahawa perkara pewarisan Islam termasuk dalam bidang kuasa eksklusif mahkamah Syariah di bawah Perkara 121(1A). Mahkamah sivil tidak sepatutnya menjalankan bidang kuasa.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Federal Court held that matters of Islamic inheritance fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Shariah court under Article 121(1A). The civil court should not exercise jurisdiction.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian mengenai harta pusaka seorang Muslim yang meninggal dunia melibatkan penuntut Islam dan bukan Islam. Isu adalah sama ada mahkamah sivil atau mahkamah Syariah mempunyai bidang kuasa.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Dispute over the estate of a deceased Muslim involving both Muslim and non-Muslim claimants. The issue was whether the civil court or the Shariah court had jurisdiction.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Latifah Mat Zin v Rosmawati Sharibun
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas perkara pewarisan Islam di bawah Perkara 121(1A).
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the civil court has jurisdiction over Islamic inheritance matters under Article 121(1A).
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution Article 121(1A)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Mengukuhkan eksklusiviti mahkamah Syariah ke atas perkara penggantian Islam. Preseden penting untuk pertikaian harta pusaka yang melibatkan harta pusaka Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Reinforced Shariah court exclusivity over Islamic succession matters. Important precedent for estate disputes involving Muslim estates.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila kes melibatkan harta pusaka seorang Muslim, sentiasa pastikan di peringkat awal sama ada penuntut bukan Islam terlibat. Jika ya, pohon kepada Mahkamah Syariah seperti dalam Latifah Mat Zin v Rosmawati Sharibun [2007] 5 MLJ 101 untuk menentukan bidang kuasa, kerana mahkamah sivil menolak bidang kuasa dalam hal pusaka Islam. Jangan mulakan prosiding di mahkamah sivil untuk perkara sedemikian kerana ia akan dibatalkan. Petua strategik adalah untuk menasihati anak guam mengenai forum yang mungkin dari awal, menguruskan jangkaan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When a case involves a Muslim estate, always ascertain early if non-Muslim claimants are involved. If so, apply to the Shariah Court as per Latifah Mat Zin v Rosmawati Sharibun [2007] 5 MLJ 101 to establish jurisdiction, as civil courts defer on Islamic inheritance. Do not commence proceedings in civil court for such matters as it will be struck out. A strategic tip is to advise clients on the likely forum from the outset, managing expectations.

sya_case_laws.tags: faraid, distribution, residuary heirs, asabah, dhawil-furud
sya_case_laws.judge: YA Dato' Mohd Asri bin Abdullah
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah menetapkan metodologi terperinci untuk mengira bahagian faraid, termasuk penggunaan prinsip radd dan awl.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah High Court set out a detailed methodology for calculating faraid shares, including the application of radd and awl principles. Provided a comprehensive guide to faraid calculation that has become a reference for practitioners.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Permohonan sijil faraid untuk pengagihan harta pusaka Islam. Kes ini melibatkan pengiraan kompleks bahagian faraid yang membabitkan pelbagai kategori waris (dhawil-furud dan asabah).
sya_case_laws.facts_en: An application for a faraid certificate for the distribution of a Muslim estate. The case involved complex calculation of faraid shares involving multiple categories of heirs (dhawil-furud and asabah).
sya_case_laws.case_name: Isa Abdul Rahman v Majlis Agama Islam Selangor
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Kaedah yang betul untuk mengira bahagian faraid apabila pelbagai kelas waris bersaing.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The correct method of calculating faraid shares when multiple classes of heirs compete. Application of radd (return) and awl (proportional reduction) principles.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Administration of the Religion of Islam (State of Selangor) Enactment 2003
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti mahkamah Syariah yang penting menyediakan panduan terperinci mengenai pengiraan faraid yang kompleks.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: An important Shariah court authority providing detailed guidance on complex faraid calculations. Widely cited by practitioners in faraid applications.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan pengiraan faraid yang kompleks dengan pelbagai kategori waris, sentiasa rujuk silang metodologi terperinci yang dinyatakan dalam kes ini. Beri perhatian khusus kepada aplikasi prinsip radd dan awl, kerana salah aplikasi adalah perangkap biasa yang membawa kepada pengagihan yang salah. Secara strategik, kes ini boleh menjadi rujukan utama dalam hujahan anda untuk menunjukkan pemahaman menyeluruh tentang pengiraan faraid. Sahkan bahawa semua hubungan waris dan hak masing-masing dikenal pasti dengan tepat sebelum mengaplikasikan prinsip-prinsip dari duluan ini.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling complex faraid calculations with multiple heir categories, always cross-reference the detailed methodology set out in this case. Pay close attention to the application of radd and awl principles, as misapplication is a common pitfall leading to incorrect distributions. Strategically, this case can serve as a primary reference point in your submissions to demonstrate a thorough understanding of faraid computation. Verify that all heir relationships and their respective entitlements are accurately identified before applying the principles from this precedent.

sya_case_laws.tags: hadhanah, welfare of child, mumayyiz, child's preference
sya_case_laws.judge: YA Dato' Mohd Na'im bin Mokhtar
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah memutuskan bahawa bagi anak mumayyiz, pilihan anak adalah faktor penting tetapi bukan menentukan. Pertimbangan utama adalah kebajikan (maslahah) anak.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah High Court held that for a mumayyiz child, the child's preference is an important but not determinative factor. The paramount consideration is the welfare (maslahah) of the child, assessed holistically including the child's spiritual, educational, emotional, and physical well-being.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian hak penjagaan yang melibatkan anak mumayyiz (boleh membezakan). Mahkamah perlu menentukan ibu bapa mana yang sepatutnya mendapat hak penjagaan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A custody dispute involving a mumayyiz (discerning) child. The court had to determine which parent should have custody, considering the child's expressed preference and overall welfare.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Norizam binti Mohd Lazim v Halim bin Mohd Noor
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Penggunaan prinsip hadhanah kepada anak mumayyiz. Berat pilihan anak mumayyiz. Pertimbangan utama kebajikan anak.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Application of the hadhanah principles to a mumayyiz child. The weight of a mumayyiz child's preference. The paramount consideration of the child's welfare.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (State of Selangor) Enactment 2003, s.82-87
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti mahkamah Syariah penting mengenai pendekatan berasaskan kebajikan terhadap hadhanah bagi anak mumayyiz.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important Shariah court authority on the welfare-based approach to hadhanah for mumayyiz children, balancing the child's preference with overall welfare considerations.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan kes hadhanah melibatkan anak mumayyiz, sentiasa dapatkan pilihan anak pada peringkat awal, tetapi ingat ia bukan penentu tunggal. Nilaikan secara kritikal semua aspek maslahah kanak-kanak – rohani, pendidikan, emosi, dan fizikal – kerana mahkamah akan mengutamakan pandangan holistik ini. Pastikan hujahan anda merangkumi aspek-aspek kebajikan ini secara menyeluruh, memberikan bukti konkrit untuk setiap perkara, melangkaui hanya kehendak anak. Petua strategik adalah untuk menyediakan bukti secara proaktif yang menunjukkan bagaimana cadangan anak guam anda paling baik memenuhi maslahah jangka panjang anak merentasi semua domain ini, menjangkakan penelitian kehakiman melebihi pilihan semata-mata.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling child custody cases involving a mumayyiz child, always ascertain their preference early, but remember it is not the sole determinant. Critically assess all aspects of the child's welfare (maslahah) – spiritual, educational, emotional, and physical – as the court will prioritise this holistic view. Ensure your submissions comprehensively address these welfare aspects, providing concrete evidence for each point, beyond just the child's wishes. A strategic tip is to proactively prepare evidence demonstrating how your client's proposal best serves the child's long-term welfare across all these domains, anticipating judicial scrutiny beyond mere preference.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan (2-1) memutuskan bahawa murtad daripada Islam adalah dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah. Pemohon mesti mendapatkan pengesahan mahkamah Syariah sebelum JPN boleh menukar status agama.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Federal Court (2-1) held that apostasy from Islam is within Shariah court jurisdiction. The applicant must obtain Shariah court certification before the NRD can change the religious status.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang wanita Melayu yang memeluk agama Kristian memohon untuk membuang 'Islam' daripada kad pengenalannya. Jabatan Pendaftaran Negara enggan tanpa perintah mahkamah Syariah mengesahkan murtadnya.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Malay woman who converted to Christianity sought to have 'Islam' removed from her identity card. The National Registration Department refused without a Shariah court order confirming her apostasy.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Lina Joy v Majlis Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada seorang Muslim boleh meninggalkan Islam secara unilateral tanpa penentuan mahkamah Syariah. Sama ada Perkara 11 (kebebasan beragama) terpakai.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether a Muslim can unilaterally renounce Islam without Shariah court determination. Whether Article 11 (freedom of religion) applies.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution Articles 11, 121(1A)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes paling penting mengenai murtad di Malaysia. Menetapkan bahawa meninggalkan Islam memerlukan proses mahkamah Syariah. Kontroversi kerana implikasi terhadap kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Most significant case on apostasy in Malaysia. Established that renouncing Islam requires Shariah court process. Controversial due to implications for religious freedom.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila pelanggan ingin menukar status agama mereka daripada Islam, maklumkan bahawa Jabatan Pendaftaran Negara akan memerlukan perintah Mahkamah Syariah. Langkah utama anda adalah untuk memulakan prosiding di Mahkamah Syariah bagi pengisytiharan murtad. Bersedia untuk prosiding yang berpotensi panjang dan rumit, kerana bidang kuasa Mahkamah Syariah ke atas penolakan Islam adalah disahkan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When a client seeks to change their religious status from Islam, advise them that the National Registration Department will require a Shariah Court order. Your primary step is to initiate proceedings in the Shariah Court for a declaration of apostasy. Be prepared for potentially lengthy and complex proceedings, as the Shariah Court's jurisdiction over renunciation of Islam is affirmed.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan memutuskan bahawa mahkamah sivil mengekalkan bidang kuasa ke atas pembubaran perkahwinan sivil yang didaftarkan di bawah LRA 1976.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Federal Court held that the civil court retains jurisdiction over the dissolution of a civil marriage registered under the LRA 1976. The non-converting spouse's rights must be protected by the civil court. However, the converting spouse may also seek relief from the Shariah court.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang isteri Hindu cuba menghalang suaminya yang telah memeluk Islam daripada meneruskan prosiding perceraian dan hak penjagaan di mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Hindu wife sought to restrain her husband, who had converted to Islam, from proceeding with divorce and custody proceedings in the Shariah court. The civil marriage was registered under the Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Subashini Rajasingam v Saravanan Thangathoray
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada pasangan yang memeluk Islam boleh membubarkan perkahwinan sivil melalui mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether a spouse who converts to Islam can dissolve a civil marriage through the Shariah court. Jurisdictional conflict between civil and Shariah courts over custody and maintenance.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 121(1A); Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti utama mengenai hubungan bidang kuasa sivil-Syariah apabila seorang pasangan dalam perkahwinan sivil memeluk Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key authority on the civil-Shariah jurisdictional nexus when one spouse in a civil marriage converts to Islam. Addresses the protection of non-Muslim spouse's rights.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan perceraian yang melibatkan mualaf, segera semak jenis pendaftaran perkahwinan dan status pasangan bukan mualaf untuk menentukan bidang kuasa mahkamah awal. Bersedia untuk prosiding serentak di Mahkamah Sivil dan Syariah, kerana pasangan mualaf mungkin masih akan mendapatkan remedi Syariah. Utamakan mendapatkan perintah interim dari Mahkamah Sivil untuk melindungi hak pasangan bukan mualaf mengenai aset perkahwinan dan anak-anak. Petua strategik adalah untuk mempertimbangkan memfailkan injunksi larangan di Mahkamah Sivil bagi menghalang prosiding Mahkamah Syariah daripada menjejaskan hak sivil pasangan bukan mualaf yang telah ditetapkan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When faced with a divorce involving a convert, immediately check the marriage registration type and the non-converting spouse's status to determine initial court jurisdiction. Be prepared for concurrent proceedings in both civil and Shariah courts, as the converting spouse may still pursue Shariah remedies. Prioritise securing interim orders from the civil court to protect the non-converting spouse's rights regarding matrimonial assets and children. A strategic tip is to consider filing a prohibitory injunction in the civil court to restrain Shariah court proceedings from affecting the non-converting spouse's established civil rights.

sya_case_laws.tags: conversion, habeas corpus, custody, constitutional rights
sya_case_laws.judge: Balia Yusof Wahi, Hamid Sultan Abu Backer, Badariah Sahamid JJCA
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan memutuskan memihak kepada ibu, memutuskan bahawa perintah hak penjagaan mahkamah sivil terpakai kerana mahkamah Syariah tidak mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas pihak bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Court of Appeal ruled in favour of the mother, holding that the civil court custody order prevails as the Shariah court had no jurisdiction over a non-Muslim party. Ordered the return of the child to the mother.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Ibu memohon habeas corpus untuk pengembalian anak bongsu yang dibawa oleh bapa yang telah memeluk Islam. Bapa telah mendapat hak penjagaan dari mahkamah Syariah manakala ibu telah mendapat dari mahkamah sivil.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The mother sought habeas corpus for the return of her youngest child taken by the father who had converted to Islam. The father had obtained custody from the Shariah court while the mother had obtained custody from the civil court.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Pathmanathan a/l Krishnan v Indira Gandhi a/p Mutho
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Perintah mahkamah mana yang terpakai — perintah hak penjagaan mahkamah Syariah atau mahkamah sivil.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Which court order prevails — the Shariah court custody order or the civil court custody order. Whether habeas corpus lies for the return of a child.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Articles 5, 8, 12
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan penting mengenai hak penjagaan anak dalam kes penukaran agama, sebelum keputusan penting Mahkamah Persekutuan dalam Indira Gandhi.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important intermediate appellate authority on child custody in conversion cases, preceding the Federal Court's landmark decision in Indira Gandhi.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan perintah hak penjagaan yang bercanggah dari Mahkamah Syariah dan Mahkamah Sivil yang melibatkan pihak bukan Muslim, utamakan bidang kuasa Mahkamah Sivil. Sentiasa sahkan status undang-undang terkini keputusan Mahkamah Rayuan Pathmanathan v Indira Gandhi a/p Mutho, kerana keputusan mahkamah yang lebih tinggi mungkin telah mengatasi penemuannya mengenai perkara-perkara tertentu. Langkah praktikal adalah untuk segera menilai status bukan Muslim mana-mana pihak untuk menentukan potensi cabaran bidang kuasa. Petua strategik utama adalah untuk secara proaktif memohon perintah pengisytiharan dari mahkamah sivil mengenai bidang kuasa dalam pertikaian keluarga agama campuran, terutamanya yang melibatkan bukan Muslim, untuk mengelakkan komplikasi penguatkuasaan kemudian.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When faced with conflicting custody orders from Shariah and Civil Courts involving a non-Muslim party, prioritize the Civil Court's jurisdiction. Always verify the current legal status of the Pathmanathan v Indira Gandhi a/p Mutho Court of Appeal decision, as higher court rulings might have superseded its findings on specific points. A practical step is to immediately assess the non-Muslim status of any party to determine potential jurisdictional challenges. A key strategic tip is to proactively seek declaratory orders from the civil court regarding jurisdiction in mixed-religion family disputes, especially concerning non-Muslims, to avoid later enforcement complications.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan memutuskan bahawa perkara murtad terletak dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah dan mahkamah sivil tidak mempunyai bidang kuasa.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Federal Court held that matters of apostasy fall within the jurisdiction of the Shariah court and the civil courts have no jurisdiction. Article 121(1A) ousts civil court jurisdiction over matters within Shariah court competence.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang Sikh yang telah memeluk Islam dan kemudian ingin kembali kepada Sikhisme memohon kepada mahkamah sivil untuk pengisytiharan bahawa beliau bukan lagi seorang Muslim.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Sikh who had converted to Islam and then wished to return to Sikhism applied to the civil court for a declaration that he was no longer a Muslim. PERKIM, through which he had converted, opposed the application.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Soon Singh a/l Bikar Singh v Pertubuhan Kebajikan Islam Malaysia (PERKIM)
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa untuk mendengar dan menentukan perkara berkaitan murtad dari Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the civil court has jurisdiction to hear and determine matters relating to apostasy from Islam.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 121(1A)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti Mahkamah Persekutuan terawal yang menetapkan bahawa perkara murtad terletak secara eksklusif dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The earliest Federal Court authority establishing that apostasy matters fall exclusively within Shariah court jurisdiction. Preceded and influenced the Lina Joy decision.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan kes murtad, sentiasa sahkan bidang kuasa awal, kerana duluan Mahkamah Persekutuan ini mengesahkan Mahkamah Syariah secara eksklusif menguruskan perkara tersebut. Pastikan anak guam anda memahami implikasi prosedur Perkara 121(1A) dan bersedia untuk berhujah menentang sebarang cabaran mahkamah sivil terhadap bidang kuasa Syariah. Petua strategik utama adalah untuk secara proaktif menetapkan kecekapan Mahkamah Syariah pada peringkat awal dalam sebarang prosiding bagi mengelakkan kelewatan dan pertikaian bidang kuasa.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling apostasy cases, always verify initial jurisdiction, as this Federal Court precedent confirms Shariah Courts exclusively handle such matters. Ensure your client understands the procedural implications of Article 121(1A) and prepare to argue against any civil court challenges to Shariah jurisdiction. A key strategic tip is to proactively establish the Shariah Court's competence early in any proceedings to prevent delays and jurisdictional disputes.

sya_case_laws.tags: detention, ISA, propagation, conversion to Christianity, freedom of religion
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa walaupun undang-undang negeri boleh menyekat penyebaran agama bukan Islam kepada orang Islam, kerajaan persekutuan tidak boleh menggunakan ISA untuk menahan seseorang kerana menjalankan kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court held that while state law may restrict propagation of non-Islamic religions to Muslims, the federal government cannot use the ISA to detain a person for exercising religious freedom. The detention was unlawful.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang Melayu Islam yang ditahan di bawah Akta Keselamatan Dalam Negeri 1960 kerana cuba menukar agama orang Melayu kepada Kristian mencabar penahanannya sebagai tidak berperlembagaan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Malay Muslim detained under the Internal Security Act 1960 for attempting to convert Malays to Christianity challenged his detention as unconstitutional, arguing it violated his freedom of religion under Article 11.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Jamaluddin bin Othman v Menteri Hal Ehwal Dalam Negeri
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada penahanan di bawah ISA wajar bagi penyebaran agama bukan Islam kepada orang Islam.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether detention under the ISA is justified for propagation of non-Islamic religion to Muslims. Whether freedom of religion includes the right to propagate religion to Muslims.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Articles 11, 149; Internal Security Act 1960
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti utama mengenai had kuasa negara untuk menyekat kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Key authority on the limits of state power to restrict religious freedom and the distinction between state law powers to control propagation versus federal detention powers.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan kes kebebasan beragama, terutamanya yang menyentuh isu penyebaran, sentiasa semak terlebih dahulu sama ada cabaran itu terhadap sekatan undang-undang negeri atau kuasa penahanan persekutuan, kerana ujian undang-undang dan remedi yang tersedia berbeza dengan ketara. Perhatikan perbezaan antara kuasa negeri untuk mengawal penyebaran dan kuasa penahanan persekutuan di bawah statut seperti ISA. Petua strategik adalah untuk meneliti instrumen perundangan khusus yang digunakan untuk sekatan; kuasa penahanan persekutuan mempunyai tahap justifikasi yang lebih tinggi dalam konteks kebebasan beragama.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When faced with religious freedom cases, specifically those touching on propagation, always first verify whether the challenge is against state law restrictions or federal detention powers, as the legal tests and available remedies differ significantly. Note the distinction between state powers to control propagation and federal detention powers under statutes like the ISA. A strategic tip is to scrutinise the specific legislative instrument used for restriction; federal detention powers have a higher bar for justification in religious freedom contexts.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan memutuskan bahawa mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas perkara hadhanah apabila satu pihak bukan Islam, kerana pihak bukan Islam tidak boleh tertakluk kepada bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Court of Appeal held that the civil court has jurisdiction over custody matters when one party is a non-Muslim, as the non-Muslim party cannot be subject to Shariah court jurisdiction.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian hadhanah antara ibu Hindu dan bapa yang telah memeluk Islam. Bapa mendapat hak penjagaan dari mahkamah Syariah, ibu dari mahkamah sivil. Perintah bertentangan dari dua sistem mahkamah.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Custody dispute between a Hindu mother and a father who had converted to Islam. Father obtained custody from Shariah court, mother from civil court. Conflicting orders from two court systems.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Viran a/l Nagapan v Deepa a/p Subramaniam
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Mahkamah mana mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas hadhanah apabila seorang ibu bapa Islam dan seorang bukan Islam? Bagaimana menyelesaikan perintah yang bertentangan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Which court has jurisdiction over custody when one parent is Muslim and one is non-Muslim? How to resolve conflicting orders.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution Article 121(1A)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes penting mengenai konflik bidang kuasa dalam perkara hadhanah melibatkan pihak berlainan agama. Menyerlahkan ketidakcukupan rangka undang-undang untuk situasi sedemikian.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important case on jurisdictional conflict in custody matters involving mixed-religion parties. Highlighted the inadequacy of the legal framework for such situations.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan kes hadhanah yang melibatkan ibu bapa Muslim dan bukan Muslim, sentiasa pastikan agama kedua-dua pihak pada permulaan, kerana ini menentukan sistem mahkamah yang sesuai. Bersedia untuk potensi cabaran bidang kuasa dan perintah yang bercanggah daripada mahkamah yang berbeza, seperti yang ditekankan oleh kes ini. Secara strategik, nasihatkan anak guam tentang keperluan intervensi awal untuk mencegah prosiding mahkamah berganda dan memastikan semua permohonan difailkan di forum yang betul untuk mengelakkan litigasi yang berpanjangan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling custody cases involving a Muslim parent and a non-Muslim parent, always ascertain the religion of both parties at the outset, as this dictates the appropriate court system. Be prepared for potential jurisdictional challenges and conflicting orders from different courts, as this case highlights. Strategically, advise clients on the need for early intervention to prevent dual court proceedings and ensure all applications are filed in the correct forum to avoid protracted litigation.

sya_case_laws.tags: Islamic banking, bai' al-inah, murabahah, Shariah compliance
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan mengiktiraf kesahihan bai' al-inah sebagai mekanisme pembiayaan Islam yang diluluskan oleh MPS.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Federal Court recognized the validity of bai' al-inah as an Islamic financing mechanism approved by the SAC. Civil courts should defer to the SAC on matters of Shariah compliance.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian melibatkan kemudahan perbankan Islam (Bai' al-Inah) di mana defendan mencabar pematuhan Syariah struktur pembiayaan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A dispute involving an Islamic banking facility (Bai' al-Inah) where the defendant challenged the Shariah compliance of the financing structure. The case raised questions about the role of civil courts in determining Shariah compliance.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Bank Kerjasama Rakyat Malaysia Berhad v PSC Naval Dockyard Sdn Bhd
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada bai' al-inah (jual dan beli semula) adalah mekanisme pembiayaan Islam yang sah.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether bai' al-inah (sale and buy-back) is a valid Islamic financing mechanism. The role of the Shariah Advisory Council (SAC) in determining Shariah compliance.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Banking Act 1983; Central Bank of Malaysia Act 2009
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti Mahkamah Persekutuan penting mengenai kesahihan bai' al-inah dan penghormatan yang perlu diberikan kepada MPS.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important Federal Court authority on the validity of bai' al-inah and the deference owed to the SAC on Shariah compliance matters in Islamic finance litigation.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan kes kewangan Islam melibatkan pematuhan Syariah, sentiasa kenal pasti dahulu jika mekanisme tertentu, seperti Bai' al-Inah, telah ditangani oleh Majlis Penasihat Syariah (MPS). Sahkan pendirian terkini MPS mengenai instrumen yang dipersoalkan, kerana mahkamah sivil akur kepada kepakaran mereka. Kesilapan biasa adalah berhujah ketidakpatuhan Syariah tanpa bukti kukuh berasaskan MPS; strategi dengan menumpukan kepada keputusan MPS atau mendapatkan keputusan MPS baharu jika sesuai.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling Islamic finance cases involving Shariah compliance, always first identify if the specific mechanism, like Bai' al-Inah, has been addressed by the Shariah Advisory Council (SAC). Verify the current stance of the SAC on the instrument in question, as civil courts defer to their expertise. A common pitfall is arguing Shariah non-compliance without robust SAC-based evidence; strategize by focusing on the SAC's pronouncements or seeking a new SAC ruling if appropriate.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Harta pusaka seorang Muslim termasuk dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah untuk pembahagian menurut faraid. Mahkamah sivil boleh memberikan surat kuasa mentadbir tetapi pembahagian mesti mengikut undang-undang Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The estate of a Muslim falls under Shariah court jurisdiction for distribution according to faraid. The civil court may grant letters of administration but distribution must follow Islamic law.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pentadbir bukan Islam memohon untuk mentadbirkan harta pusaka seorang mualaf yang meninggal dunia. MAIS menuntut bidang kuasa ke atas harta pusaka Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Non-Muslim administrator sought to administer the estate of a deceased convert. MAIS claimed jurisdiction over the Islamic estate.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Majlis Agama Islam Selangor v Bong Boon Chuen
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada pentadbir bukan Islam boleh mentadbirkan harta pusaka Islam. Bidang kuasa mahkamah sivil lawan mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether a non-Muslim administrator can administer a Muslim estate. Jurisdiction of civil vs Shariah court.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Probate and Administration Act 1959, State Islamic Law Enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Menjelaskan hubungan antara bidang kuasa sivil dan Syariah dalam perkara harta pusaka melibatkan mualaf.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Clarified the interplay between civil and Shariah jurisdiction in estate matters involving converts.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan harta pusaka mualaf yang meninggal dunia, sentiasa sahkan status Muslim si mati pada waktu kematian, kerana ini menentukan undang-undang pembahagian yang terpakai. Pastikan Surat Kuasa Mentadbir, jika dikeluarkan oleh mahkamah sivil, secara jelas mengakui bahawa pembahagian mesti mematuhi prinsip undang-undang Islam, terutamanya faraid. Kesilapan biasa adalah mengabaikan keperluan untuk memohon kepada Mahkamah Syariah untuk perintah pembahagian sebenar, walaupun mahkamah sivil telah memberikan pentadbiran. Secara strategik, nasihatkan pentadbir bukan Muslim lebih awal mengenai pembahagian bidang kuasa untuk menguruskan jangkaan berkaitan pembahagian harta pusaka.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling deceased convert estates, always verify the deceased's Muslim status at the time of death, as this determines the applicable distribution law. Ensure that the Letters of Administration, if issued by a civil court, explicitly acknowledge that distribution must adhere to Islamic law principles, particularly faraid. A common pitfall is overlooking the need to apply to the Shariah Court for the actual distribution order, even if the civil court granted administration. Strategically, advise non-Muslim administrators early on about the jurisdictional split to manage expectations regarding estate distribution.

sya_case_laws.tags: harta sepencarian, indirect contribution, 1/3 ratio, matrimonial assets
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah mengiktiraf sumbangan tidak langsung isteri (pengurusan rumah tangga dan penjagaan anak) sebagai alasan yang sah untuk menuntut harta sepencarian. Mahkamah menganugerahkan isteri satu pertiga daripada harta yang diperolehi bersama, menetapkan preseden penting untuk sumbangan tidak langsung.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court recognized the wife's indirect contributions (homemaking and childcare) as valid grounds for claiming harta sepencarian. The court awarded the wife one-third of the jointly acquired property, establishing an important precedent for indirect contributions.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Selepas perceraian, isteri menuntut bahagian harta yang diperolehi semasa perkahwinan. Harta tersebut, terdiri daripada beberapa lot tanah dan sebuah rumah, didaftarkan atas nama suami. Isteri berhujah bahawa beliau telah menyumbang secara langsung (melalui sumbangan kewangan) dan tidak langsung (melalui pengurusan rumah tangga dan membesarkan anak-anak) kepada pemerolehan aset-aset ini sepanjang perkahwinan 20 tahun mereka.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Following a divorce, the wife claimed a share of property acquired during the marriage. The property, consisting of several parcels of land and a house, was registered in the husband's name. The wife argued that she had contributed both directly (through financial contributions) and indirectly (through managing the household and raising children) to the acquisition of these assets over their 20-year marriage.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Wan Mahammad bin Ali v Siti Aishah binti Salleh
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada isteri berhak kepada bahagian harta sepencarian berdasarkan sumbangan langsung dan tidak langsung kepada perkahwinan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the wife is entitled to a share of harta sepencarian based on both direct and indirect contributions to the marriage.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Islamic Family Law Enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Salah satu kes terawal yang mengiktiraf sumbangan tidak langsung sebagai asas tuntutan harta sepencarian. Menetapkan nisbah 1/3:2/3 untuk sumbangan tidak langsung yang masih kerap digunakan hari ini.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: One of the earliest cases recognizing indirect contributions as a basis for harta sepencarian claims. Established the 1/3:2/3 ratio for indirect contributions that is still frequently applied today.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengemukakan tuntutan harta sepencarian berdasarkan sumbangan tidak langsung, sentiasa perincikan dan kuantitikan usaha bukan kewangan isteri dengan jelas. Sahkan ambang keterangan yang terpakai untuk sumbangan tidak langsung dalam bidang kuasa anda, kerana mahkamah mungkin berbeza dalam tafsiran mereka tentang apa yang membentuk 'alasan yang sah'. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan untuk merundingkan tawaran penyelesaian awal berdasarkan nisbah 1/3 yang ditetapkan, terutamanya jika sumbangan langsung adalah minimum atau sukar dibuktikan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When presenting a harta sepencarian claim based on indirect contributions, always clearly particularize and quantify the wife's non-financial efforts. Verify the applicable evidentiary thresholds for indirect contributions in your specific jurisdiction, as courts may vary in their interpretation of what constitutes 'valid grounds'. Strategically, consider negotiating an early settlement offer based on the established 1/3 ratio, especially if direct contributions are minimal or hard to prove.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah meluluskan khuluk setelah suami akhirnya bersetuju. Menetapkan bahawa mahkamah mempunyai peranan dalam memediasi dan memudahkan prosiding khuluk, khususnya dalam menggalakkan suami yang enggan untuk mempertimbangkan kedudukan isteri.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court granted the khuluk upon the husband's eventual consent. Established that the court has a role in mediating and facilitating khuluk proceedings, particularly in encouraging reluctant husbands to consider the wife's position.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri memohon pembubaran perkahwinannya secara khuluk, menawarkan untuk memulangkan mahar sebagai pampasan. Suami pada mulanya enggan tetapi kemudian bersetuju dengan khuluk semasa prosiding mahkamah. Kes ini menetapkan panduan prosedur penting untuk permohonan khuluk di mahkamah Syariah Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The wife applied for dissolution of her marriage by khuluk, offering to return the mahr as compensation. The husband initially refused but subsequently agreed to the khuluk during court proceedings. The case established important procedural guidelines for khuluk applications in Malaysian Shariah courts.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Noor Bee binti Adam v Ahmad Sanusi bin Ismail
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Prosedur khuluk apabila suami pada mulanya enggan. Sama ada mahkamah boleh memudahkan khuluk melalui mediasi.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Procedure for khuluk when husband initially refuses. Whether the court can facilitate khuluk through mediation.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Islamic Family Law Enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti awal mengenai prosedur khuluk di Malaysia. Mengesahkan peranan fasilitatif mahkamah dalam prosiding khuluk.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Early authority on khuluk procedure in Malaysia. Confirmed the court's facilitative role in khuluk proceedings.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan permohonan khuluk di mana suami pada mulanya enggan, ingat kes ini mengesahkan peranan aktif mahkamah dalam mediasi; bersedia untuk menonjolkan kuasa mempermudah mahkamah. Sentiasa cuba mendapatkan persetujuan suami melalui rundingan, kerana mahkamah kemungkinan besar akan menggalakkan ini. Sahkan sama ada mana-mana peraturan Mahkamah Syariah tempatan telah mengemas kini atau memperhalusi garis panduan prosedur 1978 ini. Petua strategik adalah untuk membingkai pengembalian Mahr sebagai manfaat yang jelas kepada suami, menekankan kemuktamadan.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a khuluk application where the husband initially refuses, remember this case confirms the court's active role in mediation; prepare to highlight the court's facilitative power. Always attempt to secure the husband's consent through negotiation, as the court will likely encourage this. Verify if any local Shariah Court rules have updated or refined these 1978 procedural guidelines. A strategic tip is to frame the Mahr return as a clear benefit to the husband, emphasizing finality.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah mengiktiraf kesahihan wakaf dan memutuskan bahawa harta wakaf terletak hak kepada pihak berkuasa agama negeri untuk ditadbir mengikut terma wakaf.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court recognized the validity of the wakaf and held that wakaf properties vest in the state religious authority for administration in accordance with the terms of the wakaf.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian sama ada harta-harta tertentu merupakan wakaf (endowmen Islam) yang sah dan sama ada harta tersebut telah terletak hak dengan sewajarnya kepada Pesuruhjaya Hal Ehwal Agama.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A dispute over whether certain properties constituted a valid wakaf (Islamic endowment) and whether the properties had properly vested in the Commissioner of Religious Affairs (now MAIN — Majlis Agama Islam Negeri).
sya_case_laws.case_name: Commissioner of Religious Affairs Terengganu v Tengku Mariam
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Keperluan bagi wakaf yang sah di bawah undang-undang Islam. Sama ada harta wakaf secara automatik terletak hak kepada pihak berkuasa agama negeri.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Requirements for a valid wakaf under Islamic law. Whether wakaf properties automatically vest in the state religious authority.
sya_case_laws.legislation: State Administration of Islamic Law enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Salah satu autoriti terawal dan paling banyak dirujuk mengenai undang-undang wakaf di Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: One of the earliest and most cited authorities on wakaf law in Malaysia. Established fundamental principles on the vesting and administration of wakaf properties.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan pertikaian wakaf, sentiasa mulakan dengan mengesahkan sama ada wakaf itu dibentuk dengan betul dan sama ada ia diletakkan hak pada Majlis Agama Islam Negeri (MAIN). Semak dengan teliti perkataan dalam instrumen wakaf asal, kerana kes ini mengesahkan peranan pentadbiran MAIN. Kesilapan biasa ialah terlepas pandang terma khusus wakaf, yang ditekankan dalam kes ini sebagai penting untuk pentadbiran yang betul.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with wakaf disputes, always start by verifying if the wakaf was properly constituted and whether it vests in the Majlis Agama Islam Negeri (MAIN). Check the original wakaf instrument's wording carefully, as this case confirms the MAIN's administrative role. A common pitfall is overlooking the specific terms of the endowment, which this case emphasizes are crucial for proper administration.

sya_case_laws.tags: hadhanah, custody rights, remarriage, mumayyiz child
sya_case_laws.judge: YAA Sheikh Ghazali Abdul Rahman CJAS
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah memutuskan bahawa perkahwinan semula ibu dengan lelaki yang bukan mahram anak boleh mempengaruhi tetapi tidak secara automatik menamatkan hak penjagaannya.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Shariah Court of Appeal held that the mother's remarriage to a man who is not a mahram of the child may affect but does not automatically terminate her custody right. The welfare of the child (maslahah) remains paramount. A mumayyiz child's preference should be considered.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian hak penjagaan di mana bapa menuntut hak penjagaan anak mumayyiz (boleh membezakan). Ibu telah berkahwin lagi, dan bapa berhujah bahawa perkahwinan semula ibu dengan orang bukan mahram anak sepatutnya menyingkirkannya daripada hak penjagaan.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A custody dispute where the father sought custody of a mumayyiz (discerning) child. The mother had remarried, and the father argued that her remarriage to a non-mahram person of the child should disqualify her from custody.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Wan Ismail bin Wan Endut v Wan Puziah binti Wan Awang
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada perkahwinan semula ibu secara automatik menyingkirkannya daripada hadhanah. Berat yang perlu diberikan kepada pilihan anak mumayyiz.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the mother's remarriage automatically disqualifies her from hadhanah. The weight to be given to a mumayyiz child's preference.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic Family Law (State of Terengganu) Enactment, s.83-84
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti rayuan Syariah yang utama mengenai kesan perkahwinan semula ibu terhadap hak hadhanah dan pertimbangan pilihan anak mumayyiz.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A leading Shariah appellate authority on the effect of a mother's remarriage on hadhanah rights and the consideration of a mumayyiz child's preference.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan kes hadhanah yang melibatkan ibu yang berkahwin semula atau anak mumayyiz, rujuk Wan Ismail lwn Wan Puziah sebagai autoriti utama untuk menunjukkan bahawa perkahwinan semula tidak secara automatik membatalkan hak jagaan dan keutamaan anak adalah penting. Sentiasa bersedia untuk berhujah bahawa 'maslahah' (kebajikan) anak adalah yang paling utama, walaupun bertentangan dengan tafsiran tradisional. Pastikan umur anak dan keupayaan mereka untuk menyuarakan keutamaan yang tulen sebelum bergantung pada pilihan mereka; elakkan melatih anak kerana ini boleh menjejaskan kredibiliti. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada pasangan bukan mahram menimbulkan kemudaratan sebenar kepada kebajikan anak, kerana ini mengukuhkan atau melemahkan hujah perkahwinan semula.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a hadhanah case involving a remarried mother or a mumayyiz child, cite Wan Ismail v Wan Puziah as a leading authority to establish that remarriage does not automatically disqualify custody and the child's preference is critical. Always prepare to argue the 'maslahah' (welfare) of the child as paramount, even against traditional interpretations. Verify the child's age and ability to articulate a genuine preference before relying on their choice; avoid coaching the child as this can undermine credibility. Strategically, consider whether the non-mahram spouse poses any actual detriment to the child's welfare, as this strengthens or weakens the remarriage argument.

sya_case_laws.tags: faraid, Muslim estate, civil court application, pre-independence
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah menggunakan prinsip faraid untuk mengagihkan harta pusaka, mengiktiraf bahawa harta pusaka Islam di Negeri-Negeri Melayu mesti diagihkan mengikut undang-undang pewarisan Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court applied faraid principles to distribute the estate, recognizing that Muslim estates in the Malay States must be distributed according to Islamic inheritance law (faraid).
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Salah satu kes terawal yang dilaporkan mengenai penggunaan faraid (undang-undang pewarisan Islam) di Negeri-Negeri Melayu Bersekutu.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: One of the earliest reported cases on the application of faraid (Islamic inheritance law) in the Federated Malay States. A dispute over the distribution of a Muslim deceased's estate among the heirs.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Shaik Abdul Latif v Shaik Elias Bux
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Penggunaan faraid di mahkamah sivil Negeri-Negeri Melayu Bersekutu.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: The application of faraid in the civil courts of the Federated Malay States. The correct shares for different categories of heirs.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Islamic law of inheritance (faraid)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Salah satu pengiktirafan kehakiman terawal faraid sebagai undang-undang terpakai untuk pengagihan harta pusaka Islam di Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: One of the earliest judicial recognitions of faraid as the applicable law for Muslim estate distribution in Malaysia. Predates the formal codification of Islamic law in the states.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan pertikaian faraid, sentiasa sahkan undang-undang yang terpakai berdasarkan domisil si mati pada masa kematian, kerana kes awal ini mengesahkan aplikasi bersejarah prinsip faraid di mahkamah Malaysia. Utamakan mendapatkan Sijil Faraid dari Mahkamah Syariah sebelum memulakan sebarang prosiding sivil untuk mengelakkan cabaran bidang kuasa. Berhati-hati bahawa pengekodan undang-undang Islam yang berikutnya mungkin memperkenalkan keperluan prosedur atau tafsiran khusus yang tiada dalam duluan asas ini. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada duluan yang lebih lama seperti ini mengukuhkan hujah untuk aplikasi faraid yang telah lama wujud, walaupun terdapat enakmen negeri yang lebih baru.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling faraid disputes, always verify the applicable law based on the deceased's domicile at the time of death, as this early case confirms the historical application of faraid principles in Malaysian courts. Prioritize obtaining a Faraid Certificate from the Shariah Court before initiating any civil proceedings to avoid jurisdictional challenges. Be mindful that subsequent codifications of Islamic law might introduce specific procedural requirements or interpretations not present in this foundational precedent. Strategically, consider whether an older precedent like this one strengthens an argument for a long-standing application of faraid, even if more recent state enactments exist.

sya_case_laws.tags: harta sepencarian, customary law, earliest authority, property division
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah mengiktiraf adat Melayu harta sepencarian — harta yang diperolehi melalui usaha bersama suami isteri semasa perkahwinan.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The court recognized the Malay custom of harta sepencarian — property acquired by the joint efforts of husband and wife during marriage. The wife was entitled to a share of such property upon divorce.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian antara pasangan Islam yang bercerai mengenai harta yang diperolehi semasa perkahwinan. Ini adalah salah satu kes terawal yang dilaporkan menangani konsep harta sepencarian di Negeri-Negeri Melayu.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A dispute between divorced Muslim spouses over property acquired during the marriage. This is one of the earliest reported cases addressing the concept of harta sepencarian in the Malay States.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Ramah binti Ta'at v Laton binti Malim Sultan
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada undang-undang adat Melayu mengiktiraf hak isteri untuk berkongsi harta yang diperolehi bersama semasa perkahwinan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether Malay customary law recognizes a wife's right to share in property jointly acquired during marriage.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Malay customary law; Islamic family law principles
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti terawal yang dilaporkan mengenai harta sepencarian. Kes pra-kemerdekaan ini menetapkan asas undang-undang adat.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The earliest reported authority on harta sepencarian. This pre-independence case established the customary law foundation for what later became codified in state Islamic family law enactments.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila memetik kes ini, sahkan Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam negeri tertentu dan peruntukannya mengenai harta sepencarian, kerana ini sering mengkodifikasikan prinsip yang ditetapkan di sini. Perlu diingat bahawa walaupun penting, kes pra-kodifikasi ini mungkin bersifat persuasif tetapi tidak secara langsung mengikat di mahkamah Syariah kontemporari. Gunakan ini untuk menggambarkan perkembangan sejarah prinsip harta sepencarian di Malaysia. Pastikan anda menunjukkan bagaimana enakmen kemudian dibina di atas undang-undang adat asas ini.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When citing this case, verify the specific state Islamic Family Law Enactment and its provisions on harta sepencarian, as these often codify the principles established here. Note that while significant, this pre-codification case might be persuasive but not directly binding in contemporary Shariah courts. Use this to illustrate the historical development of harta sepencarian principles in Malaysia. Ensure you demonstrate how the later enactments built upon this foundational customary law.

sya_case_laws.tags: wakaf, state authority, MAIN, endowment administration
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan memutuskan bahawa MAIN, seperti yang ditubuhkan di bawah undang-undang negeri, adalah pemegang amanah tunggal semua harta wakaf di negeri tersebut.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Court of Appeal held that the MAIN, as constituted under state law, is the sole trustee of all wakaf properties in the state. Private individuals cannot claim parallel or competing authority over wakaf administration.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Pertikaian mengenai pengurusan dan pentadbiran harta wakaf. Majlis Agama Islam Negeri (MAIN) menuntut kuasa tunggal untuk mentadbir harta wakaf di negeri tersebut.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A dispute over the management and administration of wakaf property. The State Islamic Religious Council (MAIN) claimed sole authority to administer wakaf properties in the state.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Perlis Islamic Religious Council & Another v Mohd Yusoff
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada MAIN mempunyai kuasa tunggal dan eksklusif ke atas pentadbiran harta wakaf di negeri tersebut.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the MAIN has sole and exclusive authority over the administration of wakaf properties in the state.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Administration of the Religion of Islam (State of Perlis) Enactment 2006
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Mengesahkan peranan eksklusif MAIN sebagai pentadbir semua harta wakaf dalam setiap negeri.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Affirmed the exclusive role of the MAIN as the administrator of all wakaf properties within each state. Critical for understanding wakaf governance in Malaysia.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan perkara wakaf, sentiasa sahkan terlebih dahulu jika kes itu melibatkan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri (MAIN) kerana mereka mempunyai kuasa tunggal dan eksklusif ke atas pentadbiran wakaf. Duluan ini mengesahkan bahawa individu persendirian tidak boleh menuntut kuasa yang bersaing, jadi periksa sebarang percubaan untuk memintas MAIN. Secara strategik, jika mewakili pihak persendirian, tumpukan pada penghujahan sifat wakaf yang spesifik atau pelanggaran prosedur oleh MAIN, daripada mencabar kuasa keseluruhan mereka. Pastikan semua dokumentasi dengan betul mengenal pasti MAIN sebagai pemegang amanah tunggal.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When handling wakaf matters, always first verify if the case involves a State Islamic Religious Council (MAIN) as they hold sole and exclusive authority over wakaf administration. This precedent affirms that private individuals cannot claim competing authority, so check for any attempts to bypass the MAIN. Strategically, if representing a private party, focus on arguing the specific nature of the wakaf or procedural breaches by the MAIN, rather than challenging their overall authority. Ensure all documentation correctly identifies the MAIN as the sole trustee.

sya_case_laws.held_bm: Penukaran agama Islam oleh satu pihak beroperasi sebagai pembubaran perkahwinan sivil di bawah Akta Membaharui Undang-Undang (Perkahwinan dan Perceraian) 1976.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Conversion of one spouse to Islam operates as a dissolution of the civil marriage under the Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Isteri bukan Islam memohon perceraian daripada suami yang telah memeluk Islam. Isu kesan penukaran agama ke atas perkahwinan sivil.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Non-Muslim wife sought divorce from husband who had converted to Islam. Issue of the effect of conversion on a civil marriage.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Kung Lim Siew Wan v Choong Chee Kuan
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Kesan penukaran agama Islam satu pihak ke atas perkahwinan sivil. Hak pasangan yang tidak menukar agama.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Effect of one spouse's conversion to Islam on a civil marriage. Rights of the non-converting spouse.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes penting mengenai persimpangan undang-undang perkahwinan sivil dan penukaran agama Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important case on the intersection of civil marriage law and Islamic conversion.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila pasangan bukan Islam memeluk agama Islam, segera sahkan kedudukan undang-undang semasa mengenai pembubaran automatik perkahwinan sivil di bawah Akta Membaharui Undang-Undang (Perkahwinan dan Perceraian) 1976, kerana bidang undang-undang ini telah menyaksikan perkembangan ketara selepas 2003. Nasihati pasangan yang tidak memeluk agama mengenai hak-hak mereka dan jalan keluar yang berpotensi untuk bantuan, dengan menyatakan bahawa pembubaran automatik mungkin tidak digunakan atau ditafsirkan secara seragam di seluruh forum undang-undang yang berbeza. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada sebarang prosiding selari di Mahkamah Syariah mungkin memberi kesan atau terjejas oleh prosiding mahkamah sivil, dan nasihati pelanggan mengenai forum yang paling berfaedah untuk tuntutan khusus mereka.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When a non-Muslim spouse converts to Islam, immediately verify the current legal position regarding the automatic dissolution of a civil marriage under the Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976, as this area of law has seen significant developments post-2003. Advise the non-converting spouse on their rights and potential avenues for relief, noting that the automatic dissolution may not be uniformly applied or interpreted across different legal forums. Strategically, consider whether any parallel proceedings in the Shariah Court might impact or be impacted by civil court proceedings, and advise the client on the most advantageous forum for their specific claims.

sya_case_laws.tags: constitutional supremacy, basic structure, judicial power
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan menerima pakai doktrin struktur asas — ciri-ciri asas tertentu Perlembagaan tidak boleh dipinda oleh Parlimen. Kuasa kehakiman tidak boleh dialihkan daripada mahkamah.
sya_case_laws.held_en: Federal Court adopted the basic structure doctrine — certain fundamental features of the Constitution cannot be amended by Parliament. Judicial power cannot be removed from the courts.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Walaupun terutamanya kes pengambilan tanah, keputusan Mahkamah Persekutuan ini mengesahkan semula doktrin ketertinggian perlembagaan dan doktrin struktur asas.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: Although primarily a land acquisition case, this Federal Court decision reaffirmed the doctrine of constitutional supremacy and the basic structure doctrine.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Semenyih Jaya Sdn Bhd v Pentadbir Tanah Daerah Hulu Langat
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada Parlimen boleh melucutkan kuasa kehakiman mahkamah. Doktrin struktur asas Perlembagaan Persekutuan.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether Parliament can strip courts of judicial power. The basic structure doctrine of the Federal Constitution.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution Article 121
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes undang-undang perlembagaan mercu tanda yang menetapkan doktrin struktur asas di Malaysia. Berkaitan dengan skop bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Landmark constitutional law case establishing basic structure doctrine in Malaysia. Relevant to the scope of Shariah court jurisdiction.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Pertimbangkan keputusan Mahkamah Persekutuan ini apabila berhujah mengenai had kuasa perundangan ke atas mahkamah Syariah, terutamanya berkaitan kuasa kehakiman intrinsik mereka. Tekankan bahawa Parlimen tidak boleh menghapuskan kuasa kehakiman daripada mahkamah, yang merupakan aspek utama doktrin struktur asas. Pastikan hujahan anda mengaitkan prinsip perlembagaan ini dengan cabaran bidang kuasa khusus dalam perkara Syariah anda dengan jelas. Berhati-hati bahawa walaupun kes itu melibatkan pengambilan tanah, prinsip perlembagaannya terpakai secara meluas kepada semua mahkamah, termasuk mahkamah Syariah.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: Consider this Federal Court decision when arguing the limits of legislative power over Shariah courts, particularly regarding their inherent judicial power. Emphasize that Parliament cannot remove judicial power from the courts, a key aspect of the basic structure doctrine. Ensure your submissions clearly link this constitutional principle to the specific jurisdictional challenge in your Shariah matter. Be mindful that while the case involved land acquisition, its constitutional principles apply broadly to all courts, including Shariah courts.

sya_case_laws.tags: apostasy, Muslim status, death, burial rights, jurisdiction
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Agung memutuskan bahawa hanya mahkamah Syariah mempunyai bidang kuasa untuk menentukan sama ada seseorang itu seorang Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Supreme Court held that only the Shariah court has jurisdiction to determine whether a person is a Muslim. The civil court cannot make such a determination even in respect of a deceased person.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang ibu Sikh menuntut jasad anaknya yang didakwa telah memeluk Islam tetapi yang didakwanya telah kembali kepada Sikhisme sebelum kematian. Pihak berkuasa Islam berkeras tentang pengebumian secara Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Sikh mother claimed the body of her son who had allegedly converted to Islam but whom she claimed had reverted to Sikhism before death. The Islamic authorities insisted on a Muslim burial. The dispute centred on the religious status of the deceased at the time of death.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Dalip Kaur v Pegawai Polis Daerah Bukit Mertajam
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada si mati meninggal sebagai seorang Islam atau telah kembali kepada agama asalnya.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the deceased died a Muslim or had reverted to his former religion. Which court (civil or Shariah) has jurisdiction to determine the religious status of the deceased.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 121(1A); State Administration of Islamic Law enactments
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti utama mengenai penentuan status Islam untuk tujuan pengebumian.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A leading authority on the determination of Muslim status for burial purposes. Established that Shariah courts have exclusive jurisdiction over questions of whether a person died as a Muslim.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Kes ini mengesahkan bidang kuasa eksklusif Mahkamah Syariah dalam menentukan status Muslim, walaupun selepas kematian. Sentiasa sahkan status agama melalui Mahkamah Syariah terlebih dahulu, terutamanya dalam pertikaian pengebumian, untuk mengelakkan cabaran bidang kuasa mahkamah sivil. Perlu diingatkan bahawa mahkamah sivil tidak boleh membuat penentuan ini, oleh itu teruskan semua jalan dalam sistem Syariah sebelum mempertimbangkan pilihan lain.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: This case confirms Shariah courts' exclusive jurisdiction over determining Muslim status, even posthumously. Always confirm religious status through the Shariah court first, especially in burial disputes, to avoid civil court jurisdictional challenges. Be mindful that civil courts cannot make this determination, so pursue all avenues within the Shariah system before contemplating other options.
