sya_case_laws.tags: jurisdiction, Article 121(1A), Shariah court, Islamic law matter
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan memutuskan bahawa perkara yang terletak dalam bidang kuasa yang diberikan kepada mahkamah Syariah oleh undang-undang negeri berada di luar bidang kuasa mahkamah sivil.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Federal Court held that matters falling within the jurisdiction conferred on Shariah courts by state law are outside civil court jurisdiction by virtue of Article 121(1A). The civil court cannot hear matters concerning the administration of Islamic law.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Persoalan timbul sama ada mahkamah sivil boleh mendengar perkara yang melibatkan pentadbiran undang-undang Islam dan kuasa Majlis Agama Islam Negeri.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A question arose whether a civil court could hear a matter involving the administration of Islamic law and the powers of the State Islamic Religious Council (MAIPP).
sya_case_laws.case_name: Majlis Ugama Islam Pulau Pinang v Shaik Zolkaffily bin Shaik Natar
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas perkara yang melibatkan pentadbiran undang-undang Islam dan kuasa majlis agama negeri.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the civil court has jurisdiction over matters involving the administration of Islamic law and the powers of the state religious council.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 121(1A); Administration of the Religion of Islam (State of Penang) Enactment
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Autoriti Mahkamah Persekutuan yang penting mengukuhkan pembahagian bidang kuasa antara mahkamah sivil dan Syariah.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: Important Federal Court authority reinforcing the jurisdictional divide between civil and Shariah courts, particularly regarding administrative Islamic law matters.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berdepan dengan cabaran bidang kuasa berkaitan pentadbiran undang-undang Islam, sahkan terlebih dahulu sama ada perkara itu termasuk dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah negeri seperti yang ditakrifkan oleh undang-undang negeri. Preceden ini mengesahkan bahawa mahkamah sivil tidak boleh campur tangan dalam kes-kes sedemikian kerana Perkara 121(1A), jadi tumpukan usaha anda ke arah mahkamah Syariah. Perangkap biasa ialah cuba membantah bidang kuasa mahkamah sivil berdasarkan teknikaliti prosedur dan bukannya undang-undang substantif. Secara strategik, sentiasa bingkaikan hujah anda dengan menggariskan dengan jelas peruntukan undang-undang Islam atau kuasa pentadbiran khusus yang terlibat untuk menegaskan atau menafikan bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah secara mantap.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When faced with a jurisdictional challenge concerning Islamic law administration, first verify if the matter falls squarely within state Shariah court purview as defined by state law. This precedent confirms that civil courts cannot intervene in such cases due to Article 121(1A), so direct your efforts towards the Shariah court. A common pitfall is attempting to argue civil court jurisdiction based on procedural technicalities rather than substantive law. Strategically, always frame your arguments by clearly delineating the specific Islamic law provisions or administrative powers involved to robustly assert or deny Shariah court jurisdiction.

sya_case_laws.tags: unilateral conversion, death, Muslim burial, jurisdiction, constitutional rights
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Persekutuan memutuskan bahawa mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa untuk menentukan kesahihan penukaran agama apabila hak pihak bukan Islam terjejas.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Federal Court held that the civil court has jurisdiction to determine the validity of a conversion when the rights of non-Muslim parties are affected. Article 121(1A) does not oust civil court jurisdiction where non-Muslim constitutional rights are at stake.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Seorang ibu Kristian memohon pengisytiharan bahawa bekas suaminya yang meninggal tidak memeluk Islam, mencabar perintah mahkamah Syariah untuk pengebumian secara Islam.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: A Christian mother sought a declaration that her deceased ex-husband had not converted to Islam, challenging the Shariah court's order for a Muslim burial. The case revisited the scope of civil court jurisdiction in determining the religious status of a deceased person.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Majlis Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan v Victoria Jayaseele Martin & Another Appeal
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa apabila pihak bukan Islam mempertikaikan status Islam si mati.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether the civil court has jurisdiction where a non-Muslim party disputes the Muslim status of a deceased. The scope of Article 121(1A) where non-Muslim rights are affected.
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Articles 5, 8, 11, 121(1A)
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Keputusan penting Mahkamah Persekutuan yang mengubahsuai tafsiran ketat Perkara 121(1A) untuk melindungi hak perlembagaan bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: A landmark Federal Court decision modifying the strict interpretation of Article 121(1A) to protect non-Muslim constitutional rights. Represents a significant evolution in civil-Shariah jurisdictional jurisprudence.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan pertikaian bidang kuasa yang melibatkan status agama si mati dan pihak bukan Islam, sentiasa sahkan sama ada hak perlembagaan bukan Islam benar-benar terjejas, kerana ini menentukan kecekapan mahkamah sivil. Nilai secara proaktif potensi konflik antara perintah mahkamah sivil dan Syariah, terutamanya mengenai pengebumian atau pentadbiran harta pusaka. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada membentangkan kes sebagai perlindungan hak bukan Islam dan bukannya semata-mata pertikaian status agama mengukuhkan hujah untuk bidang kuasa mahkamah sivil. Pastikan semua pihak bersekutu agama dan hubungan mereka dengan si mati ditetapkan dengan jelas pada permulaan untuk mengelakkan kelewatan prosedur.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When faced with a jurisdictional dispute involving a deceased's religious status and non-Muslim parties, always verify if non-Muslim constitutional rights are genuinely affected, as this determines civil court competence. Proactively assess potential conflicts between civil and Shariah court orders, particularly concerning burial or estate administration. Strategically, consider whether presenting the case as a protection of non-Muslim rights rather than purely a religious status dispute strengthens the argument for civil court jurisdiction. Ensure all parties' religious affiliations and their relationship to the deceased are clearly established at the outset to avoid procedural delays.

sya_case_laws.tags: Allah, use of word, religious freedom, Herald newspaper, Article 11
sya_case_laws.judge: Mohd Apandi Ali, Abdul Aziz Rahim, Mohd Zawawi Salleh JJCA
sya_case_laws.held_bm: Mahkamah Rayuan mengekalkan larangan tersebut, memutuskan bahawa penggunaan perkataan 'Allah' dalam bahagian bahasa Melayu Herald boleh menyebabkan kekeliruan di kalangan orang Islam.
sya_case_laws.held_en: The Court of Appeal upheld the prohibition, holding that the use of the word 'Allah' in the Herald's Malay-language section could cause confusion among Muslims. The prohibition was a reasonable restriction under Article 11(5) to maintain public order.
sya_case_laws.facts_bm: Akhbar Catholic Herald mencabar arahan Menteri Dalam Negeri yang melarang penggunaan perkataan 'Allah' dalam bahagian bahasa Melayu penerbitan tersebut.
sya_case_laws.facts_en: The Catholic Herald newspaper challenged the Home Minister's directive prohibiting the use of the word 'Allah' in the Malay-language section of the publication. The Archbishop argued this violated the constitutional right to freedom of religion.
sya_case_laws.case_name: Titular Roman Catholic Archbishop of Kuala Lumpur v Menteri Dalam Negeri
sya_case_laws.issues_bm: Sama ada bukan Islam mempunyai hak untuk menggunakan perkataan 'Allah'. Sama ada larangan tersebut melanggar Perkara 11.
sya_case_laws.issues_en: Whether non-Muslims have the right to use the word 'Allah'. Whether the prohibition violates Article 11 (freedom of religion).
sya_case_laws.legislation: Federal Constitution, Articles 3, 11; Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984
sya_case_laws.significance_bm: Kes Malaysia yang paling terkenal mengenai penggunaan perkataan 'Allah' oleh bukan Islam.
sya_case_laws.significance_en: The most prominent Malaysian case on the use of the word 'Allah' by non-Muslims. A significant authority on the intersection of religious freedom and Islamic sensitivities.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berhadapan dengan pertikaian mengenai terminologi keagamaan, terutamanya berkaitan "Allah", sentiasa pastikan sama ada penggunaan oleh anak guam anda selaras dengan menjaga ketenteraman awam di bawah Perkara 11(5). Nasihatkan anak guam mengenai potensi kekeliruan di kalangan umat Islam, kerana ini adalah faktor utama yang dipertimbangkan mahkamah. Secara strategik, terokai terminologi alternatif atau penafian kontekstual untuk mengurangkan risiko sebelum litigasi, daripada hanya bergantung pada tuntutan kebebasan beragama. Pastikan sama ada terdapat sebarang pindaan perundangan atau keputusan mahkamah yang lebih tinggi yang mungkin mengubah aplikasi duluan ini.
sya_case_laws.practitioner_notes_en: When encountering disputes over religious terminology, especially concerning "Allah", always ascertain if your client's usage aligns with maintaining public order under Article 11(5). Advise clients on potential confusion among Muslims, as this is a key factor courts consider. Strategically, explore alternative terminology or contextual disclaimers to mitigate risks before litigation, rather than relying solely on claims of religious freedom. Verify if there are any subsequent legislative amendments or higher court decisions that might modify the application of this precedent.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Mahkamah Syariah mempunyai bidang kuasa eksklusif ke atas orang yang menganut agama Islam dalam perkara yang disenaraikan dalam Senarai Negeri (Jadual 9, Senarai II) Perlembagaan Persekutuan. Ini termasuk undang-undang diri, undang-undang keluarga, dan kesalahan jenayah Syariah. Skop ini selanjutnya ditentukan oleh Perkara 121(1A).
sya_provisions.overview_en: Shariah courts have exclusive jurisdiction over persons professing the religion of Islam in matters listed in the State List (Schedule 9, List II) of the Federal Constitution. This includes personal law, family law, and Shariah criminal offences. The scope is further defined by Article 121(1A).
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Bidang kuasa peribadi: Orang Islam sahaja. Perkara: Undang-undang diri Islam, undang-undang keluarga, harta (faraid, wasiat, hibah, wakaf), kesalahan jenayah Syariah. Wilayah: dalam sempadan negeri. Konflik dengan mahkamah sivil: Perkara 121(1A) — mahkamah sivil tiada bidang kuasa dalam perkara bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Personal jurisdiction: Muslims only. Subject matter: Islamic personal law, family law, property (faraid, wasiat, hibah, wakaf), Shariah criminal offences. Territorial: within state boundaries. Conflict with civil courts: Article 121(1A) — civil courts have no jurisdiction on matters within Shariah court jurisdiction.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Indira Gandhi [2018]; Latifah Mat Zin [2007]; Lina Joy [2007]; Semenyih Jaya [2017]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Perlembagaan Persekutuan: Perkara 121(1A), Jadual 9 Senarai II. Akta Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam 1993 (Akta 505). Akta Mahkamah Syariah (Bidang Kuasa Jenayah) 1965 (Akta 355).
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Federal Constitution: Article 121(1A), Schedule 9 List II. Administration of Islamic Law Act 1993 (Act 505). Shariah Courts (Criminal Jurisdiction) Act 1965 (Act 355).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Sentiasa sahkan bidang kuasa sebelum memfailkan. Untuk perkara silang bidang kuasa (cth., satu pihak Islam, satu bukan Islam), pertimbangkan implikasi Indira Gandhi [2018]. Failkan bantahan awal terhadap bidang kuasa awal jika dipertikaikan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Always verify jurisdiction before filing. For cross-jurisdictional matters (e.g., one party Muslim, one non-Muslim), consider the implications of Indira Gandhi [2018]. File preliminary objections to jurisdiction early if contested.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Prosiding sivil di mahkamah Syariah dimulakan melalui Saman atau Permohonan. Cara memulakan bergantung kepada sama ada perkara tersebut berbentuk pertikaian atau bukan pertikaian.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Civil proceedings in Shariah courts are commenced by way of Saman (Summons) or Permohonan (Application/Petition). The mode depends on whether the matter is contentious or non-contentious.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Saman: untuk perkara pertikaian — tuntutan cerai, nafkah, harta sepencarian. Permohonan: untuk perkara bukan pertikaian — sijil faraid, pengesahan hibah. Keperluan pemfailan: fi mahkamah, dokumen sokongan, pengesahan yang betul.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Saman (Summons): for contentious matters — divorce claims, maintenance, harta sepencarian. Permohonan (Application): for non-contentious matters — faraid certificate, confirmation of hibah. Filing requirements: court fees, supporting documents, properly attested.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Tatacara Mal Mahkamah Syariah 1998 (Akta 585): Bahagian III — Memulakan Prosiding. Borang: MS 1-5.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Shariah Court Civil Procedure Act 1998 (Act 585): Part III — Commencement of Proceedings. Forms: MS 1-5.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Pastikan cara memulakan yang betul. Failkan di mahkamah Syariah yang betul (bidang kuasa wilayah). Sediakan salinan yang mencukupi untuk penyampaian. Bayar fi mahkamah yang ditetapkan. Lantik Peguam Syarie yang berlesen di negeri berkenaan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Ensure correct mode of commencement. File at the correct Shariah court (territorial jurisdiction). Prepare sufficient copies for service. Pay prescribed court fees. Engage Peguam Syarie licensed in the relevant state.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Perbicaraan di mahkamah Syariah mengikuti prosedur yang ditetapkan untuk pendengaran keterangan, termasuk syahadah (kesaksian), iqrar (pengakuan), sumpah, dan qarinah (keterangan keadaan). Beban dan standard pembuktian berbeza daripada mahkamah sivil.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Trial in Shariah courts follows established procedures for the hearing of evidence, including syahadah (testimony), iqrar (confession/admission), sumpah (oath), and qarinah (circumstantial evidence). The burden and standard of proof differ from civil courts.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Jenis keterangan: (1) Syahadah — kesaksian saksi (2 lelaki atau 1 lelaki + 2 perempuan untuk perkara kewangan), (2) Iqrar — pengakuan, (3) Sumpah — sumpah, (4) Qarinah — keterangan keadaan (termasuk keterangan dokumen, laporan pakar, DNA). Standard pembuktian: imbangan kebarangkalian (sivil), melampaui keraguan munasabah (jenayah).
sya_provisions.principles_en: Types of evidence: (1) Syahadah — testimony of witnesses (2 male or 1 male + 2 female for financial matters), (2) Iqrar — admission/confession, (3) Sumpah — oath, (4) Qarinah — circumstantial evidence (including documentary evidence, expert reports, DNA). Standard of proof: balance of probabilities (civil), beyond reasonable doubt (criminal).
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Keterangan Mahkamah Syariah 1997 (Akta 561). Akta 585: Bahagian VII — Perbicaraan dan Pendengaran.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Shariah Court Evidence Act 1997 (Act 561). Act 585: Part VII — Trial and Hearing.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Sediakan saksi dengan baik. Fahami keperluan syahadah dalam jenis kes yang berbeza. Keterangan dokumen mesti disahkan dengan betul. Keterangan pakar (perubatan, DNA, kewangan) mesti dikemukakan melalui pakar yang berkelayakan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Prepare witnesses well. Understand the requirements for syahadah in different types of cases. Documentary evidence must be properly authenticated. Expert evidence (medical, DNA, financial) must be presented through qualified experts.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Pliding di mahkamah Syariah termasuk Penyata Tuntutan, Penyata Pembelaan, Tuntutan Balas, dan Afidavit. Dokumen-dokumen ini mesti mematuhi format yang ditetapkan.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Pleadings in Shariah courts include the Statement of Claim (Penyata Tuntutan), Statement of Defence (Penyata Pembelaan), Counterclaim (Tuntutan Balas), and Affidavits. These documents must comply with prescribed formats.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Penyata Tuntutan mesti menyatakan: fakta material, kausa tindakan, relif yang dituntut. Penyata Pembelaan: pengakuan/penafian, pembelaan afirmatif. Semua dokumen mesti diserahkan kepada pihak lawan. Had masa pemfailan mesti dipatuhi.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Statement of Claim must state: material facts, cause of action, relief sought. Statement of Defence: admissions/denials, affirmative defence. All documents must be served on the opposing party. Time limits for filing must be observed.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 585: Bahagian IV — Pliding. Borang dan Arahan Amalan mahkamah Syariah negeri masing-masing.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 585: Part IV — Pleadings. Forms and Practice Directions of the respective state Shariah courts.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Gunakan borang yang betul yang ditetapkan oleh mahkamah Syariah negeri. Pastikan afidavit ditegaskan di hadapan pesuruhjaya yang diberi kuasa. Failkan dalam had masa yang ditetapkan untuk mengelakkan pembatalan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Use the correct forms prescribed by the state Shariah court. Ensure affidavits are affirmed before an authorized commissioner. File within prescribed time limits to avoid striking out.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Permohonan interlocutory dibuat semasa prosiding untuk relif interim. Ini termasuk perintah nafkah interim, injunksi, penangguhan prosiding, dan perlantikan Peguam Syarie.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Interlocutory applications are made during the course of proceedings for interim relief. These include interim maintenance orders, injunctions, stay of proceedings, and appointment of Peguam Syarie.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Jenis: nafkah interim (s.133 Akta 303), hadhanah interim, injunksi menghalang pelupusan harta sepencarian, penangguhan prosiding, penemuan dokumen. Permohonan melalui Notis Permohonan disokong oleh Afidavit.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Types: interim maintenance (s.133 Act 303), interim custody, injunction to prevent disposal of matrimonial assets, stay of proceedings, discovery of documents. Application by way of Notis Permohonan supported by Affidavit.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 585: Bahagian V — Permohonan Interlocutory. Akta 303: s.133 (nafkah interim).
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 585: Part V — Interlocutory Applications. Act 303: s.133 (interim maintenance).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Mohon relif interim seawal mungkin untuk melindungi kepentingan klien. Permohonan ex-parte boleh dibuat dalam kes segera. Sediakan keterangan afidavit yang kukuh.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Apply for interim relief as early as possible to protect the client's interests. Ex-parte applications may be made in urgent cases. Prepare strong affidavit evidence.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Mahkamah boleh mengeluarkan pelbagai jenis penghakiman dan perintah termasuk penghakiman ingkar, penghakiman persetujuan, dan perintah penguatkuasaan. Penghinaan mahkamah Syariah adalah satu kesalahan.
sya_provisions.overview_en: The court may issue various types of judgments and orders including default judgment, consent judgment, and orders for enforcement. Contempt of Shariah court is an offence.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Jenis: penghakiman ingkar, penghakiman persetujuan, penghakiman selepas perbicaraan. Penguatkuasaan: penahanan harta, prosiding garnisi, komital kerana penghinaan. Rayuan mesti difailkan dalam had masa yang ditetapkan.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Types: default judgment (penghakiman ingkar), consent judgment (penghakiman persetujuan), judgment after trial. Enforcement: attachment of property, garnishee proceedings, committal for contempt. Appeals must be filed within prescribed time limits.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 585: Bahagian VIII — Penghakiman dan Perintah. Bahagian X — Penguatkuasaan. Bahagian IX — Rayuan.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 585: Part VIII — Judgments and Orders. Part X — Enforcement. Part IX — Appeals.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Keluarkan perintah serta-merta selepas pengumuman. Serahkan perintah kepada pihak satu lagi untuk penguatkuasaan. Pantau pematuhan. Mohon penguatkuasaan jika perintah tidak dipatuhi.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Extract the order immediately after pronouncement. Serve the order on the other party for enforcement. Monitor compliance. Apply for enforcement if the order is not complied with.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Rayuan dari Mahkamah Rendah Syariah pergi ke Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah, dan dari Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah ke Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah. Proses rayuan melibatkan pemfailan notis rayuan dalam had masa yang ditetapkan.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Appeals from the Shariah Subordinate Court go to the Shariah High Court, and from the Shariah High Court to the Shariah Appeal Court (Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah). The appeal process involves filing a notice of appeal within prescribed time limits.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Had masa: 14 hari dari tarikh perintah (berbeza mengikut negeri). Alasan: kesilapan undang-undang, kesilapan fakta, ketidakadilan. Penangguhan pelaksanaan sementara menunggu rayuan boleh dimohon. Rekod prosiding mesti diperolehi.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Time limit: 14 days from date of order (varies by state). Grounds: error of law, error of fact, miscarriage of justice. Stay of execution pending appeal may be applied for. Record of proceedings must be obtained.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 585: Bahagian IX — Rayuan. Enakmen Mahkamah Syariah negeri untuk had masa khusus.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 585: Part IX — Appeals. State Shariah Court enactments for specific time limits.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Failkan notis rayuan dengan segera dalam had masa. Mohon penangguhan pelaksanaan jika perlu. Sediakan hujahan bertulis. Mahkamah rayuan boleh mengesahkan, membatalkan, atau mengubah keputusan mahkamah bawahan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: File notice of appeal promptly within the time limit. Apply for stay of execution if necessary. Prepare written submissions. The appellate court may affirm, reverse, or vary the lower court's decision.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Sulh adalah proses mediasi di mahkamah Syariah, dijalankan oleh Pegawai Sulh. Ia bertujuan menyelesaikan pertikaian secara baik sebelum meneruskan perbicaraan. Perjanjian sulh, setelah disahkan oleh mahkamah, mempunyai kuat kuasa perintah mahkamah.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Sulh is the mediation process in Shariah courts, conducted by a Sulh Officer (Pegawai Sulh). It aims to resolve disputes amicably before proceeding to trial. A sulh agreement, once endorsed by the court, has the force of a court order.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Proses: (1) Kes dirujuk kepada Sulh, (2) Sesi Sulh diadakan (biasanya 2-3 sesi), (3) Jika persetujuan dicapai — direkodkan sebagai perintah persetujuan, (4) Jika tiada persetujuan — kes diteruskan ke perbicaraan. Kelebihan: lebih cepat, kurang adversarial, memelihara hubungan, kos lebih rendah.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Process: (1) Case referred to Sulh, (2) Sulh sessions held (usually 2-3 sessions), (3) If agreement reached — recorded as consent order, (4) If no agreement — case proceeds to trial. Advantages: faster, less adversarial, preserves relationships, lower cost.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Arahan Amalan mengenai Sulh. Kaedah-Kaedah Mahkamah Syariah negeri. Akta 585.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Practice Direction on Sulh. State Shariah Court Rules. Act 585.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Sediakan klien untuk sulh — jelaskan proses, manfaat, dan bahawa sebarang perjanjian adalah mengikat. Hadir dengan pendirian penyelesaian yang realistik. Pegawai Sulh memudahkan tetapi tidak memutuskan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Prepare the client for sulh — explain the process, benefits, and that any agreement is binding. Come prepared with realistic settlement positions. The Sulh Officer facilitates but does not decide.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Wasiat adalah wasiat Islam, tertakluk kepada peraturan satu pertiga — seorang Muslim hanya boleh mewasiatkan sehingga satu pertiga harta pusaka kepada bukan waris. Wasiat kepada waris Al-Quran memerlukan persetujuan waris lain. Wasiat wajibah mungkin terpakai bagi cucu waris yang telah meninggal dunia terlebih dahulu.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Wasiat is the Islamic will, subject to the one-third rule — a Muslim may only bequeath up to one-third of the estate to non-heirs. Bequests to Quranic heirs require the consent of other heirs. Wasiat wajibah (obligatory bequest) may apply for grandchildren of a predeceased heir.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Peraturan satu pertiga: wasiat maksimum kepada bukan waris. Wasiat kepada waris: memerlukan persetujuan waris lain. Wasiat wajibah: wasiat wajib untuk cucu yang ibu/bapanya (yang sepatutnya menjadi waris) meninggal dunia sebelum pewasiat. Syarat kesahan: pewasiat mestilah waras, wasiat tidak boleh melebihi 1/3, tiada wasiat untuk tujuan haram.
sya_provisions.principles_en: One-third rule: maximum bequest to non-heirs. Bequest to heirs: requires consent of other heirs. Wasiat wajibah: obligatory bequest for grandchildren whose parent (who would have been an heir) predeceased the testator. Conditions of validity: testator must be of sound mind, bequest must not exceed 1/3, no bequest for unlawful purposes.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Re Dato' Bentara Luar [1982]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri. Akta Wasiat 1959 (tidak terpakai kepada Orang Islam untuk pembahagian harta pusaka). Akta 303.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: State Islamic Law Administration enactments. Wills Act 1959 (does not apply to Muslims for estate distribution). Act 303.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Draf wasiat dengan teliti — nyatakan benefisiari, aset, dan bahagian. Saksi oleh dua orang saksi yang kompeten. Daftar dengan pihak berkuasa berkenaan. Nasihatkan klien mengenai had satu pertiga dan alternatif (hibah, wakaf).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Draft wasiat carefully — specify beneficiaries, assets, and proportions. Have it witnessed by two competent witnesses. Register with relevant authorities. Advise clients on the one-third limitation and alternatives (hibah, wakaf).

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Hibah adalah pemberian semasa hidup dalam undang-undang Islam. Ia membolehkan Orang Islam memindahkan harta kepada sesiapa (termasuk waris) tanpa had satu pertiga yang terpakai bagi wasiat. Hibah telah menjadi alat perancangan harta pusaka yang penting.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Hibah is an inter vivos (during lifetime) gift in Islamic law. It allows Muslims to transfer property to anyone (including heirs) without the one-third limitation that applies to wasiat. Hibah has become an important estate planning tool.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Rukun Hibah: (1) Pemberi, (2) Penerima, (3) Harta, (4) Ijab, (5) Qabul, (6) Qabd (penyerahan milikan). Hibah bi syarat (hibah bersyarat): kesahihan dipertikaikan. Pembatalan: secara umumnya tidak boleh dibatalkan kecuali ibu bapa kepada anak (dipertikaikan). Hibah takaful/insurans: sah jika didokumentasikan dengan betul.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Pillars (Rukun Hibah): (1) Donor (pemberi), (2) Donee (penerima), (3) Subject matter (harta), (4) Offer (ijab), (5) Acceptance (qabul), (6) Taking possession (qabd). Hibah bi syarat (conditional hibah): validity debated. Revocation: generally irrevocable except parent to child (contested). Hibah of takaful/insurance proceeds: valid if properly documented.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Sharifah Sapoyah v Wan Alwi [2004]; Eshah v Siti Hajar [2009]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri. Kes undang-undang daripada mahkamah Syariah. Tiada statut persekutuan khusus mengenai hibah.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: State Islamic Law Administration enactments. Case law from Shariah courts. No specific federal statute on hibah.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Dokumentasikan hibah dengan teliti — gunakan surat ikatan hibah dengan saksi yang betul. Pastikan qabd (penyerahan milikan) dilaksanakan. Bagi harta tak alih, daftarkan pemindahan. Pertimbangkan pengaturan amanah hibah yang ditawarkan oleh institusi kewangan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Document hibah meticulously — use a hibah deed with proper witnesses. Ensure qabd (transfer of possession) is effected. For immovable property, register the transfer. Consider hibah trust arrangements offered by financial institutions.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Wakaf adalah pengabdian harta untuk tujuan kebajikan atau keagamaan secara kekal. Harta tersebut menjadi tidak boleh dipindah milik dan ditadbirkan oleh Majlis Agama Islam Negeri (MAIN). Perkembangan moden termasuk wakaf tunai dan wakaf korporat.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Wakaf is the dedication of property for charitable or religious purposes in perpetuity. The property becomes inalienable and is administered by the State Islamic Religious Council (Majlis Agama Islam Negeri). Modern developments include cash wakaf and corporate wakaf.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Jenis: Wakaf Am (umum — untuk manfaat awam), Wakaf Khas (khusus — untuk benefisiari yang ditetapkan). Setelah diwujudkan, wakaf tidak boleh dibatalkan. Doktrin cy-pres: jika tujuan asal gagal, harta boleh digunakan untuk tujuan yang serupa. Pentadbiran: pemegang amanah tunggal adalah Majlis Agama Islam Negeri.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Types: Wakaf Am (general — for the public benefit), Wakaf Khas (specific — for designated beneficiaries). Once created, wakaf is irrevocable. Cy-pres doctrine: if the original purpose fails, the property may be applied to a similar purpose. Administration: sole trustee is the State Islamic Religious Council.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Commissioner of Religious Affairs Terengganu v Tengku Mariam [1970]; MAIS v Bong Boon Chuen [2003]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri. Kanun Tanah Negara 1965 (pendaftaran). Peruntukan wakaf dalam enakmen negeri masing-masing.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: State Islamic Law Administration enactments. National Land Code 1965 (registration). Wakaf provisions in respective state enactments.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Daftarkan wakaf dengan Majlis Agama Islam Negeri. Pastikan harta bebas daripada bebanan. Draf surat ikatan wakaf dengan jelas menyatakan tujuan dan benefisiari. Bagi wakaf tunai, gunakan institusi yang diberi kuasa.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Register the wakaf with the State Islamic Religious Council. Ensure the property is free from encumbrances. Draft the wakaf deed clearly specifying the purpose and beneficiaries. For cash wakaf, use authorized institutions.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Nazar adalah niat atau ikrar yang dibuat kepada Allah untuk melakukan perbuatan ibadat atau kebajikan tertentu. Setelah dibuat, ia menjadi wajib untuk ditunaikan. Jika tidak mampu menunaikan, kaffarah (tebusan) mungkin diperlukan.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Nazar is a vow or pledge made to Allah to perform a specific act of worship or charity. Once made, it becomes obligatory to fulfill. If unable to fulfill, kaffarah (expiation) may be required.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Jenis: Nazar Mutlak (tanpa syarat), Nazar Mu'allaq (bersyarat — apabila sesuatu peristiwa berlaku). Penunaian adalah wajib. Kaffarah bagi nazar yang tidak ditunaikan: memberi makan 10 orang miskin, atau memberikan pakaian, atau berpuasa 3 hari.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Types: Nazar Mutlak (unconditional), Nazar Mu'allaq (conditional — upon occurrence of an event). Fulfillment is obligatory. Kaffarah for unfulfilled nazar: feeding 10 poor persons, or clothing them, or fasting 3 days.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: State Islamic Law Administration enactments.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Perkara nazar jarang dibawa ke mahkamah. Apabila berlaku, nasihatkan mengenai prinsip fiqh Islam dan kaffarah yang sesuai jika nazar tidak dapat ditunaikan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Nazar matters rarely come before the court. When they do, advise on the Islamic jurisprudential principles and the appropriate kaffarah if the nazar cannot be fulfilled.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Perkara 121(1A) Perlembagaan Persekutuan memperuntukkan bahawa mahkamah sivil tidak mempunyai bidang kuasa berkenaan dengan mana-mana perkara dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah. Peruntukan ini telah menjadi subjek tafsiran kehakiman yang penting.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Article 121(1A) of the Federal Constitution provides that civil courts shall have no jurisdiction in respect of any matter within the jurisdiction of the Shariah courts. This provision has been the subject of significant judicial interpretation.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Klausa penyisihan: mahkamah sivil mesti menolak bidang kuasa apabila perkara tersebut termasuk dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah. Walau bagaimanapun: (1) Isu perlembagaan kekal dengan mahkamah sivil (Mahkamah Persekutuan), (2) Bukan Islam tidak boleh tertakluk kepada bidang kuasa Syariah, (3) Peruntukan ini tidak mengangkat mahkamah Syariah di atas mahkamah sivil. Ketegangan utama: kes penukaran agama melibatkan kanak-kanak, pertikaian harta pusaka dengan waris Islam dan bukan Islam.
sya_provisions.principles_en: The ouster clause: civil courts must decline jurisdiction where the matter falls within Shariah court jurisdiction. However: (1) Constitutional issues remain with civil courts (Federal Court), (2) Non-Muslims cannot be subject to Shariah jurisdiction, (3) The provision does not elevate Shariah courts above civil courts. Key tensions: conversion cases involving children, estate disputes with Muslim and non-Muslim heirs.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Indira Gandhi [2018]; Lina Joy [2007]; Latifah Mat Zin [2007]; Shaik Zolkaffily [2003]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Perlembagaan Persekutuan: Perkara 121(1A), Perkara 3, Perkara 11, Perkara 12. Jadual 9 Senarai II.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Federal Constitution: Article 121(1A), Article 3, Article 11, Article 12. Schedule 9 List II.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan isu bidang kuasa, analisis sama ada perkara tersebut benar-benar termasuk dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah yang disebutkan. Failkan cabaran bidang kuasa dengan segera. Pertimbangkan tafsiran terkini Mahkamah Persekutuan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: When dealing with jurisdictional issues, analyze whether the subject matter truly falls within the Shariah court's enumerated jurisdiction. File jurisdictional challenges promptly. Consider the Federal Court's latest interpretations.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Khuluk adalah satu bentuk perceraian yang dimulakan oleh isteri di mana beliau menawarkan pampasan (biasanya pemulangan mahar) kepada suami sebagai ganti pembebasannya daripada perkahwinan. Ia memerlukan persetujuan bersama dan pengesahan mahkamah. Tidak seperti fasakh, khuluk tidak memerlukan isteri membuktikan alasan khusus — ia berdasarkan keinginan beliau untuk menamatkan perkahwinan. Konsep ini berasal daripada ayat Al-Quran dalam Surah Al-Baqarah (2:229) di mana seorang wanita memohon pembebasan daripada suaminya dengan memulangkan kebunnya sebagai pampasan. Di mahkamah Syariah Malaysia, permohonan khuluk diproses di bawah enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam negeri masing-masing.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Khuluk is a form of divorce initiated by the wife whereby she offers compensation (usually the return of mahr) to the husband in exchange for her release from the marriage. It requires mutual consent and court endorsement. Unlike fasakh, khuluk does not require the wife to prove specific grounds — it is based on her desire to end the marriage. The concept originates from the Quranic verse in Surah Al-Baqarah (2:229) where a woman sought release from her husband by returning his garden as compensation. In Malaysian Shariah courts, khuluk applications are processed under the respective state Islamic Family Law enactments.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Prinsip utama: (1) Isteri memulakan perceraian, (2) Pampasan (iwadh) ditawarkan — biasanya pemulangan mahar tetapi boleh dipersetujui pada jumlah lain, (3) Persetujuan suami diperlukan — jika suami enggan, mahkamah boleh menjadi perantara tetapi tidak boleh memaksa khuluk, (4) Setelah dilafazkan, khuluk mengakibatkan Talaq Ba'in (cerai tidak boleh rujuk), (5) Isteri mesti mengalami iddah satu kali haid (sesetengah ulama berkata tiga), (6) Dibezakan daripada fasakh (tidak perlu membuktikan alasan) dan talaq (isteri memulakan, bukan suami). Mazhab Syafie (utama di Malaysia) menganggap khuluk sebagai satu bentuk talaq.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Key principles: (1) Wife initiates the divorce, (2) Compensation (iwadh) is offered — typically return of mahr but may be agreed at other amounts, (3) Husband's consent is required — if husband refuses, the court may mediate but cannot force khuluk, (4) Once pronounced, khuluk results in Talaq Ba'in (irrevocable divorce), (5) The wife must observe iddah of one menstrual cycle (some scholars say three), (6) Distinguished from fasakh (no need to prove grounds) and talaq (wife initiates, not husband). The Shafi'i school (predominant in Malaysia) considers khuluk as a form of talaq.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Noor Bee v Ahmad Sanusi [1978]; Tengku Puteri Zainah v Dato' Seri DiRaja Syed Nadzir [2001]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 303: s.49 (peruntukan khuluk). Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam negeri mengandungi peruntukan selari. Jumlah pampasan tertakluk kepada persetujuan antara pihak-pihak dan kelulusan mahkamah.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 303: s.49 (khuluk provisions). State Islamic Family Law enactments contain parallel provisions. The compensation amount is subject to agreement between parties and court approval.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati klien mengenai khuluk: (1) Nilai sama ada suami berkemungkinan bersetuju — jika tidak, fasakh mungkin laluan yang lebih baik, (2) Rundingkan jumlah pampasan — ia tidak perlu sama dengan jumlah penuh mahar, (3) Sediakan perjanjian bertulis yang menyatakan terma iwadh, (4) Failkan permohonan dengan dokumentasi sokongan, (5) Mahkamah akan mengesahkan persetujuan kedua-dua pihak dan terma pampasan sebelum mengesahkan khuluk. Khuluk secara umumnya lebih cepat daripada fasakh kerana tidak memerlukan prosiding perbicaraan yang meluas.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: When advising a client on khuluk: (1) Assess whether the husband is likely to consent — if not, fasakh may be the better route, (2) Negotiate the compensation amount — it need not equal the full mahr, (3) Prepare a written agreement specifying the iwadh terms, (4) File the application with supporting documentation, (5) The court will verify both parties' consent and the compensation terms before endorsing the khuluk. Khuluk is generally faster than fasakh as it does not require extensive trial proceedings.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Salah satu cabaran paling kritikal dalam amalan mahkamah Syariah adalah penguatkuasaan perintah mahkamah, khususnya perintah nafkah dan perintah hadhanah. Akta Tatacara Mal Mahkamah Syariah 1998 (Akta 585) menyediakan beberapa mekanisme penguatkuasaan termasuk prosiding penghinaan mahkamah, penahanan pendapatan (garnisi), penyitaan dan penjualan harta, dan komital ke penjara. Walaupun peruntukan ini wujud, penguatkuasaan kekal sebagai cabaran yang berterusan disebabkan had bidang kuasa dan kesukaran praktikal.
sya_provisions.overview_en: One of the most critical challenges in Shariah court practice is the enforcement of court orders, particularly maintenance orders and custody orders. The Shariah Court Civil Procedure Act 1998 (Act 585) provides several enforcement mechanisms including contempt of court proceedings, attachment of income (garnishee), seizure and sale of property, and committal to prison. Despite these provisions, enforcement remains a persistent challenge due to jurisdictional limitations and practical difficulties.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Mekanisme penguatkuasaan di bawah Akta 585: (1) Penghinaan mahkamah — penjara sehingga 6 bulan atau denda, (2) Penahanan pendapatan/gaji (s.130 Akta 303) — mahkamah mengarahkan majikan memotong nafkah daripada gaji, (3) Saman penghutang penghakiman — penghutang diperiksa mengenai keupayaan membayar, (4) Penyitaan dan penjualan — harta alih disita dan dijual, (5) Pendaftaran di mahkamah sivil — untuk penguatkuasaan terhadap harta tak alih atau penguatkuasaan antara negeri. Isu silang bidang kuasa: perintah mahkamah Syariah mungkin sukar dikuatkuasakan merentasi sempadan negeri atau terhadap bukan Islam.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Enforcement mechanisms under Act 585: (1) Contempt of court (penghinaan mahkamah) — imprisonment up to 6 months or fine, (2) Attachment of income/salary (s.130 Act 303) — court orders employer to deduct maintenance from salary, (3) Judgment debtor summons — debtor examined on ability to pay, (4) Seizure and sale — moveable property seized and sold, (5) Registration in civil court — for enforcement against immovable property or inter-state enforcement. Cross-jurisdictional issues: Shariah court orders may be difficult to enforce across state borders or against non-Muslims.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Kamariah Ali v Kelantan [2002]; Ahmad v Rosli [2008]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 585: Bahagian X — Penguatkuasaan Perintah. Akta 303: s.130 (penahanan pendapatan). Enakmen Kesalahan Jenayah Syariah (penghinaan). Penguatkuasaan timbal balik antara negeri: berbeza mengikut pengaturan negeri.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 585: Part X — Enforcement of Orders. Act 303: s.130 (attachment of income). Shariah Criminal Offences enactments (contempt). Reciprocal enforcement between states: varies by state arrangement.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Strategi penguatkuasaan: (1) Langkah pertama — tulis surat tuntutan rasmi merujuk perintah mahkamah, (2) Jika tidak dipatuhi — mohon penghinaan mahkamah (pencegah paling berkesan), (3) Bagi nafkah — mohon perintah penahanan pendapatan mengarahkan majikan, (4) Bagi hadhanah — mohon perintah pemulihan jika anak tidak diserahkan, (5) Pertimbangkan mendaftarkan perintah mahkamah Syariah di mahkamah sivil untuk penguatkuasaan jika perlu (cth., untuk perkara tanah/harta). Dokumentasikan semua ketidakpatuhan dengan teliti untuk prosiding penghinaan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Enforcement strategy: (1) First step — write a formal demand letter citing the court order, (2) If non-compliance — apply for contempt of court (most effective deterrent), (3) For maintenance — apply for attachment of income order directing the employer, (4) For custody — apply for recovery order if child not surrendered, (5) Consider registering the Shariah court order in the civil court for enforcement if needed (e.g., for land/property matters). Document all non-compliance meticulously for contempt proceedings.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Peguam Syarie adalah peguam yang berlesen untuk mengamal di mahkamah Syariah. Tidak seperti pengamal mahkamah sivil yang memegang sijil amalan kebangsaan, Peguam Syarie mesti diterima dan dilesenkan oleh setiap negeri secara individu. Syarat kemasukan berbeza mengikut negeri tetapi secara umumnya termasuk: ijazah dalam undang-undang Islam (Syariah) atau setara, lulus peperiksaan Peguam Syarie negeri, dan berkelakuan baik. Peguam sivil (Peguam Bela & Peguam Cara) tidak boleh hadir di mahkamah Syariah tanpa lesen Peguam Syarie yang berasingan.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Peguam Syarie are lawyers licensed to practice in Shariah courts. Unlike civil court practitioners who hold a national practicing certificate, Peguam Syarie must be admitted and licensed by each state individually. The requirements for admission vary by state but generally include: a degree in Islamic law (Syariah) or equivalent, passing the state Peguam Syarie examination, and good character. A civil lawyer (Advocate & Solicitor) cannot appear in Shariah courts without a separate Peguam Syarie license.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Aspek utama: (1) Pelesenan peringkat negeri — setiap negeri mempunyai Kaedah-Kaedah Peguam Syarie sendiri, (2) Tidak perlu menjadi ahli Badan Peguam Malaysia, (3) Pengamal dwi-kelayakan (kedua-dua Peguam Bela & Peguam Cara dan Peguam Syarie) wujud tetapi merupakan minoriti, (4) Bidang kuasa tatatertib: jawatankuasa Peguam Syarie negeri, (5) Hak didengar: boleh hadir dan berucap di mahkamah Syariah bagi pihak klien, (6) Bantuan guaman: sesetengah negeri menyediakan Peguam Syarie di bawah skim bantuan guaman.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Key aspects: (1) State-level licensing — each state has its own Peguam Syarie Rules, (2) Not required to be a member of the Malaysian Bar, (3) Dual-qualified practitioners (both Advocate & Solicitor and Peguam Syarie) exist but are a minority, (4) Disciplinary jurisdiction: state Peguam Syarie committee, (5) Rights of audience: may appear and address the Shariah court on behalf of clients, (6) Legal aid: some states provide Peguam Syarie under legal aid schemes.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1993 (Akta 505): Bahagian V (Peguam Syarie). Kaedah-Kaedah dan Enakmen Peguam Syarie negeri.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Administration of Islamic Law (Federal Territories) Act 1993 (Act 505): Part V (Peguam Syarie). State Peguam Syarie Rules and Enactments.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Peguam Syarie yang berlesen di satu negeri tidak boleh mengamal secara automatik di negeri lain — permohonan dan peperiksaan berasingan mungkin diperlukan. Pastikan lesen Peguam Syarie anda adalah terkini (pembaharuan tahunan). Bagi kes kompleks yang melibatkan unsur sivil dan Syariah, pertimbangkan untuk bekerjasama dengan Peguam Bela & Peguam Cara sivil.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: A Peguam Syarie licensed in one state cannot automatically practice in another state — separate applications and examinations may be required. Ensure your Peguam Syarie license is current (annual renewal). For complex cases involving both civil and Shariah elements, consider working alongside a civil Advocate & Solicitor.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Perancangan harta pusaka Islam melibatkan penstrukturan aset seseorang semasa hayat untuk memastikan pengagihan yang teratur apabila kematian mengikut undang-undang Islam. Ia menggabungkan pelbagai instrumen: faraid (bahagian wajib Al-Quran), wasiat (sehingga 1/3 kepada bukan waris), hibah (pemberian semasa hidup — tiada had), wakaf (wakaf), dan penamaan takaful (dengan pengisytiharan hibah). Perancangan harta pusaka Islam yang berkesan meminimumkan pertikaian keluarga, mengelakkan harta pusaka beku (hartanah beku), dan memastikan pematuhan prinsip Syariah sambil mencapai hasrat pewasiat dalam sempadan yang dibenarkan.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Islamic estate planning involves structuring one's assets during lifetime to ensure orderly distribution upon death in accordance with Islamic law. It combines multiple instruments: faraid (mandatory Quranic shares), wasiat (will — up to 1/3 to non-heirs), hibah (lifetime gifts — no limit), wakaf (endowment), and takaful nomination (with hibah declaration). Effective Islamic estate planning minimizes family disputes, avoids frozen estates (hartanah beku), and ensures compliance with Shariah principles while achieving the testator's wishes within permissible boundaries.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Instrumen utama: (1) Faraid — wajib, tidak boleh diubah oleh pewasiat (kecuali dengan persetujuan semua waris), (2) Wasiat — sehingga 1/3 boleh diarahkan kepada bukan waris atau tujuan kebajikan, (3) Hibah — pemberian semasa hayat, tiada had, berkuat kuasa serta-merta, secara umumnya tidak boleh dibatalkan, (4) Amanah — diuruskan melalui pengaturan amanah Islam, (5) Wakaf — wakaf kekal, (6) Takaful/insurans — hasil pergi kepada penama sebagai pemegang amanah untuk pengagihan faraid kecuali hibah diisytiharkan. Strategi: gunakan hibah semasa hayat untuk memindahkan aset kepada penerima yang dikehendaki, sediakan wasiat untuk sehingga 1/3 baki, dan biarkan faraid terpakai kepada selebihnya.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Key instruments: (1) Faraid — mandatory, cannot be altered by the testator (except with consent of all heirs), (2) Wasiat — up to 1/3 can be directed to non-heirs or charitable causes, (3) Hibah — lifetime gift, no limit, effective immediately, generally irrevocable, (4) Amanah (trust) — managed through Islamic trust arrangements, (5) Wakaf — perpetual endowment, (6) Takaful/insurance — proceeds go to nominee as trustee for faraid distribution unless hibah declared. Strategy: use hibah during lifetime to transfer assets to intended recipients, prepare wasiat for up to 1/3 remainder, and let faraid apply to the rest.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Re Dato' Bentara Luar [1982]; Latifah Mat Zin [2007]; various state Shariah court hibah decisions
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 303 (peruntukan undang-undang keluarga), Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri, Akta Probet dan Pentadbiran 1959, Akta Harta Pusaka Kecil (Pembahagian) 1955, Akta Cukai Pendapatan 1967 (untuk implikasi cukai).
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 303 (family law provisions), State Islamic Law Administration enactments, Probate and Administration Act 1959, Small Estates (Distribution) Act 1955, Income Tax Act 1967 (for tax implications).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Kesilapan biasa perancangan harta pusaka: (1) Tidak menyediakan sebarang dokumen — membawa kepada harta pusaka beku yang mengambil masa bertahun-tahun untuk diselesaikan, (2) Menganggap penamaan takaful sama dengan pemilikan — ia tidak mengatasi faraid, (3) Membuat hibah tanpa dokumentasi atau qabd yang betul — berisiko tidak sah, (4) Tidak mempertimbangkan isu harta bersama untuk hartanah dengan pemilik bersama bukan Islam. Nasihatkan klien untuk: menyediakan wasiat, melaksanakan hibah untuk aset utama dengan dokumentasi yang betul, mengisytiharkan hibah ke atas hasil takaful, dan mendapatkan pengiraan faraid secara proaktif.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Common estate planning mistakes: (1) Not preparing any documents — leading to frozen estates that take years to resolve, (2) Assuming takaful nomination equals ownership — it does not override faraid, (3) Making hibah without proper documentation or qabd — risking invalidity, (4) Not considering joint property issues for properties with non-Muslim co-owners. Advise clients to: prepare wasiat, execute hibah for key assets with proper documentation, declare hibah on takaful proceeds, and obtain faraid calculation proactively.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Amanah Islam adalah pengaturan fidusiari di mana harta dipegang oleh pemegang amanah untuk manfaat benefisiari yang ditetapkan mengikut prinsip Syariah. Di Malaysia, amanah Islam ditawarkan oleh institusi seperti Amanah Raya Berhad, As-Salihin Trustee Berhad, dan pelbagai bank Islam. Konsep ini menyambungkan undang-undang amanah konvensional dengan perancangan harta pusaka Islam, menyediakan mekanisme untuk mengurus dan mengagihkan aset semasa hayat dan selepas kematian sambil kekal patuh Syariah.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Islamic trust (amanah) is a fiduciary arrangement where property is held by a trustee for the benefit of specified beneficiaries in accordance with Shariah principles. In Malaysia, Islamic trusts are offered by institutions such as Amanah Raya Berhad, As-Salihin Trustee Berhad, and various Islamic banks. The concept bridges conventional trust law with Islamic estate planning, providing a mechanism to manage and distribute assets both during life and after death while remaining Shariah-compliant.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Jenis amanah Islam: (1) Amanah hidup — pewujud memindahkan aset semasa hayat, (2) Amanah wasiat — berkuat kuasa apabila kematian melalui wasiat, (3) Amanah hibah — gabungan hibah dan amanah untuk pemindahan aset, (4) Amanah wakaf — untuk wakaf kebajikan kekal. Keperluan Syariah: aset mesti halal, pelaburan mesti patuh Syariah, pengagihan mesti menghormati faraid di mana berkenaan. Akta Pemegang Amanah 1949 terpakai secara umum tetapi tertakluk kepada prinsip Syariah bagi pewujud Muslim.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Types of Islamic trusts: (1) Living trust (amanah hidup) — settlor transfers assets during lifetime, (2) Testamentary trust (amanah wasiat) — takes effect upon death via wasiat, (3) Hibah trust — combination of hibah and trust for asset transfer, (4) Wakaf trust — for perpetual charitable endowment. Shariah requirements: assets must be halal, investment must be Shariah-compliant, distribution must respect faraid where applicable. The Trustee Act 1949 applies generally but subject to Shariah principles for Muslim settlers.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Amanah Raya Berhad v various; As-Salihin trustee cases
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Pemegang Amanah 1949. Akta Perkhidmatan Kewangan Islam dan Sekuriti Labuan 2010 (untuk amanah luar pesisir). Enakmen undang-undang Islam negeri. Akta Pasaran Modal dan Perkhidmatan 2007 (untuk amanah saham).
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Trustee Act 1949. Labuan Islamic Financial Services and Securities Act 2010 (for offshore trusts). State Islamic law enactments. Capital Markets and Services Act 2007 (for unit trust).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Apabila mewujudkan amanah Islam: (1) Pastikan surat ikatan amanah menyatakan pematuhan Syariah secara eksplisit, (2) Lantik pemegang amanah yang patuh Syariah, (3) Bagi amanah hibah, pastikan keperluan qabd dipenuhi, (4) Pertimbangkan interaksi antara amanah dan faraid — amanah hidup dengan hibah yang telah sempurna mungkin mengambil aset di luar harta pusaka faraid, (5) Dapatkan pendapat penasihat Syariah untuk pengaturan yang kompleks.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: When establishing an Islamic trust: (1) Ensure the trust deed explicitly states Shariah compliance, (2) Appoint a Shariah-compliant trustee, (3) For hibah trusts, ensure qabd requirements are satisfied, (4) Consider the interaction between the trust and faraid — a living trust with completed hibah may take assets outside the faraid estate, (5) Get Shariah advisory opinion for complex arrangements.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Perbankan Islam di Malaysia beroperasi di bawah Akta Perkhidmatan Kewangan Islam 2013 (Akta 759) dan diselia oleh Bank Negara Malaysia. Semua produk mesti mematuhi prinsip Syariah seperti yang ditentukan oleh Majlis Penasihat Syariah (MPS) Bank Negara Malaysia. Prinsip utama termasuk larangan riba (faedah/riba), gharar (ketidakpastian berlebihan), maysir (perjudian), dan transaksi yang melibatkan aktiviti haram. Malaysia adalah peneraju global dalam kewangan Islam dengan aset melebihi USD 600 bilion.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Islamic banking (perbankan Islam) in Malaysia operates under the Islamic Financial Services Act 2013 (Act 759) and is supervised by Bank Negara Malaysia. All products must comply with Shariah principles as determined by the Shariah Advisory Council (SAC) of Bank Negara Malaysia. Key principles include the prohibition of riba (interest/usury), gharar (excessive uncertainty), maysir (gambling), and transactions involving haram activities. Malaysia is a global leader in Islamic finance with assets exceeding USD 600 billion.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Kontrak teras: (1) Murabahah — pembiayaan kos tambah (bank membeli aset dan menjual kepada pelanggan pada margin keuntungan yang dipersetujui), (2) Musharakah — perkongsian (modal bersama dan untung/rugi dikongsi), (3) Mudarabah — perkongsian untung (satu pihak menyediakan modal, pihak lain menyediakan kepakaran), (4) Ijarah — pajakan (bank membeli dan memajakkan aset kepada pelanggan), (5) Istisna' — kontrak pembuatan (untuk barangan tempahan/pembinaan), (6) Bai' Bithaman Ajil (BBA) — jualan bayaran tertangguh, (7) Tawarruq — murabahah komoditi (untuk pembiayaan peribadi), (8) Sukuk — bon Islam (sekuriti bersandarkan aset).
sya_provisions.principles_en: Core contracts: (1) Murabahah — cost-plus financing (bank buys asset and sells to customer at agreed profit margin), (2) Musharakah — partnership (shared capital and shared profit/loss), (3) Mudarabah — profit-sharing (one party provides capital, other provides expertise), (4) Ijarah — leasing (bank buys and leases asset to customer), (5) Istisna' — manufacturing contract (for bespoke/construction items), (6) Bai' Bithaman Ajil (BBA) — deferred payment sale, (7) Tawarruq — commodity murabahah (for personal financing), (8) Sukuk — Islamic bonds (asset-backed securities).
sya_provisions.related_cases: Bank Islam Malaysia Bhd v Azhar Osman [2010]; Tan Sri Abdul Khalid Ibrahim v Bank Islam Malaysia Bhd [2013]; Arab-Malaysian Finance Bhd v Taman Ihsan Jaya [2008]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Perkhidmatan Kewangan Islam 2013 (Akta 759). Akta Bank Negara Malaysia 2009 (Akta 701). Akta Suruhanjaya Sekuriti 1993. Akta Pasaran Modal dan Perkhidmatan 2007.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Islamic Financial Services Act 2013 (Act 759). Central Bank of Malaysia Act 2009 (Act 701). Securities Commission Act 1993. Capital Markets and Services Act 2007.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Apabila menasihati mengenai pertikaian perbankan Islam: (1) Kenal pasti kontrak Syariah yang mendasari, (2) Semak keputusan MPS mengenai jenis kontrak tertentu, (3) Ambil perhatian bahawa mahkamah sivil mempunyai bidang kuasa ke atas pertikaian perbankan Islam (bukan mahkamah Syariah), (4) Keputusan MPS mengikat mahkamah di bawah s.56 Akta 759, (5) Pertikaian biasa: keingkaran kemudahan pembiayaan Islam, hak ibra' (rebat), caj bayaran lewat (ta'widh).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: When advising on Islamic banking disputes: (1) Identify the underlying Shariah contract, (2) Check SAC rulings on the specific contract type, (3) Note that civil courts have jurisdiction over Islamic banking disputes (not Shariah courts), (4) The SAC's ruling is binding on courts under s.56 Act 759, (5) Common disputes: default on Islamic financing facilities, ibra' (rebate) entitlements, late payment charges (ta'widh).

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Zakat adalah salah satu Rukun Islam — levi keagamaan wajib ke atas kekayaan yang memenuhi syarat tertentu (nisab dan haul). Di Malaysia, kutipan dan pengagihan zakat diuruskan oleh pihak berkuasa agama Islam negeri melalui Pusat Pungutan Zakat (PPZ) atau badan setara. Zakat terpakai ke atas pendapatan (zakat pendapatan), simpanan (zakat simpanan), perniagaan (zakat perniagaan), pertanian (zakat pertanian), emas/perak (zakat emas/perak), saham (zakat saham), dan kekayaan lain yang layak. Kegagalan membayar zakat adalah kesalahan jenayah Syariah di sesetengah negeri.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Zakat is one of the five pillars of Islam — an obligatory religious levy on wealth that meets certain conditions (nisab and haul). In Malaysia, zakat collection and distribution is managed by state Islamic religious authorities through Pusat Pungutan Zakat (PPZ) or equivalent bodies. Zakat is applicable on income (zakat pendapatan), savings (zakat simpanan), business (zakat perniagaan), agriculture (zakat pertanian), gold/silver (zakat emas/perak), shares (zakat saham), and other eligible wealth. Failure to pay zakat is a Shariah criminal offence in some states.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Syarat zakat: (1) Nisab — had minimum (cth., kira-kira RM21,000 untuk zakat pendapatan pada 2024, berdasarkan setara 85g emas), (2) Haul — harta mesti dipegang selama satu tahun qamariah (kecuali zakat pendapatan yang tahunan), (3) Pemilikan penuh, (4) Harta mesti berkembang atau mampu berkembang. Pengagihan: 8 asnaf (kategori penerima) seperti yang dinyatakan dalam Al-Quran 9:60 — fakir, miskin, amil (pengutip zakat), muallaf, riqab (yang dalam perhambaan), gharimin (penghutang), fisabilillah (di jalan Allah), ibnu sabil (musafir yang terlantar). Kadar zakat: 2.5% ke atas harta/simpanan; kadar berbeza untuk pertanian dan ternakan.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Conditions for zakat: (1) Nisab — minimum threshold (e.g., approximately RM21,000 for zakat pendapatan in 2024, based on 85g gold equivalent), (2) Haul — wealth must be held for one lunar year (except income zakat which is annual), (3) Full ownership, (4) Wealth must be growing or capable of growth. Distribution: 8 asnaf (categories of recipients) as specified in Al-Quran 9:60 — fakir (destitute), miskin (poor), amil (zakat collectors), muallaf (new converts), riqab (those in bondage), gharimin (debtors), fisabilillah (in the cause of Allah), ibnu sabil (stranded travellers). Zakat rate: 2.5% on wealth/savings; varying rates for agriculture and livestock.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Majlis Agama Islam Wilayah Persekutuan v Lina Joy [2007] (tangential); State zakat authority decisions
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri (peruntukan zakat). Akta Cukai Pendapatan 1967 (rebat bagi zakat yang dibayar — s.6A(3)). Enakmen Kesalahan Jenayah Syariah (keengganan membayar zakat).
sya_provisions.legislation_en: State Islamic Law Administration enactments (zakat provisions). Income Tax Act 1967 (rebate for zakat paid — s.6A(3)). Shariah Criminal Offences enactments (refusal to pay zakat).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Pertimbangan praktikal utama: (1) Zakat yang dibayar kepada badan negeri yang diberi kuasa layak untuk rebat cukai pendapatan penuh (pengurangan ringgit demi ringgit), (2) Zakat korporat: syarikat boleh membayar zakat perniagaan melalui pihak berkuasa negeri, (3) Pertikaian zakat adalah dalam bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah, (4) Caruman EPF/KWSP: zakat ke atas EPF dipertikaikan — kebanyakan negeri membenarkan zakat dibayar apabila dikeluarkan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Key practical considerations: (1) Zakat paid to authorized state bodies qualifies for full income tax rebate (dollar-for-dollar reduction), (2) Corporate zakat: companies may pay business zakat through state authorities, (3) Zakat disputes are within Shariah court jurisdiction, (4) EPF/KWSP contributions: zakat on EPF is debated — most states allow zakat to be paid when withdrawn.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Perkahwinan (nikah) dalam undang-undang Islam adalah satu kontrak (aqad) yang suci antara seorang lelaki dan seorang perempuan, yang mewujudkan hak dan kewajipan bersama. Di bawah undang-undang Syariah Malaysia, perkahwinan dikawal oleh enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam negeri. Wilayah Persekutuan mengikuti Akta Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1984 (Akta 303).
sya_provisions.overview_en: Marriage (nikah) in Islamic law is a solemn contract (aqad) between a man and a woman, creating mutual rights and obligations. Under Malaysian Shariah law, marriage is governed by state Islamic Family Law enactments. The Federal Territory follows the Islamic Family Law (Federal Territories) Act 1984 (Act 303).
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Rukun Nikah: 1) Suami, 2) Isteri, 3) Wali, 4) Dua orang saksi, 5) Ijab dan Qabul. Syarat-syarat sah termasuk: persetujuan kedua-dua pihak, mahar (mas kahwin), ketiadaan halangan (hubungan mahram, tempoh iddah). Pendaftaran adalah wajib di bawah s.25 AUKI.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Pillars of marriage (Rukun Nikah): 1) Bridegroom (suami), 2) Bride (isteri), 3) Guardian (wali), 4) Two witnesses (dua orang saksi), 5) Offer and acceptance (ijab dan qabul). Conditions of validity include: consent of both parties, mahr (mas kahwin), absence of impediments (mahram relationships, iddah period). Registration is mandatory under s.25 AUKI.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Re Mohd Habibullah bin Mahmood [1993]; Aishah v Wan Salleh [2002]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1984 (Akta 303), ss.4-24. Pendaftaran perkahwinan: ss.25-34. Penalti bagi ketidakpatuhan: ss.35-40.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Islamic Family Law (Federal Territories) Act 1984 (Act 303), ss.4-24. Marriage registration: ss.25-34. Penalties for non-compliance: ss.35-40.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Permohonan perkahwinan mesti dibuat kepada Pendaftar sekurang-kurangnya 7 hari sebelum tarikh yang dicadangkan. Kedua-dua pihak mesti menghadiri kursus pra-perkahwinan. Persetujuan wali adalah penting — jika wali enggan tanpa sebab munasabah, mahkamah boleh melantik Wali Hakim (s.13 AUKI).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Applications for marriage must be made to the Registrar at least 7 days before the intended date. Both parties must attend a pre-marriage course (Kursus Pra-Perkahwinan). The wali's consent is essential — if the wali refuses unreasonably, the court may appoint a Wali Hakim (s.13 AUKI).

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Rujuk adalah proses di mana suami membatalkan perceraian yang boleh dirujuk (talaq raj'ie) semasa tempoh iddah isteri, dengan itu memulihkan perkahwinan tanpa akad nikah baru. Rujuk mesti didaftarkan dengan Pendaftar. Jika iddah telah tamat, pihak-pihak mesti menjalani perkahwinan baru (akad nikah) untuk berdamai. Rujuk hanya tersedia untuk talaq raj'ie (lafaz pertama atau kedua talaq). Selepas talaq ketiga (talaq ba'in kubra), rujuk tidak mungkin sehingga isteri telah berkahwin dengan lelaki lain (muhallil), menyempurnakan perkahwinan itu, dan bercerai atau menjadi janda daripada perkahwinan itu.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Rujuk is the process whereby a husband revokes a revocable divorce (talaq raj'ie) during the wife's iddah period, thereby restoring the marriage without a new marriage contract. Rujuk must be registered with the Registrar. If the iddah has expired, the parties must undergo a new marriage (akad nikah) to reconcile. Rujuk is only available for talaq raj'ie (first or second pronouncement of talaq). After a third talaq (talaq ba'in kubra), rujuk is not possible until the wife has married another man (muhallil), consummated that marriage, and been divorced or widowed from that marriage.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Syarat: (1) Perceraian mesti talaq raj'ie (boleh dirujuk), (2) Mesti dalam tempoh iddah, (3) Persetujuan isteri TIDAK diperlukan (tetapi beliau mesti dimaklumkan), (4) Dilafazkan oleh suami dengan perkataan atau tindakan yang jelas menunjukkan perdamaian, (5) Mesti didaftarkan dalam tempoh 7 hari. Jika isteri enggan tinggal bersama selepas rujuk, beliau boleh memohon fasakh. Selepas rujuk, suami telah menggunakan satu daripada tiga lafaz talaqnya.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Requirements: (1) Divorce must be talaq raj'ie (revocable), (2) Must be during the iddah period, (3) Wife's consent is NOT required (though she must be informed), (4) Pronounced by the husband with clear words or actions indicating reconciliation, (5) Must be registered within 7 days. If the wife refuses to cohabit after rujuk, she may apply for fasakh. After rujuk, the husband has used one of his three talaq pronouncements.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Ahmad Shah v Norhayati [1990]; Rokiah v Mohd Idris [2005]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta 303: s.51 (peruntukan rujuk), s.57 (pendaftaran rujuk). Ketidakpendaftaran adalah kesalahan di bawah s.125.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Act 303: s.51 (rujuk provisions), s.57 (registration of rujuk). Non-registration is an offence under s.125.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Nasihatkan suami bahawa rujuk mesti didaftarkan — kegagalan mendaftar adalah kesalahan jenayah. Jika terdapat pertikaian sama ada rujuk telah dilaksanakan dengan sah, mahkamah akan menyiasat. Isteri harus dimaklumkan tentang rujuk dan haknya untuk mencabar jika beliau percaya syarat-syarat tidak dipenuhi.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Advise the husband that rujuk must be registered — failure to register is a criminal offence. If there is dispute about whether rujuk was validly effected, the court will investigate. The wife should be informed of the rujuk and her right to challenge if she believes conditions were not met.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Penukaran agama kepada dan daripada Islam menimbulkan isu bidang kuasa dan perlembagaan yang kompleks di Malaysia. Penukaran agama kanak-kanak berikutan penukaran agama ibu bapa telah menjadi sangat kontroversi, seperti yang ditunjukkan dalam kes mercu tanda Indira Gandhi.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Conversion into and out of Islam raises complex jurisdictional and constitutional issues in Malaysia. Conversion of minors following a parent's conversion has been particularly contentious, as highlighted in the landmark Indira Gandhi case.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Penukaran kepada Islam (masuk Islam): pendaftaran dengan pihak berkuasa Islam negeri. Penukaran daripada Islam (murtad): bidang kuasa dipertikaikan — kebanyakan negeri memerlukan penentuan mahkamah Syariah. Penukaran kanak-kanak: Mahkamah Persekutuan dalam Indira Gandhi [2018] memutuskan persetujuan kedua-dua ibu bapa diperlukan. Kesan ke atas perkahwinan: perkahwinan sivil dibubarkan jika satu pihak memeluk Islam.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Conversion into Islam (masuk Islam): registration with state Islamic authority. Conversion out of Islam (murtad): jurisdiction contested — most states require Shariah court determination. Conversion of minors: Federal Court in Indira Gandhi [2018] held that both parents' consent required. Effect on marriage: civil marriage dissolved if one party converts.
sya_provisions.related_cases: Indira Gandhi [2018]; Lina Joy [2007]; Kung Lim Siew Wan v Choong Chee Kuan [2003]; Viran v Deepa [2016]
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Perlembagaan Persekutuan: Perkara 11, 12, 121(1A). Enakmen Pentadbiran Undang-Undang Islam negeri. Akta Membaharui Undang-Undang (Perkahwinan dan Perceraian) 1976.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Federal Constitution: Articles 11, 12, 121(1A). State Islamic Law Administration enactments. Law Reform (Marriage and Divorce) Act 1976.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Untuk kes penukaran agama: kenal pasti sama ada isu tersebut di hadapan mahkamah sivil atau Syariah. Untuk penukaran agama kanak-kanak, ikuti prinsip Indira Gandhi. Untuk perkahwinan yang terjejas oleh penukaran agama, pertimbangkan akibat sivil dan Syariah.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: For conversion cases: identify whether the issue is before the civil or Shariah court. For child conversion, follow the Indira Gandhi principle. For marriages affected by conversion, consider both civil and Shariah consequences.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Kesalahan jenayah Syariah ditetapkan oleh enakmen negeri dan meliputi perkara akhlak Islam dan kewajipan agama. Ini termasuk khalwat, zina, meminum arak, dan tidak menghadiri solat Jumaat. Bidang kuasa terhad kepada Orang Islam sahaja.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Shariah criminal offences are prescribed by state enactments and cover matters of Islamic morality and religious obligations. These include khalwat, zina, consuming alcohol, and non-attendance at Friday prayers. Jurisdiction is limited to Muslims only.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Kategori: (1) Kesalahan terhadap akhlak — khalwat, zina, liwat, (2) Kesalahan terhadap agama — tidak berpuasa, tidak bersolat, meminum arak, (3) Kesalahan terhadap kuasa agama — mengajar tanpa tauliah, menghina kuasa agama. Hukuman maksimum: denda RM5,000, penjara 3 tahun, 6 sebatan (Akta Mahkamah Syariah (Bidang Kuasa Jenayah) 1965).
sya_provisions.principles_en: Categories: (1) Offences against morality — khalwat (close proximity), zina, liwat, (2) Offences against religion — not fasting, not praying, drinking alcohol, (3) Offences against religious authority — teaching without credentials, contempt of religious authority. Maximum penalties: RM5,000 fine, 3 years imprisonment, 6 strokes (Shariah Courts Criminal Jurisdiction Act 1965).
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Kesalahan Jenayah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1997 (Akta 559). Akta Mahkamah Syariah (Bidang Kuasa Jenayah) 1965 (Akta 355). Enakmen kesalahan jenayah negeri.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Shariah Criminal Offences (Federal Territories) Act 1997 (Act 559). Shariah Courts (Criminal Jurisdiction) Act 1965 (Act 355). State criminal offence enactments.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Pertahan pertuduhan dengan mencabar: bidang kuasa (status Islam), keterangan (siasatan yang betul), prosedur (keperluan tangkapan tanpa waran). Pertimbangkan permohonan ikat jamin. Ambil perhatian kuasa hukuman terhad mahkamah Syariah di bawah Akta 355.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Defend charges by challenging: jurisdiction (Muslim status), evidence (proper investigation), procedure (arrest without warrant requirements). Consider bail applications. Note the limited sentencing power of Shariah courts under Act 355.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Tatacara jenayah Syariah mengawal siasatan, pendakwaan, dan perbicaraan kesalahan jenayah Syariah. Pendakwa Syarie menjalankan pendakwaan. Tertuduh mempunyai hak termasuk hak kepada peguam dan hak untuk berdiam diri.
sya_provisions.overview_en: Shariah criminal procedure governs the investigation, prosecution, and trial of Shariah criminal offences. The Shariah Prosecutor (Pendakwa Syarie) conducts prosecutions. The accused has rights including the right to counsel and the right to remain silent.
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Proses: (1) Siasatan oleh Pegawai Penguatkuasa Agama, (2) Pertuduhan oleh Pendakwa Syarie, (3) Akuan, (4) Perbicaraan, (5) Keputusan, (6) Hukuman. Hak tertuduh: hak diberitahu pertuduhan, hak kepada peguam, hak memanggil saksi, hak rayuan. Ikat jamin: umumnya tersedia untuk kesalahan boleh ikat jamin.
sya_provisions.principles_en: Process: (1) Investigation by Religious Enforcement Officers, (2) Charge by Pendakwa Syarie, (3) Plea, (4) Trial, (5) Verdict, (6) Sentencing. Rights of accused: right to be informed of charge, right to counsel, right to call witnesses, right of appeal. Bail: generally available for bailable offences.
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Tatacara Jenayah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1997 (Akta 560). Akta 561 (Keterangan). Akta 355 (Bidang Kuasa).
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Shariah Criminal Procedure (Federal Territories) Act 1997 (Act 560). Act 561 (Evidence). Act 355 (Jurisdiction).
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Hadir dengan segera pada tarikh mahkamah. Cabar keterangan pendakwaan dengan tegas. Mohon ikat jamin serta-merta selepas tangkapan. Ambil perhatian bahawa standard pembuktian adalah melampaui keraguan munasabah.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Appear promptly on court dates. Challenge the prosecution's evidence rigorously. Apply for bail immediately upon arrest. Note that the standard of proof is beyond reasonable doubt.

sya_provisions.overview_bm: Khalwat merujuk kepada kesalahan seorang lelaki dan perempuan (yang tidak berkahwin secara sah atau mempunyai hubungan mahram) yang didapati berdua-duaan dalam keadaan yang mencurigakan yang mencadangkan kelakuan tidak bermoral. Ia adalah salah satu kesalahan jenayah Syariah yang paling kerap didakwa di Malaysia. Penguatkuasaan dijalankan oleh pegawai penguatkuasa agama Islam negeri yang menjalankan serbuan, sering pada waktu malam, di premis yang disyaki berlaku khalwat. Kesalahan ini membawa hukuman denda, penjara, atau kedua-duanya, dalam had yang ditetapkan oleh Akta Mahkamah Syariah (Bidang Kuasa Jenayah) 1965 (Akta 355).
sya_provisions.overview_en: Khalwat refers to the offence of a man and woman (not lawfully married or related by mahram) being found in close proximity in suspicious circumstances suggesting immoral conduct. It is one of the most commonly prosecuted Shariah criminal offences in Malaysia. Enforcement is carried out by state Islamic religious enforcement officers (Pegawai Penguatkuasa Agama) who conduct raids, often at night, on premises where khalwat is suspected. The offence carries penalties of fine, imprisonment, or both, within the limits prescribed by the Shariah Courts (Criminal Jurisdiction) Act 1965 (Act 355).
sya_provisions.principles_bm: Elemen yang perlu dibuktikan: (1) Lelaki dan perempuan didapati bersama, (2) Tidak berkahwin antara satu sama lain, (3) Tidak mempunyai hubungan mahram, (4) Di tempat/keadaan yang terpencil atau mencurigakan, (5) Keadaan mencadangkan niat tidak bermoral. Pembelaan: (1) Perkahwinan yang sah, (2) Hubungan mahram (saudara darah dalam darjat yang dilarang), (3) Tujuan yang sah untuk berada bersama (cth., profesional/perniagaan), (4) Kecacatan prosedur dalam tindakan penguatkuasaan. Hukuman maksimum: denda RM5,000, penjara 3 tahun, atau kedua-duanya (tertakluk kepada had Akta 355).
sya_provisions.principles_en: Elements to prove: (1) Male and female found together, (2) Not married to each other, (3) Not related by mahram, (4) In a secluded or suspicious place/circumstances, (5) Circumstances suggest immoral intent. Defences: (1) Lawful marriage, (2) Mahram relationship (blood relatives within prohibited degrees), (3) Legitimate purpose for being together (e.g., professional/business), (4) Procedural defects in the enforcement action. Maximum penalty: RM5,000 fine, 3 years imprisonment, or both (subject to Act 355 limits).
sya_provisions.related_cases: Various unreported state Shariah court decisions
sya_provisions.legislation_bm: Akta Kesalahan Jenayah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1997 (Akta 559): s.27. Enakmen kesalahan jenayah negeri. Akta Mahkamah Syariah (Bidang Kuasa Jenayah) 1965 (Akta 355): had hukuman.
sya_provisions.legislation_en: Shariah Criminal Offences (Federal Territories) Act 1997 (Act 559): s.27. State criminal offence enactments. Shariah Courts (Criminal Jurisdiction) Act 1965 (Act 355): limits on punishment.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_bm: Strategi pembelaan: (1) Cabar prosedur tangkapan — adakah waran diperolehi dengan betul? Adakah prosedur yang betul diikuti? (2) Cabar pengenalan — adakah tertuduh dikenal pasti dengan betul? (3) Buktikan keadaan adalah tidak bersalah — tujuan yang sah untuk berada bersama, (4) Semak jika pegawai penguatkuasa agama mempunyai kuasa dan bidang kuasa yang betul. Banyak kes khalwat diselesaikan melalui tawar-menawar akuan. Pesalah kali pertama biasanya menerima hukuman yang lebih ringan.
sya_provisions.practical_notes_en: Defence strategy: (1) Challenge the arrest procedure — was the warrant properly obtained? Were proper procedures followed? (2) Challenge the identification — was the accused properly identified? (3) Establish the circumstances were innocent — legitimate purpose for being together, (4) Check if religious enforcement officers had proper authority and jurisdiction. Many khalwat cases are settled through plea bargaining. First-time offenders typically receive lighter sentences.
