sya_legislation.description_en: Provides for the regulation and supervision of Islamic financial institutions, payment systems, and other relevant entities. Establishes the Shariah Advisory Council of Bank Negara Malaysia.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Bahagian I: Pelesenan, Bahagian IV: Keperluan Syariah, Bahagian V: Majlis Penasihat Syariah, Bahagian VIII: Tadbir Urus Syariah
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Part I: Licensing, Part IV: Shariah Requirements, Part V: Shariah Advisory Council, Part VIII: Shariah Governance

sya_legislation.description_bm: Perundangan utama yang mengawal undang-undang keluarga Islam di Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan. Meliputi perkahwinan, perceraian, nafkah, hadhanah, harta perkahwinan, dan perkara berkaitan bagi Orang Islam.
sya_legislation.description_en: The primary legislation governing Islamic family law in the Federal Territories. Covers marriage, divorce, maintenance, custody, matrimonial property, and related matters for Muslims.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Bahagian II: Perkahwinan (ss.4-24), Bahagian V: Pembubaran Perkahwinan (ss.45-58), Bahagian VI: Nafkah (ss.59-80), Bahagian VII: Hadhanah (ss.81-87), s.122: Harta Sepencarian
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Part II: Marriage (ss.4-24), Part V: Dissolution of Marriage (ss.45-58), Part VI: Maintenance (ss.59-80), Part VII: Custody (ss.81-87), s.122: Harta Sepencarian

sya_legislation.title_en: Administration of Islamic Law (Federal Territories) Act 1993
sya_legislation.description_bm: Mewujudkan rangka pentadbiran undang-undang Islam di Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan, termasuk Majlis Agama Islam, Mufti, hierarki mahkamah Syariah, dan kuasa penguatkuasaan.
sya_legislation.description_en: Establishes the administrative framework for Islamic law in the Federal Territories, including the Majlis Agama Islam, Mufti, Shariah courts hierarchy, and enforcement powers.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Bahagian II: Majlis Agama Islam, Bahagian III: Mufti & Fatwa, Bahagian IV: Mahkamah Syariah, Bahagian V: Peguam Syarie
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Part II: Majlis Agama Islam, Part III: Mufti & Fatwa, Part IV: Shariah Courts, Part V: Peguam Syarie
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan mana-mana perkara undang-undang Islam di Wilayah Persekutuan, kenal pasti dahulu badan pentadbiran atau mahkamah khusus yang terlibat dan bidang kuasanya di bawah Akta 505. Sentiasa sahkan komposisi dan kuasa semasa Majlis Agama Islam, fatwa Mufti yang terkini, dan peraturan prosedur mahkamah Syariah. Petua strategik adalah untuk merujuk Bahagian V mengenai Peguam Syarie bagi memastikan perwakilan dan kedudukan yang betul untuk anak guam anda.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with any Islamic law matter in the Federal Territories, first identify the specific administrative body or court involved and its jurisdiction under Act 505. Always verify the current composition and powers of the Majlis Agama Islam, the Mufti's most recent fatwas, and the Shariah court's procedural rules. A strategic tip is to cross-reference Part V regarding Peguam Syarie to ensure proper representation and standing for your client.

sya_legislation.description_bm: Peruntukan perlembagaan utama berkaitan undang-undang Islam: Perkara 3 (Islam sebagai agama Persekutuan), Perkara 11 (kebebasan beragama), Perkara 12 (hak berkaitan pendidikan), Perkara 121(1A) (bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah), Jadual 9 Senarai II (bidang kuasa negeri ke atas perkara Islam).
sya_legislation.description_en: Key constitutional provisions relevant to Islamic law: Article 3 (Islam as religion of the Federation), Article 11 (freedom of religion), Article 12 (rights in respect of education), Article 121(1A) (Shariah court jurisdiction), Schedule 9 List II (state jurisdiction over Islamic matters).
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Perkara 3, Perkara 11, Perkara 12, Perkara 121(1A), Jadual 9 Senarai II, Perkara 160 (takrifan Melayu)
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Article 3, Article 11, Article 12, Article 121(1A), Schedule 9 List II, Article 160 (definition of Malay)
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Sentiasa silang rujukan Perkara-Perkara tertentu yang disebut dengan teks penuhnya untuk memastikan tafsiran yang tepat dalam rangka kerja perlembagaan yang lebih luas. Sahkan sebarang pindaan kepada Perkara-Perkara ini, terutamanya Perkara 121(1A), kerana perubahan perlembagaan boleh memberi kesan ketara kepada bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah. Apabila menyediakan hujah, terutamanya berkaitan dengan Perkara 11 atau Perkara 12, jangka konflik yang mungkin timbul dengan undang-undang Islam negeri dan sediakan hujah yang menangani peruntukan perlembagaan dan negeri. Petua strategik adalah untuk mempertimbangkan takrifan 'Melayu' dalam Perkara 160 apabila berhadapan dengan isu-isu penukaran agama atau undang-undang peribadi, kerana ia menjadi asas banyak aplikasi Syariah.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: Always cross-reference the specific Articles cited with their full text to ensure accurate interpretation within the broader constitutional framework. Verify any amendments to these Articles, especially Article 121(1A), as constitutional changes can significantly impact Shariah court jurisdiction. When preparing arguments, particularly regarding Article 11 or Article 12, anticipate potential conflicts with state Islamic laws and craft submissions that address both constitutional and state-level provisions. A strategic tip is to consider Article 160's definition of 'Malay' when dealing with issues of conversion or personal law, as it underpins many Shariah applications.

sya_legislation.description_bm: Mengawal pemberian probet dan surat kuasa mentadbir untuk harta pusaka. Bagi harta pusaka Islam yang melebihi RM2 juta atau tidak mengandungi harta tak alih, permohonan surat kuasa mentadbir mesti dibuat kepada Mahkamah Tinggi sivil. Pengagihan masih mesti mengikut faraid seperti yang disahkan oleh mahkamah Syariah.
sya_legislation.description_en: Governs the grant of probate and letters of administration for estates. For Muslim estates exceeding RM2 million or not containing immovable property, applications for letters of administration must be made to the civil High Court. The distribution must still follow faraid as certified by the Shariah court.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Seksyen 3: Pemberian probet. Seksyen 16: Surat kuasa mentadbir. Seksyen 30: Pengagihan menurut undang-undang terpakai (faraid bagi Orang Islam). Mesti melampirkan Sijil Faraid daripada mahkamah Syariah.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Section 3: Grant of probate. Section 16: Letters of administration. Section 30: Distribution according to applicable law (faraid for Muslims). Must attach Faraid Certificate from Shariah court.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Bagi harta pusaka Muslim yang melebihi RM2 juta atau tanpa harta tak alih, mohon Surat Kuasa Mentadbir di Mahkamah Tinggi Sivil, bukan Mahkamah Syariah. Sentiasa dapatkan Sijil Faraid dari Mahkamah Syariah terlebih dahulu, kerana Mahkamah Tinggi memerlukan ini untuk memastikan pembahagian mengikut undang-undang faraid. Sahkan aset si mati dengan teliti untuk menentukan ambang bidang kuasa yang betul dan pastikan semua pengesahan Mahkamah Syariah yang diperlukan lengkap sebelum memulakan prosiding sivil, bagi mengelakkan kelewatan atau cabaran bidang kuasa.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: For Muslim estates exceeding RM2 million or without immovable property, apply for Letters of Administration at the Civil High Court, not the Shariah Court. Always obtain a Faraid Certificate from the Shariah Court first, as the High Court requires this to ensure distribution adheres to Islamic inheritance law. Verify the deceased's assets carefully to determine the correct jurisdictional threshold and ensure all necessary Shariah court certifications are complete before initiating civil proceedings, to avoid delays or jurisdictional challenges.

sya_legislation.title_bm: Enakmen Tatacara Mal Mahkamah Syariah (Negeri Johor) 2003
sya_legislation.title_en: Syariah Court Civil Procedure (State of Johor) Enactment 2003
sya_legislation.description_bm: Peraturan tatacara mal Mahkamah Syariah Johor.
sya_legislation.description_en: Civil procedure rules for Shariah courts in Johor.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Pemfailan kertas kausa; penyampaian; pliding; perbicaraan; rayuan.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Filing of cause papers; service; pleadings; trial; appeal.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan kes sivil di Mahkamah Syariah Johor, sentiasa silang rujukan Enakmen Tatacara Mal Mahkamah Syariah (Negeri Johor) 2003 dengan arahan amalan Mahkamah yang berkaitan. Sahkan pindaan terkini kepada Enakmen tersebut kerana peraturan prosedur sering dikemaskini. Beri perhatian teliti kepada syarat-syarat penyampaian untuk mengelakkan kelewatan atau pembatalan prosiding, dan rancang pliding anda secara strategik untuk menentukan isu-isu dengan jelas dari awal.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When handling civil cases in Johor's Shariah Courts, always cross-reference the Syariah Court Civil Procedure (State of Johor) Enactment 2003 with the specific court's practice directions. Verify the latest amendments to the Enactment as procedural rules are frequently updated. Pay close attention to service requirements to avoid delays or invalidation of proceedings, and strategically plan your pleadings to clearly define the issues from the outset.

sya_legislation.title_bm: Akta Tatacara Mal Mahkamah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1998
sya_legislation.title_en: Shariah Court Civil Procedure (Federal Territories) Act 1998
sya_legislation.description_bm: Mengawal prosiding sivil di mahkamah Syariah di Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan. Meliputi permulaan prosiding, pliding, tatacara perbicaraan, penghakiman, penguatkuasaan, dan rayuan.
sya_legislation.description_en: Governs civil proceedings in Shariah courts in the Federal Territories. Covers commencement of proceedings, pleadings, trial procedure, judgments, enforcement, and appeals.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Bahagian III: Permulaan, Bahagian IV: Pliding, Bahagian V: Interlocutory, Bahagian VII: Perbicaraan, Bahagian VIII: Penghakiman, Bahagian IX: Rayuan, Bahagian X: Penguatkuasaan
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Part III: Commencement, Part IV: Pleadings, Part V: Interlocutory, Part VII: Trial, Part VIII: Judgments, Part IX: Appeals, Part X: Enforcement
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan perkara sivil di Wilayah Persekutuan, sentiasa mulakan dengan mengesahkan versi terkini dan sebarang pindaan baru kepada Akta Tatacara Mal Mahkamah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1998, kerana peraturan prosedur sering dikemas kini. Beri perhatian khusus kepada bahagian yang mengawal permulaan prosiding, pliding, dan penguatkuasaan, kerana ini adalah bidang yang biasa berlaku kesilapan prosedur yang boleh menggagalkan kes. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada sebarang permohonan interlokutori di bawah Bahagian V mungkin memberikan kelebihan awal atau penyelesaian, daripada menunggu perbicaraan. Kesilapan umum adalah mengabaikan garis masa yang ketat untuk pemfailan dan respons; sentiasa catatkan tarikh kritikal berdasarkan Akta tersebut.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a civil matter in the Federal Territories, always begin by verifying the current version and any recent amendments to the Shariah Court Civil Procedure (Federal Territories) Act 1998, as procedural rules are frequently updated. Pay close attention to the specific parts governing commencement, pleadings, and enforcement, as these are common areas for procedural errors that can derail a case. Strategically, consider whether any interlocutory applications under Part V might provide an early advantage or resolution, rather than waiting for trial. A common pitfall is overlooking the strict timelines for filing and responses; always diary critical dates based on the Act.

sya_legislation.title_en: Administration of the Religion of Islam (State of Johor) Enactment 2003
sya_legislation.description_bm: Menubuhkan Majlis Agama Islam Johor dan mengawal pentadbiran hal ehwal Islam.
sya_legislation.description_en: Establishes Majlis Agama Islam Johor and governs administration of Islamic affairs.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: MAIJ; Mufti; Mahkamah Syariah; fatwa; zakat; baitulmal.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: MAIJ; Mufti; Mahkamah Syariah; fatwa; zakat; baitulmal.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menggunakan Enakmen ini, sentiasalah semak pindaan terkini dan undang-undang subsidiari, kerana undang-undang pentadbiran Islam kerap dikemas kini. Beri perhatian khusus kepada kuasa dan tugas tertentu yang digariskan untuk MAIJ, Mufti, dan Mahkamah Syariah untuk memastikan aplikasi prosedur yang betul. Petua strategik adalah menyemak silang Enakmen ini dengan Enakmen Tatacara Jenayah Syariah (Negeri Johor) 2003 dan Enakmen Tatacara Mal Syariah (Negeri Johor) 2003 untuk pemahaman komprehensif mengenai had bidang kuasa dan mekanisme penguatkuasaan.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When using this Enactment, always verify the latest amendments and subsidiary legislation, as Islamic administration laws are frequently updated. Pay close attention to the specific powers and duties outlined for MAIJ, the Mufti, and the Syariah Court to ensure correct procedural application. A strategic tip is to cross-reference this Enactment with the Syariah Criminal Procedure (State of Johor) Enactment 2003 and Syariah Civil Procedure (State of Johor) Enactment 2003 for comprehensive understanding of jurisdictional limits and enforcement mechanisms.

sya_legislation.title_en: Syariah Criminal Offences (State of Johor) Enactment 1997
sya_legislation.description_bm: Mentakrifkan kesalahan jenayah Syariah dan hukuman bagi orang Islam di Johor.
sya_legislation.description_en: Defines Shariah criminal offences and penalties for Muslims in Johor.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Khalwat; zina; minum arak; tidak bersembahyang Jumaat; kesalahan akidah.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Khalwat; zina; minum arak; tidak bersembahyang Jumaat; kesalahan akidah.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan perkara jenayah di Johor, sentiasa silang rujuk kesalahan yang didakwa dengan peruntukan khusus Enakmen ini untuk memastikan bidang kuasa dan pembentukan pertuduhan yang betul. Sahkan agama tertuduh dan lokasi kesalahan kerana Enakmen ini hanya terpakai kepada orang Islam di Johor. Berhati-hati bahawa penalti dan prosedur tertentu diperincikan di sini, jadi ikuti langkah-langkah yang ditetapkan dengan teliti untuk mengelakkan ketidakteraturan prosedur. Petua strategik adalah untuk sentiasa menyemak sebarang pindaan berikutnya atau perundangan subsidiari yang mungkin menjejaskan pemakaian atau tafsiran peruntukan utama seperti 'khalwat' atau 'zina'.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with criminal matters in Johor, always cross-reference the alleged offence with the specific provisions of this Enactment to ensure jurisdiction and proper charge framing. Verify the accused's religion and the locus of the offence as this Enactment applies only to Muslims within Johor. Be mindful that specific penalties and procedures are detailed herein, so meticulously follow the prescribed steps to avoid procedural irregularities. A strategic tip is to always check for any subsequent amendments or subsidiary legislation that might impact the application or interpretation of these key provisions like 'khalwat' or 'zina'.

sya_legislation.description_bm: Pentadbiran hal ehwal Islam di Kedah.
sya_legislation.description_en: Administration of Islamic affairs in Kedah.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Majlis Agama Islam Kedah; Mufti; Mahkamah Syariah; fatwa.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Majlis Agama Islam Kedah; Mufti; Mahkamah Syariah; fatwa.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan pentadbiran Islam di Kedah, sentiasalah bermula dengan menyemak pindaan terkini kepada Enakmen ini. Sahkan komposisi dan kuasa semasa Majlis Agama Islam Kedah serta bidang kuasa Mahkamah Syariah. Petua strategik utama adalah untuk menyemak silang peruntukan fatwa dengan mana-mana fatwa yang diwartakan yang berkaitan untuk memastikan pematuhan, kerana ini boleh memberi kesan ketara kepada strategi kes anda.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with Islamic administration in Kedah, always begin by checking the most recent amendments to this Enactment. Verify the current composition and powers of the Majlis Agama Islam Kedah and the jurisdiction of the Syariah Courts. A key strategic tip is to cross-reference the fatwa provisions with any relevant gazetted fatwas to ensure compliance, as these can significantly impact your case strategy.

sya_legislation.title_bm: Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Kedah Darul Aman) 2008
sya_legislation.title_en: Islamic Family Law (Kedah Darul Aman) Enactment 2008
sya_legislation.description_bm: Undang-undang keluarga Islam Kedah meliputi perkahwinan, perceraian, nafkah, hadhanah dan pusaka.
sya_legislation.description_en: Family law for Muslims in Kedah covering marriage, divorce, maintenance, custody and inheritance.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Perkahwinan; talaq; fasakh; khuluk; nafkah; hadhanah; harta sepencarian.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Marriage; talaq; fasakh; khuluk; nafkah; hadhanah; harta sepencarian.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan kes di bawah Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Kedah Darul Aman) 2008, sentiasa sahkan domisil pihak-pihak dan locus kejadian di Kedah terlebih dahulu. Beri perhatian teliti kepada keperluan prosedur khusus untuk talaq, fasakh, dan khuluk kerana ini sering mempunyai peraturan pemfailan dan pemberitahuan yang ketat. Pastikan semua tuntutan berkaitan nafkah, hadhanah, dan harta sepencarian disenaraikan dengan jelas dan disokong oleh bukti dari awal, kerana membuktikannya kemudian boleh menjadi cabaran. Petua strategik adalah mempertimbangkan pilihan penyelesaian pertikaian alternatif seperti sulh lebih awal untuk perkara-perkara seperti nafkah dan hadhanah untuk mencapai hasil yang lebih cepat dan dipersetujui bersama.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When handling cases under the Islamic Family Law (Kedah Darul Aman) Enactment 2008, always verify the parties' domicile and the incident's locus in Kedah first. Pay close attention to the specific procedural requirements for talaq, fasakh, and khuluk as these often have strict filing and notification rules. Ensure all claims related to nafkah, hadhanah, and harta sepencarian are clearly itemized and supported by evidence from the outset, as proving these later can be challenging. A strategic tip is to consider alternative dispute resolution options like sulh early for matters such as nafkah and hadhanah to achieve faster, mutually agreeable outcomes.

sya_legislation.title_bm: Enakmen Majlis Agama Islam dan Adat Istiadat Melayu Kelantan 1994
sya_legislation.title_en: Council of the Religion of Islam and Malay Custom Enactment (Kelantan) 1994
sya_legislation.description_bm: Menubuhkan Majlis Agama Islam dan Adat Istiadat Melayu Kelantan (MAIK).
sya_legislation.description_en: Establishes Majlis Agama Islam dan Adat Istiadat Melayu Kelantan (MAIK).
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: MAIK; Mufti; pentadbiran Syariah; zakat; baitulmal.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: MAIK; Mufti; Shariah administration; zakat; baitulmal.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila berurusan dengan MAIK atau hal ehwal pentadbiran Syariah di Kelantan, sentiasa sahkan peruntukan khusus dalam Enakmen Majlis Agama Islam dan Adat Istiadat Melayu Kelantan 1994, Enakmen 4/1994. Pastikan anda memahami kuasa dan prosedur semasa berkaitan MAIK, Mufti, zakat, dan baitulmal, kerana ini boleh mempengaruhi strategi kes anda. Kesalahan umum adalah menganggap keseragaman di seluruh negeri; sentiasa semak enakmen negeri yang spesifik. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan sama ada peranan MAIK menyediakan jalan untuk penyelesaian pertikaian atau rayuan pentadbiran sebelum litigasi.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When dealing with MAIK or related Shariah administration matters in Kelantan, always verify the specific provisions of the Council of the Religion of Islam and Malay Custom Enactment (Kelantan) 1994, Enakmen 4/1994. Ensure you understand the current powers and procedures regarding MAIK, the Mufti, zakat, and baitulmal, as these can impact your case strategy. A common pitfall is assuming uniformity across states; always check the specific state enactment. Strategically, consider whether MAIK's role provides an avenue for dispute resolution or administrative appeal before litigation.

sya_legislation.description_bm: Undang-undang keluarga Islam Kelantan.
sya_legislation.description_en: Family law for Muslims in Kelantan.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Perkahwinan; perceraian; nafkah; hadhanah; harta sepencarian.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Marriage; divorce; nafkah; hadhanah; harta sepencarian.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila mengendalikan kes undang-undang keluarga untuk pelanggan Muslim di Kelantan, sentiasa mulakan dengan mengesahkan pemakaian Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Kelantan) 2002. Beri perhatian khusus kepada peruntukan berkaitan perkahwinan, perceraian, nafkah, hadhanah, dan harta sepencarian, kerana ini adalah inti kepada kebanyakan kes. Rujuk silang seksyen yang berkaitan dengan tafsiran kehakiman terkini dari Mahkamah Syariah di Kelantan untuk memastikan pemakaian semasa. Kesilapan umum adalah terlepas pandang pindaan atau perundangan subsidiari, jadi sahkan status terkini Enakmen sebelum menasihati pelanggan.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a family law matter for a Muslim client in Kelantan, always begin by confirming the applicability of the Islamic Family Law Enactment (Kelantan) 2002. Pay close attention to the specific provisions related to marriage, divorce, nafkah, hadhanah, and harta sepencarian, as these form the core of most cases. Cross-reference the relevant sections with the latest judicial interpretations from the Shariah Courts in Kelantan to ensure current application. A common pitfall is overlooking amendments or subsidiary legislation, so verify the Enactment's up-to-date status before advising the client.

sya_legislation.description_bm: Kanun Jenayah Syariah berkaitan hudud (tertakluk kepada had persekutuan di bawah Akta 355).
sya_legislation.description_en: Hudud-related Shariah criminal code (subject to federal limitations under Act 355).
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Hudud, qisas, ta'zir; tertakluk kepada had bidang kuasa Persekutuan.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Hudud, qisas, ta'zir; subject to Federal jurisdiction limits.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menggunakan Enakmen ini, sentiasa sahkan terlebih dahulu bahawa kesalahan yang didakwa berlaku di Kelantan dan berada di bawah bidang kuasa Syariah negeri, mengelakkan konflik dengan undang-undang persekutuan. Pengamal undang-undang mesti membezakan dengan teliti antara peruntukan hudud, qisas, dan ta'zir dan mengesahkan had bidang kuasa yang dikenakan oleh Akta 355 untuk mencegah cabaran terhadap kuasa mahkamah. Berhati-hati terhadap kemungkinan pertindihan atau konflik dengan perundangan jenayah persekutuan; petua strategik adalah untuk sentiasa menyemak jika tindakan yang sama juga merupakan kesalahan di bawah undang-undang persekutuan dan mahkamah mana yang akan mempunyai keutamaan. Pastikan semua keperluan prosedur dipatuhi dengan ketat, kerana kes jenayah Syariah menuntut pematuhan yang ketat terhadap keterangan dan proses.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When using this Enactment, always first confirm that the alleged offence occurred within Kelantan and falls under state Shariah jurisdiction, avoiding conflicts with federal law. Practitioners must carefully distinguish between hudud, qisas, and ta'zir provisions and verify the jurisdictional limits imposed by Act 355 to prevent challenges to the court's authority. Be mindful of potential overlaps or conflicts with federal criminal legislation; a strategic tip is to always check if the same act is also an offence under federal law and which court would have precedence. Ensure all procedural requirements are strictly followed, as Shariah criminal cases demand rigorous adherence to evidence and process.

sya_legislation.title_en: Islamic Family Law (State of Melaka) Enactment 2002
sya_legislation.description_bm: Undang-undang keluarga Islam Melaka.
sya_legislation.description_en: Family law for Muslims in Melaka.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Perkahwinan; perceraian; nafkah; hadhanah; harta sepencarian.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Marriage; divorce; nafkah; hadhanah; harta sepencarian.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menguruskan perkara undang-undang keluarga di Melaka, sentiasa mulakan dengan menyemak pindaan terkini kepada Enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam (Negeri Melaka) 2002 untuk memastikan anda bergantung pada peruntukan semasa. Beri perhatian khusus kepada keperluan prosedur tertentu untuk perkahwinan, perceraian, nafkah, hadhanah, dan harta sepencarian kerana ketidakpatuhan boleh memudaratkan tuntutan. Sahkan domisil dan status pendaftaran pihak-pihak dengan teliti, kerana Enakmen ini terpakai secara eksklusif kepada orang Islam di Melaka. Secara strategik, nasihatkan klien mengenai potensi mediasi di bawah kerangka ini sebelum memulakan prosiding mahkamah secara rasmi, kerana ia sering membawa kepada penyelesaian yang lebih cepat dan kurang dipertikaikan.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When handling a family law matter in Melaka, always start by checking the latest amendments to the Islamic Family Law (State of Melaka) Enactment 2002 to ensure you are relying on current provisions. Pay close attention to the specific procedural requirements for marriage, divorce, nafkah, hadhanah, and harta sepencarian as non-compliance can be fatal to a claim. Verify the parties' domicile and registration status meticulously, as this Enactment applies exclusively to Muslims in Melaka. Strategically, advise clients on the potential for mediation under this framework before initiating formal court proceedings, as it often leads to swifter and less contentious resolutions.

sya_legislation.description_bm: Mengawal tatacara jenayah di mahkamah Syariah di Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan, termasuk siasatan, tangkapan, perbicaraan, hukuman, dan rayuan bagi kesalahan jenayah Syariah.
sya_legislation.description_en: Governs criminal procedure in Shariah courts in the Federal Territories, including investigation, arrest, trial, sentencing, and appeal for Shariah criminal offences.
sya_legislation.key_provisions_bm: Bahagian III: Kuasa tangkapan, Bahagian V: Prosiding, Bahagian VI: Perbicaraan, Bahagian VII: Hukuman
sya_legislation.key_provisions_en: Part III: Powers of arrest, Part V: Proceedings, Part VI: Trial, Part VII: Sentence
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_bm: Apabila menggunakan Akta Tatacara Jenayah Syariah (Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan) 1997, sentiasa sahkan dahulu sama ada kesalahan itu berada di bawah bidang kuasa mahkamah Syariah di Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan. Beri perhatian khusus kepada prosedur spesifik yang digariskan dalam Bahagian III untuk tangkapan, Bahagian V untuk prosiding umum, dan Bahagian VI untuk pengendalian perbicaraan, kerana penyelewengan boleh membatalkan tindakan seterusnya. Secara strategik, pertimbangkan bagaimana peruntukan dalam Bahagian VII mengenai pensabitan boleh mempengaruhi rundingan pengakuan awal atau pengumpulan faktor-faktor mitigasi.
sya_legislation.practitioner_notes_en: When using the Shariah Criminal Procedure (Federal Territories) Act 1997, always first verify if the offense falls within the Shariah court's jurisdiction in the Federal Territories. Pay close attention to the specific procedures outlined in Part III for arrests, Part V for general proceedings, and Part VI for trial conduct, as deviations can invalidate subsequent actions. Strategically, consider how provisions in Part VII regarding sentencing might influence early plea negotiations or the gathering of mitigating factors.

Bismillahirrahmanirrahim

(b) ___

(a) Saya mewasiatkan ___ kepada [BADAN AMAL/MASJID/INSTITUSI] untuk [tujuan].

4. URUSAN PENGEBUMIAN
Saya berhasrat pengebumian saya dikendalikan mengikut syariat Islam.

Semua hutang hendaklah diselesaikan sebelum pengagihan.

6. HARTA BAKI
Baki harta pusaka saya hendaklah diagihkan menurut faraid.

Saya membuat wasiat ini secara sukarela dan atas kehendak sendiri.

Saksi 2: ___ (Nama, KP, Alamat)

NOTA: Wasiat ini tertakluk kepada peraturan satu pertiga — jumlah wasiat kepada bukan waris tidak boleh melebihi 1/3 harta pusaka bersih. Wasiat kepada waris Al-Quran memerlukan persetujuan semua waris lain.
sya_cause_papers.template_en:
WASIAT (ISLAMIC WILL)

In the Name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

I, [FULL NAME], Identity Card No. ___, of [ADDRESS], being of sound mind and body, hereby declare this to be my last will and testament (wasiat) in accordance with Islamic law (Hukum Syarak).

1. EXECUTOR (Wasi)
I appoint [EXECUTOR NAME], IC No. ___, as the executor of this wasiat.
Alternate executor: [NAME], IC No. ___.

2. BEQUESTS (not exceeding one-third of estate)
(a) I bequeath RM___ / [description of property] to [BENEFICIARY NAME] for [purpose].
(b) ___

3. CHARITABLE BEQUESTS
(a) I bequeath ___ to [CHARITY/MOSQUE/INSTITUTION] for [purpose].

4. FUNERAL ARRANGEMENTS
I wish my funeral to be conducted according to Islamic rites.

5. DEBTS
All debts shall be settled before distribution.

6. RESIDUARY ESTATE
The remainder of my estate shall be distributed according to faraid.

7. DECLARATION
I make this wasiat voluntarily and of my own free will.

Signed: ___
Date: ___

Witness 1: ___ (Name, IC, Address)
Witness 2: ___ (Name, IC, Address)

NOTE: This wasiat is subject to the one-third rule — total bequests to non-heirs may not exceed 1/3 of the net estate. Bequests to Quranic heirs require consent of all other heirs.
sya_cause_papers.description_bm: Templat untuk mendraf wasiat Islam yang mematuhi prinsip Syariah, termasuk had satu pertiga.
sya_cause_papers.description_en: Template for drafting an Islamic will (wasiat) compliant with Shariah principles, including the one-third limitation.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pembubaran perkahwinan melalui lafaz suami. Boleh dirujuk (raj'ie) atau tidak boleh dirujuk (ba'in). Tiga lafaz mengakibatkan perceraian tidak boleh rujuk secara mutlak (talaq ba'in kubra).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The dissolution of marriage by the husband's pronouncement. May be revocable (raj'ie) or irrevocable (ba'in). Three pronouncements result in a major irrevocable divorce (talaq ba'in kubra).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A husband who pronounces talaq once during his wife's tuhr (purity period) initiates a revocable divorce. He may reconcile during the iddah period.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pembubaran perkahwinan oleh mahkamah atas permohonan isteri berdasarkan alasan tertentu seperti kekejaman, kegagalan menanggung nafkah, mati pucuk, atau gila.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Dissolution of marriage by the court at the wife's request on specified grounds such as cruelty, failure to maintain, impotence, or insanity.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A wife whose husband has been absent for more than one year may apply for fasakh under s.52(1)(a) AUKI.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pembubaran perkahwinan atas permohonan isteri sebagai ganti pampasan (biasanya pemulangan mahar). Memerlukan persetujuan bersama.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Dissolution of marriage at the wife's request in exchange for compensation (usually return of mahr). Requires mutual agreement.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: The wife offers to return her mahr of RM10,000 to the husband in exchange for divorce by khuluk.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kewajipan menyediakan sokongan kewangan. Termasuk nafkah isteri (semasa perkahwinan dan iddah), anak-anak, dan ibu bapa.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The obligation to provide financial support. Includes maintenance of wife (during marriage and iddah), children, and parents.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A husband is obliged to provide nafkah to his wife including shelter, food, clothing according to his means and her accustomed standard of living.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Hak penjagaan fizikal dan pemeliharaan anak. Dalam undang-undang Islam, ibu umumnya mempunyai keutamaan untuk anak kecil.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The right to physical custody and upbringing of a child. In Islamic law, the mother generally has priority for young children.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A divorced mother has priority for hadhanah of children below age 7 (boys) and 9 (girls) in most states.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pemberian yang perlu dibayar oleh suami kepada isteri apabila perceraian bukan disebabkan kesalahan isteri. Jumlah ditentukan oleh mahkamah berdasarkan tempoh perkahwinan, kemampuan suami, dan sumbangan isteri.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A gift payable by the husband to the wife upon divorce not caused by the wife's fault. Amount determined by the court based on marriage duration, husband's means, and wife's contributions.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Court may award RM30,000-50,000 as mut'ah for a 10-year marriage where the husband earns RM10,000/month.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Sistem pewarisan Islam wajib berdasarkan bahagian tetap Al-Quran untuk waris-waris yang ditetapkan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The Islamic system of obligatory inheritance distribution based on fixed Quranic shares for specified heirs.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A deceased leaving a wife, 2 sons, and 1 daughter: wife gets 1/8, remainder divided among children with sons receiving twice the daughter's share.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Wasiat Islam di mana seorang Muslim boleh mewasiatkan sehingga satu pertiga harta pusaka kepada bukan waris. Wasiat kepada waris Al-Quran memerlukan persetujuan waris lain.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: An Islamic will by which a Muslim may bequeath up to one-third of the estate to non-heirs. Bequests to Quranic heirs require consent of other heirs.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A Muslim may bequeath 1/3 of his estate to a charitable organization by wasiat.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pemberian harta yang dibuat semasa hayat pemberi. Tidak seperti wasiat, hibah tiada had satu pertiga dan boleh dibuat kepada waris.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A gift of property made during the donor's lifetime. Unlike wasiat, hibah has no one-third limitation and can be made to heirs.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A father gifts his house to his daughter through hibah during his lifetime, bypassing faraid distribution.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pengabdian harta untuk tujuan kebajikan atau keagamaan secara kekal. Harta menjadi tidak boleh dipindah milik dan ditadbirkan oleh Majlis Agama Islam Negeri.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The dedication of property for charitable or religious purposes in perpetuity. The property becomes inalienable and is administered by the State Islamic Religious Council.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A benefactor dedicates a piece of land as wakaf for the construction and maintenance of a mosque.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Tempoh menunggu wajib selepas perceraian atau kematian suami sebelum wanita boleh berkahwin semula. Bagi perceraian: 3 kali haid. Bagi kematian: 4 bulan 10 hari. Bagi wanita hamil: sehingga melahirkan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The mandatory waiting period after divorce or death of husband before a woman may remarry. For divorce: 3 menstrual cycles. For death: 4 months and 10 days. For pregnant women: until delivery.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: After talaq, the wife must observe iddah of 3 menstrual cycles before she can remarry.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pemberian wajib daripada suami kepada isteri apabila perkahwinan. Ia adalah hak mutlak isteri dan boleh dibayar segera (mahar mu'ajjal) atau ditangguhkan (mahar mu'ajjal).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The obligatory gift from the husband to the wife upon marriage. It is the wife's absolute right and may be paid immediately (mahr mu'ajjal) or deferred (mahr mu'ajjal).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: In Malaysia, the standard mas kahwin varies by state, typically RM80-300 for Federal Territory.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kesaksian lisan yang diberikan di bawah sumpah dalam prosiding mahkamah. Bagi perkara kewangan, standard adalah 2 saksi lelaki atau 1 lelaki dan 2 perempuan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Oral testimony given under oath in court proceedings. For financial matters, the standard is 2 male witnesses or 1 male and 2 female witnesses.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: In a maintenance claim, the wife may present 2 male witnesses to testify to the husband's income.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pengakuan yang dibuat oleh pihak dalam prosiding undang-undang. Iqrar mengikat orang yang membuatnya.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A confession or admission made by a party in legal proceedings. An iqrar is binding upon the person who makes it.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: If a husband admits (iqrar) to pronouncing talaq, the court may accept this without further evidence.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Proses mediasi di mahkamah Syariah, dijalankan oleh Pegawai Sulh. Perjanjian sulh yang disahkan oleh mahkamah mempunyai kuat kuasa perintah mahkamah.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The process of mediation in Shariah courts, conducted by a Sulh Officer. A sulh agreement endorsed by the court has the force of a court order.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Before trial, the court refers the custody dispute to Sulh where parties reach an agreement on shared custody.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Keterangan keadaan atau tidak langsung yang digunakan dalam prosiding mahkamah Syariah. Termasuk keterangan dokumen, laporan pakar, keterangan DNA.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Circumstantial or indirect evidence used in Shariah court proceedings. Includes documentary evidence, expert reports, DNA evidence.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: DNA test results may be admitted as qarinah evidence in nasab (paternity) disputes.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Prinsip asas jurisprudens Islam yang membimbing penaakulan undang-undang. Contoh: 'Perkara ditentukan oleh niat' (Al-umuru bi maqasidiha), 'Keyakinan tidak dihilangkan oleh keraguan' (Al-yaqinu la yazulu bi al-shakk).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Fundamental principles of Islamic jurisprudence that guide legal reasoning. Examples: 'Matters are determined by intention' (Al-umuru bi maqasidiha), 'Certainty is not removed by doubt' (Al-yaqinu la yazulu bi al-shakk).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: In disputed divorce cases, the maxim 'certainty is not removed by doubt' means the marriage continues until divorce is proven.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kesepakatan ulama Islam mengenai sesuatu isu undang-undang. Salah satu daripada empat sumber utama undang-undang Islam selepas Al-Quran, Sunnah, dan Qiyas.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The consensus of Muslim scholars on a legal issue. One of the four main sources of Islamic law after the Quran, Sunnah, and Qiyas.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: The obligation of faraid distribution according to Quranic shares is established by ijma' of scholars.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Proses penaakulan undang-undang secara analogi, mengaplikasikan hukum yang diketahui kepada situasi baru yang berkongsi sebab efektif ('illah) yang sama.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The process of legal reasoning by analogy, applying a known ruling to a new situation that shares the same effective cause ('illah).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Qiyas is used to extend the prohibition of alcohol (khamr) to other intoxicating substances.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Prinsip bertindak demi kepentingan atau kebajikan awam. Sumber tambahan undang-undang Islam yang digunakan apabila sumber utama tidak memberikan panduan yang jelas.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The principle of acting in the public interest or welfare. A supplementary source of Islamic law used where the primary sources do not provide explicit guidance.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: The court may consider maslahah (child's welfare) when deciding custody even if the strict Hukum Syarak priority rules would lead to a different result.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Penjaga lelaki yang memberikan persetujuan untuk perkahwinan seorang wanita. Dalam mazhab Syafie (diikuti di Malaysia), persetujuan wali adalah penting untuk perkahwinan yang sah. Hierarki wali bermula dengan bapa, kemudian datuk sebelah bapa, kemudian saudara lelaki, dan seterusnya.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The male guardian who gives consent for a woman's marriage. In the Shafi'i school (followed in Malaysia), the wali's consent is essential for a valid marriage. The hierarchy of wali begins with the father, then paternal grandfather, then brothers, and so on.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: If a bride's father refuses to be her wali without valid reason, she may apply to the court for a Wali Hakim (court-appointed guardian) under s.13 AUKI.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Prosedur di mana suami menuduh isterinya berzina dengan mengangkat empat sumpah, diikuti sumpah kelima memohon laknat Allah jika dia berdusta. Isteri boleh membantah dengan sumpahnya sendiri. Mengakibatkan perpisahan kekal dan nasab anak dipertikaikan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A procedure where a husband accuses his wife of adultery by taking four oaths, followed by a fifth invoking Allah's curse if he lies. The wife may counter with her own oaths. Results in permanent separation and disputed paternity of the child.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Li'an is rarely invoked in modern Malaysian practice but remains a valid Shariah procedure for situations where a husband has no witnesses to prove zina.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Amalan yang dilarang mengenakan faedah ke atas pinjaman. Salah satu larangan paling asas dalam undang-undang komersial Islam. Termasuk riba al-fadl (lebihan dalam pertukaran barangan serupa) dan riba al-nasiah (lebihan kerana kelewatan pembayaran).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The prohibited practice of charging interest on loans. One of the most fundamental prohibitions in Islamic commercial law. Includes both riba al-fadl (excess in exchange of similar goods) and riba al-nasiah (excess due to delay in payment).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Islamic banks use murabahah (cost-plus sale) instead of interest-based lending — the bank buys an asset and sells it to the customer at an agreed profit margin.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Ketidakpastian atau kesamaran yang berlebihan dalam kontrak yang boleh membawa kepada ketidakadilan. Dilarang dalam transaksi Islam. Tahap gharar mestilah berlebihan untuk membatalkan kontrak — ketidakpastian kecil dibenarkan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Excessive uncertainty or ambiguity in a contract that may lead to injustice. Prohibited in Islamic transactions. The level of gharar must be excessive to invalidate a contract — minor uncertainty is tolerated.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A sale of unborn livestock or unripe fruit still on the tree (before maturity can be reasonably assessed) may contain excessive gharar.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Perjudian atau transaksi spekulatif yang berlebihan yang dilarang dalam undang-undang Islam. Terpakai kepada kontrak di mana keuntungan bergantung semata-mata kepada nasib dan bukannya aktiviti ekonomi yang produktif.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Gambling or excessive speculative transactions prohibited in Islamic law. Applies to contracts where gain depends purely on chance rather than productive economic activity.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Conventional insurance is considered to contain elements of maysir — hence the development of takaful as the Islamic alternative based on mutual cooperation.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kontrak jual beli di mana penjual mendedahkan harga kos dan menambah margin keuntungan yang dipersetujui. Kontrak pembiayaan Islam yang paling banyak digunakan di Malaysia, digunakan untuk pembiayaan rumah, kenderaan, dan peribadi.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A sale contract where the seller discloses the cost price and adds an agreed profit margin. The most widely used Islamic financing contract in Malaysia, used for home financing, vehicle financing, and personal financing.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: For home financing: the bank purchases the property at RM500,000 and sells it to the customer at RM700,000 (including profit) payable over 25 years by monthly installments.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kontrak pajakan di mana pemberi pajak (pemilik) memindahkan hak untuk menggunakan aset kepada pemajak untuk sewaan dan tempoh yang dipersetujui. Dalam Ijarah Thumma Al-Bai' (AITAB), pemilikan dipindahkan pada akhir tempoh pajakan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A contract of leasing where the lessor (owner) transfers the right to use an asset to the lessee for an agreed rental and period. In Ijarah Thumma Al-Bai' (AITAB), ownership is transferred at the end of the lease period.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: For vehicle financing: the bank buys the car and leases it to the customer. At the end of the lease period, the customer purchases the car at a nominal price.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Penimbangtara yang dilantik oleh mahkamah dalam pertikaian matrimoni untuk cuba mendamaikan pihak-pihak sebelum mahkamah meneruskan perbicaraan. Biasanya seorang hakam dilantik dari setiap pihak.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: An arbitrator appointed by the court in matrimonial disputes to attempt reconciliation between the parties before the court proceeds to trial. Usually one hakam is appointed from each side.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: In a divorce case, the court appoints the wife's brother and the husband's uncle as hakam. They meet with the couple to attempt reconciliation before trial proceeds.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Keputusan atau pendapat agama yang dikeluarkan oleh mufti atau jawatankuasa fatwa mengenai sesuatu perkara undang-undang Islam. Di Malaysia, fatwa yang diwartakan mempunyai kuat kuasa undang-undang di negeri berkenaan. Majlis Fatwa Kebangsaan mengeluarkan fatwa di peringkat persekutuan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A religious ruling or opinion issued by a mufti or fatwa committee on a point of Islamic law. In Malaysia, a gazetted fatwa has the force of law in the respective state. The National Fatwa Council issues fatwas at the federal level.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: The Selangor Fatwa Committee's fatwa on the validity of conditional hibah carries the force of law in Selangor for Muslims.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Salah satu Rukun Islam — levi keagamaan wajib ke atas kekayaan yang memenuhi syarat tertentu (nisab dan haul). Kadar biasanya 2.5% ke atas simpanan dan kekayaan yang layak. Dikutip dan diagihkan oleh pihak berkuasa Islam negeri.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: One of the five pillars of Islam — an obligatory religious levy on wealth meeting certain conditions (nisab and haul). Rate is typically 2.5% on savings and eligible wealth. Collected and distributed by state Islamic authorities.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A Muslim whose savings exceed the nisab (approximately RM21,000 in 2024) for one year must pay 2.5% zakat on those savings.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Sijil kewangan Islam yang mewakili kepentingan pemilikan dalam aset yang mendasari. Tidak seperti bon konvensional yang mewakili hutang, sukuk mewakili pemilikan berkadar dalam aset ketara, usufruct, atau perkhidmatan. Malaysia adalah pasaran sukuk terbesar di dunia.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Islamic financial certificates representing ownership interest in underlying assets. Unlike conventional bonds which represent debt, sukuk represent proportionate ownership in tangible assets, usufruct, or services. Malaysia is the world's largest sukuk market.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: The Malaysian government issues sovereign sukuk based on ijarah (leasing) of government assets, providing Shariah-compliant investment instruments.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Apa yang dilarang secara mutlak dalam undang-undang Islam. Dalam konteks undang-undang, merujuk kepada aktiviti, bahan, atau transaksi yang diharamkan. Bertentangan dengan halal (dibenarkan).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: That which is absolutely prohibited in Islamic law. In legal context, refers to activities, substances, or transactions that are forbidden. The opposite of halal (permissible).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: In Islamic finance, investment in companies involved in alcohol, gambling, pork, or conventional interest-based financial services is considered haram.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kategori waris dalam faraid yang menerima baki harta pusaka selepas waris bahagian tetap (fardh) telah menerima bahagian mereka. Anak lelaki adalah 'asabah yang paling biasa. Jika tiada waris bahagian tetap, 'asabah mewarisi keseluruhan harta pusaka.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A category of heirs in faraid who receive the residue of the estate after the fixed-share (fardh) heirs have received their portions. Sons are the most common 'asabah. If there are no fixed-share heirs, 'asabah inherits the entire estate.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A deceased leaves a wife (1/8 share) and two sons. The sons are 'asabah and share the remaining 7/8 equally between them.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Waris yang berhak kepada bahagian tetap yang telah ditentukan daripada harta pusaka seperti yang dinyatakan dalam Al-Quran. Ini termasuk: isteri (1/8 atau 1/4), suami (1/4 atau 1/2), anak perempuan (1/2 atau 2/3), ibu (1/6 atau 1/3), bapa (1/6), dan lain-lain.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Heirs who are entitled to a fixed predetermined share of the estate as specified in the Quran. These include: wife (1/8 or 1/4), husband (1/4 or 1/2), daughter (1/2 or 2/3), mother (1/6 or 1/3), father (1/6), and others.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A deceased leaves a husband and one daughter. The husband receives 1/4 (as fixed-share heir), the daughter receives 1/2 (as fixed-share heir), and the remaining 1/4 is distributed among other eligible heirs.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Perbuatan penebusan yang diperlukan untuk dosa atau pelanggaran kewajipan Islam tertentu. Jenis kaffarah yang berbeza wujud untuk situasi yang berbeza: melanggar sumpah, sengaja membatalkan puasa Ramadan, atau zihar (satu bentuk penolakan).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The required act of atonement for certain sins or breaches of Islamic obligations. Different types of kaffarah exist for different situations: breaking an oath, deliberate breaking of Ramadan fast, or zihar (a form of repudiation).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: If a person deliberately breaks their Ramadan fast, the kaffarah options include: fasting for 60 consecutive days, or feeding 60 poor persons.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Prinsip dalam undang-undang faraid di mana kehadiran waris tertentu menghalang atau mengurangkan sebahagian waris lain daripada mewarisi. Hajb hirman adalah penghalangan sepenuhnya; hajb nuqsan adalah pengurangan sebahagian bahagian.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The principle in faraid law whereby the presence of certain heirs excludes or partially excludes other heirs from inheriting. Hajb hirman is complete exclusion; hajb nuqsan is partial reduction of share.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: A grandfather (paternal) is excluded from inheriting (hajb hirman) by the presence of the father. However, if the father has predeceased, the grandfather steps into his position.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Tindakan mengambil milikan atau penyerahan harta. Dalam undang-undang hibah, qabd adalah penting untuk kesahihan pemberian — penerima mesti mengambil milikan sebenar atau konstruktif. Tanpa qabd, hibah mungkin dianggap tidak lengkap.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: The act of taking possession or delivery of property. In hibah law, qabd is essential for the validity of the gift — the donee must take actual or constructive possession. Without qabd, the hibah may be considered incomplete.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: For hibah of a house: qabd is effected by the donee actually occupying the house or having the keys and access, or by registering the transfer of title.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Kemudaratan atau kecederaan yang diiktiraf di bawah undang-undang Islam. Dalam undang-undang keluarga, darar syarie adalah alasan untuk fasakh dan juga pertimbangan dalam permohonan poligami. Ia merangkumi kemudaratan fizikal, emosi, dan kewangan.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: Harm or injury recognized under Islamic law. In family law, darar syarie is a ground for fasakh and also a consideration in polygamy applications. It encompasses physical, emotional, and financial harm.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: In a polygamy application, the existing wife may oppose on the ground that the proposed marriage would cause her darar syarie — emotional distress and financial hardship.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Hak atau kelayakan undang-undang yang diiktiraf di bawah undang-undang Islam. Kategori termasuk: haq Allah (hak Allah — kewajipan awam/masyarakat), haq al-'abd (hak individu — tuntutan dan kelayakan peribadi).
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A legal right or entitlement recognized under Islamic law. Categories include: haq Allah (rights of God — public/societal obligations), haq al-'abd (rights of individuals — private claims and entitlements).
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: Nafkah (maintenance) is a haq al-'abd — it is the individual right of the wife that she can enforce through the court. Zakat is a haq Allah — it is an obligation owed to God through the community.

sya_glossary_terms.definition_bm: Pelarasan matematik dalam pengiraan faraid yang berlaku apabila jumlah bahagian tetap melebihi keseluruhan harta pusaka (iaitu, melebihi 1). Semua bahagian dikurangkan secara berkadar supaya ia boleh diagihkan daripada harta pusaka yang tersedia.
sya_glossary_terms.definition_en: A mathematical adjustment in faraid calculation that occurs when the total fixed shares exceed the whole estate (i.e., exceed 1). All shares are proportionally reduced so that they can be distributed from the available estate.
sya_glossary_terms.practical_example: If a deceased leaves a husband (1/2), two sisters (2/3), and mother (1/6), total shares = 1/2 + 2/3 + 1/6 = 8/6, exceeding the estate. 'Awl adjusts: husband gets 3/8, sisters get 4/8, mother gets 1/8.

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas utama bagi kesalahan qazaf (tuduhan palsu zina) dan standard keterangan empat saksi yang melindungi maruah.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The foundational basis for the offence of qazaf (false accusation of zina) and the four-witness evidentiary standard that protects reputation.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan orang-orang yang menuduh perempuan baik-baik (dengan zina) kemudian mereka tidak membawa empat orang saksi, maka sebatlah mereka lapan puluh sebatan, dan janganlah kamu menerima persaksian mereka selama-lamanya.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses — lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept their testimony ever after.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 559 s.24 (qazaf)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا اعْدِلُوا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Memerintahkan ketidakberatsebelahan mutlak pendakwa, hakim, dan saksi walaupun terhadap musuh — tunjang proses jenayah Syariah yang adil.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Commands absolute impartiality of prosecutors, judges, and witnesses even towards adversaries — a cornerstone of fair Syariah criminal process.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, hendaklah kamu menjadi orang yang sentiasa menegakkan keadilan kerana Allah, lagi menjadi saksi dengan adil; dan jangan sekali-kali kebencian kamu terhadap sesuatu kaum mendorong kamu berlaku tidak adil. Berlaku adillah, kerana ia lebih hampir kepada takwa.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, be steadfast for Allah, witnesses in justice, and do not let the hatred of a people prevent you from being just. Be just; that is nearer to righteousness.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 560 (Syariah Criminal Procedure)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Menuntut keadilan ditegakkan tanpa pilih kasih, mendasari integriti yang diharapkan daripada semua pihak dalam prosiding jenayah.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Demands that justice be upheld without favour, underpinning the integrity expected of all participants in criminal proceedings.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, hendaklah kamu menjadi orang yang sentiasa menegakkan keadilan, lagi menjadi saksi kerana Allah, walaupun terhadap diri kamu sendiri, atau ibu bapa dan kaum kerabat kamu.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allah, even if it be against yourselves or parents and relatives.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 560 (Syariah Criminal Procedure)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْأَنصَابُ وَالْأَزْلَامُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas nas bagi larangan minuman memabukkan yang mendasari kesalahan jenayah Syariah meminum khamr.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Scriptural basis for the prohibition of intoxicants underlying the Syariah criminal offence of drinking khamr.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, sesungguhnya arak, judi, pemujaan berhala, dan mengundi nasib dengan batang-batang anak panah adalah kotor (keji) dari perbuatan syaitan; oleh itu hendaklah kamu menjauhinya.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, intoxicants, gambling, idolatrous sacrifices, and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 559 s.26

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ ۖ فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas bagi peruntukan talaq dalam Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam Malaysia. Menetapkan konsep cerai boleh rujuk (talaq raj'i) yang dihadkan kepada dua lafaz. Selepas dua talaq, isteri boleh dikekalkan dengan baik atau dilepaskan dengan ihsan. Menjadi asas bagi seksyen talaq dalam Akta 303 dan enakmen negeri.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Foundation for talaq provisions in Malaysian Islamic Family Law. Establishes the concept of revocable divorce (talaq raj'i) limited to two pronouncements. After two divorces, the wife may be retained honourably or released with kindness. Forms the basis for sections on talaq in Act 303 and state enactments.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Talak (yang boleh dirujuk) itu dua kali. Sesudah itu bolehlah ia (rujuk dan) menahan (isterinya) dengan cara yang sepatutnya atau melepaskan (menceraikannya) dengan cara yang baik.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Divorce may be pronounced twice; then the wife may either be kept back in fairness or released in kindness.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Islamic Family Law (Federal Territories) Act 1984 (Act 303), s.47

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالْمُطَلَّقَاتُ يَتَرَبَّصْنَ بِأَنفُسِهِنَّ ثَلَاثَةَ قُرُوءٍ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas Al-Quran bagi iddah (tempoh menunggu) selepas perceraian. Menetapkan tempoh tiga quru' di mana wanita yang diceraikan mesti menunggu sebelum berkahwin semula. Ayat ini mendasari peruntukan iddah dalam semua enakmen undang-undang keluarga Islam negeri Malaysia.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The Quranic basis for the iddah (waiting period) following divorce. Establishes the three-quru' period during which a divorced woman must wait before remarrying. This verse underpins iddah provisions in all Malaysian state Islamic family law enactments.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan isteri-isteri yang diceraikan hendaklah menunggu dengan menahan diri mereka (daripada berkahwin) selama tiga kali suci.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Divorced women shall wait for three menstrual periods before remarrying.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 303, s.56 (Iddah provisions)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَأَحَلَّ اللَّهُ الْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ الرِّبَا
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Ayat teras bagi kewangan dan perbankan Islam. Menetapkan larangan asas riba dan keharusan jual beli. Mendasari semua perundangan perbankan Islam di Malaysia termasuk IFSA 2013 dan keputusan Majlis Penasihat Syariah mengenai produk kewangan Islam.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The cornerstone verse for Islamic finance and banking. Establishes the fundamental prohibition of riba (interest/usury) and the permissibility of trade. Underpins all Islamic banking legislation in Malaysia including IFSA 2013 and the Shariah Advisory Council's rulings on Islamic financial products.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Allah telah menghalalkan jual beli dan mengharamkan riba.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Allah has permitted trade and forbidden usury (riba).
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Islamic Financial Services Act 2013 (Act 759); Central Bank of Malaysia Act 2009 (Act 701), Part VII

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا وَصِيَّةً لِّأَزْوَاجِهِم مَّتَاعًا إِلَى الْحَوْلِ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Berkaitan dengan peruntukan nafkah bagi balu semasa tempoh iddah mereka. Dalam amalan Malaysia, iddah balu ialah empat bulan sepuluh hari (menurut Surah 2:234). Semasa tempoh ini, kewajipan nafkah berterusan daripada harta pusaka si mati.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Relates to maintenance provisions for widows during their iddah period. In Malaysian practice, the widow's iddah is four months and ten days (per Surah 2:234). During this period, maintenance obligations continue from the deceased's estate.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan orang-orang yang meninggal dunia di antara kamu, sedang mereka meninggalkan isteri-isteri, hendaklah berwasiat untuk isteri-isteri mereka, iaitu diberi nafkah hingga setahun.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Those of you who die and leave widows should bequeath for their widows a year's maintenance and residence.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 303, s.66 (Widow's maintenance during iddah)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَوْفُوا بِالْعُقُودِ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Prinsip asas Al-Quran mengenai kesucian kontrak. Asas bagi sifat mengikat semua kontrak komersial Islam termasuk murabahah, musyarakah, ijarah, dan produk perbankan Islam lain. Dirujuk secara meluas dalam pertikaian perbankan Islam di mahkamah sivil Malaysia.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The fundamental Quranic principle of contract sanctity (pacta sunt servanda in Islamic law). Basis for the binding nature of all Islamic commercial contracts including murabahah, musharakah, ijarah, and other Islamic banking products. Cited extensively in Islamic banking disputes in Malaysian civil courts.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, penuhi akad-akad (perjanjian-perjanjian) itu.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, fulfil your contracts.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Contracts Act 1950; Islamic Financial Services Act 2013

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Dikenali sebagai Ayat al-Mudayanah (ayat muamalat kewangan), ayat terpanjang dalam Al-Quran. Menetapkan prinsip dokumentasi, saksi, dan kontrak bertulis dalam transaksi kewangan. Asas bagi keperluan dokumentasi perbankan Islam dan transaksi komersial patuh Syariah.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Known as Ayat al-Mudayanah (the verse of financial dealings), the longest verse in the Quran. Establishes principles of documentation, witnesses, and written contracts in financial transactions. Foundational for Islamic banking documentation requirements and Shariah-compliant commercial transactions.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, apabila kamu menjalankan sesuatu urusan hutang piutang yang diberi tempoh hingga ke suatu masa yang tertentu, maka hendaklah kamu menulisnya.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Islamic Financial Services Act 2013; Contracts Act 1950 (as applied to Islamic finance)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا فَرِيقًا مِّنْ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ بِالْإِثْمِ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Melarang pemerolehan harta secara tidak adil dan rasuah. Asas bagi prinsip undang-undang komersial Islam yang digunakan dalam muamalat (transaksi komersial). Memaklumkan rangka kerja amalan perniagaan patuh Syariah dan standard anti-rasuah dalam tadbir urus Islam.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Prohibits unjust acquisition of wealth and corruption. Foundational for Islamic commercial law principles applied in muamalat (commercial transactions). Informs the framework for Shariah-compliant business practices and anti-corruption standards in Islamic governance.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan janganlah kamu makan harta sesama kamu dengan jalan yang batil, dan janganlah kamu membawa harta itu kepada hakim-hakim supaya kamu boleh memakan sebahagian dari harta orang lain dengan cara dosa.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Do not consume one another's wealth unjustly, nor use it as a bribe for the judges in order to consume a portion of people's wealth sinfully.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Islamic Financial Services Act 2013; Shariah-compliant commercial law principles

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Ayat asas mengenai kebebasan beragama dalam Islam. Dirujuk dalam kes perlembagaan Malaysia melibatkan kebebasan beragama (Perkara 11), khususnya dalam kes murtad. Walau bagaimanapun, mahkamah Malaysia telah memutuskan bahawa walaupun penerimaan awal tidak boleh dipaksakan, sebaik seseorang Islam, mereka kekal tertakluk kepada bidang kuasa Syariah.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Foundational verse on religious freedom in Islam. Cited in Malaysian constitutional cases involving freedom of religion (Article 11), particularly in apostasy cases. However, Malaysian courts have held that while initial acceptance cannot be compelled, once a person is Muslim, they remain subject to Shariah jurisdiction and cannot unilaterally leave Islam without Shariah court adjudication.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Tidak ada paksaan dalam agama (Islam). Sesungguhnya telah nyata kebenaran dari kesesatan.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: There is no compulsion in religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 11; Lina Joy v MAIWP [2007] 4 MLJ 585

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَأُولِي الْأَمْرِ مِنكُمْ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Menetapkan ketaatan kepada pihak berkuasa yang sah sebagai kewajipan Islam. Di Malaysia, ayat ini dirujuk untuk menyokong kuasa Yang di-Pertuan Agong sebagai Ketua Agama Islam, Sultan negeri sebagai Ketua Agama, dan sifat mengikat fatwa yang diwartakan oleh jawatankuasa fatwa negeri.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Establishes obedience to legitimate authority as an Islamic obligation. In Malaysia, this verse is cited to support the authority of the Yang di-Pertuan Agong as Head of Islam, the state Sultans as Heads of Religion, and the binding nature of gazetted fatwas issued by state fatwa committees.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, taatlah kamu kepada Allah dan taatlah kamu kepada Rasulullah dan kepada ulil-amri (orang-orang yang berkuasa) di antara kamu.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and those in authority among you.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Federal Constitution, Article 3; State Administration of Islamic Law enactments

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas Al-Quran bagi pentadbiran keadilan dan kewajipan kesaksian yang benar. Mendasari sistem sumpah di mahkamah Syariah Malaysia dan kewajipan saksi. Juga berkaitan dengan konsep syahadah (kesaksian) dan keperluan saksi yang layak dalam prosiding Syariah.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The Quranic basis for the administration of justice and the obligation of truthful testimony. Underpins the oath (sumpah) system in Malaysian Shariah courts and the obligations of witnesses. Also relevant to the concept of shahada (testimony) and the requirements for qualified witnesses in Shariah proceedings.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Wahai orang-orang yang beriman, hendaklah kamu menjadi orang-orang yang sentiasa menegakkan keadilan, menjadi saksi kerana Allah, walaupun terhadap diri kamu sendiri.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: O you who believe, stand firmly for justice as witnesses to Allah, even if it be against yourselves.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Shariah Court Evidence enactments; Shariah Court Civil Procedure enactments

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Menetapkan prosedur li'an (sumpah laknat bersama) — prosedur khas di mana suami menuduh isterinya berzina tanpa empat saksi. Kedua-dua pihak bersumpah, dan jika kedua-duanya melengkapkan sumpah, perkahwinan dibubarkan secara kekal. Li'an dikodifikasikan dalam enakmen Undang-Undang Keluarga Islam Malaysia.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Establishes the procedure of li'an (mutual imprecation/oath) — a special procedure where a husband accuses his wife of zina without four witnesses. Both parties swear oaths, and if both complete the oath, the marriage is dissolved permanently. Li'an is codified in Malaysian Islamic Family Law enactments.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan orang-orang yang menuduh isteri mereka berzina sedang mereka tidak mempunyai saksi-saksi selain diri mereka sendiri, maka kesaksian seseorang itu ialah empat kali bersumpah dengan nama Allah bahawa sesungguhnya dia termasuk orang-orang yang benar.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Those who accuse their own spouses of zina and have no witnesses except themselves — the testimony of one of them shall be four testimonies swearing by Allah that he is truthful.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 303, s.50A (Li'an procedure)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Prinsip asas perundangan Islam (usul al-fiqh) yang digunakan merentasi semua bidang undang-undang Syariah. Digunakan di mahkamah Malaysia apabila menilai kewajaraan kewajipan — khususnya dalam keputusan kuantum nafkah di mana keupayaan suami untuk membayar mesti dipertimbangkan.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: A foundational principle of Islamic jurisprudence (usul al-fiqh) applied across all areas of Shariah law. Used in Malaysian courts when assessing the reasonableness of obligations — particularly in maintenance (nafkah) quantum decisions where the husband's ability to pay must be considered.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Allah tidak memberati seseorang melainkan apa yang terdaya olehnya.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Islamic jurisprudential maxims; Act 303, s.61 (assessment of maintenance quantum)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas Al-Quran bagi hukuman zina. Di Malaysia, mahkamah Syariah mempunyai bidang kuasa jenayah terhad di bawah Akta 355 (maksimum 6 sebatan, penjara 3 tahun, denda RM5,000). Enakmen jenayah Syariah negeri mengkodifikasikan zina sebagai kesalahan dalam had ini. Hukuman hadd dalam ayat ini tidak digunakan sepenuhnya di mahkamah Malaysia.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The Quranic basis for punishment of zina. In Malaysia, Shariah courts have limited criminal jurisdiction under Act 355 (max 6 strokes, 3 years jail, RM5,000 fine). State Shariah criminal enactments codify zina as an offence within these limits. The hadd punishment in this verse is not applied in full in Malaysian courts.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Perempuan yang berzina dan lelaki yang berzina, hendaklah kamu sebat tiap-tiap seorang dari keduanya seratus kali sebatan.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: The woman and man guilty of zina (fornication), flog each of them with a hundred lashes.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Shariah Courts (Criminal Jurisdiction) Act 1965 (Act 355); State Shariah Criminal Offences enactments

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Menetapkan keperluan empat orang saksi untuk membuktikan zina dan kesalahan qazaf (tuduhan palsu zina). Standard keterangan yang tinggi ini dicerminkan dalam enakmen keterangan Syariah Malaysia. Juga berkaitan dengan kes membabitkan fitnah di mahkamah Syariah.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Establishes the requirement of four witnesses for proving zina and the offence of qadhf (false accusation of zina). This high evidentiary standard is reflected in Malaysian Shariah evidence enactments. Also relevant to cases involving slander and defamation in Shariah courts.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan orang-orang yang melemparkan tuduhan zina terhadap perempuan-perempuan yang baik, kemudian mereka tidak membawa empat orang saksi, maka sebatlah mereka lapan puluh kali sebatan.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Those who accuse chaste women of zina and then do not produce four witnesses — flog them with eighty lashes.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Shariah Court Evidence enactments; State Shariah Criminal Offences enactments

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالسَّارِقُ وَالسَّارِقَةُ فَاقْطَعُوا أَيْدِيَهُمَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَسَبَا نَكَالًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Hukuman hadd bagi kecurian (sariqah). Di Malaysia, hukuman ini tidak digunakan kerana bidang kuasa jenayah mahkamah Syariah dihadkan oleh Akta 355. Namun, ayat ini memaklumkan pengelasan kesalahan berkaitan kecurian dalam enakmen jenayah Syariah negeri dan wacana akademik mengenai pelaksanaan hudud.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The hadd punishment for theft (sariqah). In Malaysia, this punishment is not applied as Shariah courts' criminal jurisdiction is limited by Act 355. However, the verse informs the classification of theft-related offences in state Shariah criminal enactments and academic discourse on hudud implementation.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan orang lelaki yang mencuri dan orang perempuan yang mencuri, potonglah tangan mereka sebagai balasan bagi apa yang mereka kerjakan, sebagai seksaan dari Allah.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: As for the thief, male or female, cut off their hands as a recompense for what they have earned, as a punishment from Allah.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 355; State Shariah Criminal Offences enactments

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ۖ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Menetapkan hak utama ibu untuk menyusukan dan menjaga anak kecil. Mendasari peruntukan hadhanah (penjagaan) yang secara umumnya mengutamakan ibu bagi anak kecil. Juga menetapkan kewajipan bapa untuk menafkahkan ibu dan anak semasa tempoh penyusuan.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: Establishes the mother's primary right to breastfeed and care for young children. Underpins hadhanah (custody) provisions that generally prioritize the mother for young children. Also establishes the father's obligation to maintain mother and child during nursing period.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Dan ibu-ibu hendaklah menyusukan anak-anak mereka selama dua tahun genap iaitu bagi orang yang hendak menyempurnakan penyusuan.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Mothers shall suckle their children for two full years, for those who wish to complete the term of suckling.
sya_quranic_verses.related_legislation: Act 303, s.81-87 (Hadhanah provisions)

sya_quranic_verses.text_arabic: فَانكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا فَوَاحِدَةً
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_bm: Asas Al-Quran bagi peruntukan poligami dalam undang-undang Malaysia. Membenarkan poligami sehingga empat isteri tertakluk kepada syarat ketat keupayaan berlaku adil. Undang-undang Malaysia memerlukan kebenaran mahkamah untuk perkahwinan poligami dengan syarat termasuk kemampuan kewangan, layanan adil, dan keperluan.
sya_quranic_verses.relevance_en: The Quranic basis for polygamy provisions in Malaysian law. Permits polygamy up to four wives subject to the strict condition of ability to be just and fair. Malaysian law requires court permission for polygamous marriages with conditions including financial ability, just treatment, and necessity.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_bm: Maka berkahwinlah dengan sesiapa yang kamu berkenan dari perempuan-perempuan: dua, tiga atau empat. Kemudian jika kamu bimbang tidak akan berlaku adil, maka berkahwinlah seorang sahaja.
sya_quranic_verses.translation_en: Marry of the women who seem good to you, two or three or four; and if you fear that you cannot do justice then only one.
