sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Garis Panduan Pengendalian Prosiding Kes Mal Di Mahkamah Syariah Melalui Teknologi Komunikasi Jarak Jauh
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Guidelines for Conducting Mal Proceedings via Remote Communication Technology
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi syarat, pengendalian, dan tatatertib bagi perbicaraan dalam talian, termasuk pengesahan identiti dan memastikan penyertaan yang teratur.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the conditions, conduct, and decorum for online hearings, including verifying identity and ensuring orderly participation.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan cara prosiding kes mal boleh dikendalikan secara jarak jauh menggunakan teknologi komunikasi video / jarak jauh.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets out how mal (civil) proceedings may be conducted remotely using video / remote communication technology.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Untuk perbicaraan dalam talian, uji sambungan, audio dan perkongsian dokumen anda terlebih dahulu. Pastikan saksi berada di tempat neutral dan persendirian serta ikatan dokumen anda sedia untuk dikongsi skrin atau difailkan awal.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: For online hearings, test your connection, audio and document-sharing beforehand. Have witnesses in a neutral, private setting and your bundle ready to screen-share or pre-filed.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Etika Peguam Syarie
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Ethics of Syarie Lawyers
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi tatakelakuan profesional, tanggungjawab kepada mahkamah dan klien, serta piawaian tingkah laku yang dikehendaki dalam prosiding.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers professional conduct, duties to the court and clients, and the standards of behaviour required in proceedings.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan piawaian etika yang dijangka daripada Peguam Syarie yang hadir di hadapan Mahkamah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets out the ethical standards expected of Syarie lawyers appearing before the Syariah Courts.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Tanggungjawab anda kepada mahkamah adalah utama dan mengatasi arahan klien apabila bercanggah. Keikhlasan, ketepatan masa dan kesopanan bukan pilihan — pelanggaran boleh membawa akibat tatatertib.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Your duty to the court is paramount and overrides client instructions where they conflict. Candour, punctuality and courtesy are not optional — breaches can lead to disciplinary consequences.
sya_practice_directions.related_legislation: Syarie Legal Practice rules; Syariah Court Civil Procedure enactments

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Garis Panduan Pakaian Hakim Syarie, Pendakwa Syarie, Peguam Syarie Dan Pegawai Mahkamah Di Dalam Dewan Mahkamah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Dress Guidelines for Syarie Judges, Prosecutors, Lawyers and Court Officers in the Courtroom
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Menetapkan pakaian yang dikehendaki bagi mengekalkan maruah dan tatatertib prosiding Mahkamah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Sets the required attire to maintain the dignity and decorum of Syariah Court proceedings.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyeragamkan kod pakaian bagi hakim, Pendakwa Syarie, Peguam Syarie dan pegawai mahkamah di dalam dewan mahkamah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Standardises the dress code for judges, Syarie prosecutors, Syarie lawyers and court officers in the courtroom.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Patuhi kod pakaian dengan tepat — ditolak atau ditegur kerana pakaian menjejaskan kedudukan anda sebelum anda berkata sepatah pun.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Comply with the dress code precisely — being turned away or admonished for attire undermines your standing before you have said a word.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Kod Etika Hakim Syarie
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Code of Ethics for Syarie Judges
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi kesaksamaan, integriti, dan piawaian tatakelakuan yang dijangka daripada hakim Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers impartiality, integrity, and the standards of conduct expected of the Syariah bench.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan kod etika yang mentadbir tatakelakuan hakim Syarie.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets out the code of ethics governing the conduct of Syarie judges.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Berguna apabila mempertimbangkan penarikan diri hakim atau membangkitkan kebimbangan tentang berat sebelah — rangka permohonan sedemikian dengan merujuk piawaian yang mengikat hakim itu sendiri.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Useful when considering recusal or raising concerns about apparent bias — frame any such application by reference to the standards the bench itself is bound by.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penggunaan Lafaz Sumpah Istizhar Dalam Kes Mal
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Use of the Istizhar Oath in Mal Cases
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Menangani bila sumpah istizhar boleh dilaksanakan dan bentuk yang betul, memandangkan beratnya dari segi keterangan dalam prosedur Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Addresses when the istizhar oath may be administered and the correct form, given its evidentiary weight in Syariah procedure.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Memperuntukkan penggunaan dan lafaz sumpah istizhar dalam kes mal.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides for the use and wording of the istizhar oath in mal (civil) cases.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Nasihatkan klien dengan teliti sebelum apa-apa sumpah diangkat — akibatnya dalam keterangan Syariah boleh menentukan kes. Pastikan lafaz dan prosedur mengikut arahan dengan tepat.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Advise clients carefully before any oath is taken — the consequences in Syariah evidence can be decisive. Make sure the wording and procedure follow the direction exactly.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Amalan Sumpah Mahkamah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Practice of Oath-Taking in the Syariah Courts
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi bila dan bagaimana sumpah dilaksanakan serta peranannya dalam penentuan kes.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers when and how oaths are administered and their role in the determination of cases.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyeragamkan amalan dan prosedur pelaksanaan sumpah di Mahkamah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Standardises the practice and procedure for administering oaths in the Syariah Courts.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Ketahui susunan hak untuk bersumpah atau merujuk sumpah antara pihak — kesilapan di sini boleh menyebabkan kehilangan isu yang sepatutnya boleh dimenangi.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Know the order in which the right to take or refer an oath falls between the parties — getting this wrong can lose an otherwise winnable point.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Amalan Hakam Mahkamah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Practice of Hakam (Arbitration) in the Syariah Courts
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi peranan hakam dalam kes syiqaq, pelantikan mereka, dan bagaimana dapatan mereka digunakan dalam penentuan mahkamah.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the role of hakam in syiqaq cases, their appointment, and how their findings feed into the court's determination.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Memperuntukkan pelantikan dan amalan hakam dalam menyelesaikan pertikaian rumah tangga (shiqaq).
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides for the appointment and practice of hakam (arbitrators) in resolving matrimonial disputes (shiqaq).
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Dalam perkara syiqaq, sediakan klien anda untuk proses hakam dan pastikan hakam yang dilantik memahami mandat mereka — proses hakam yang cacat boleh meruntuhkan perintah akhir.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: In shiqaq matters, prepare your client for the hakam process and ensure the appointed hakam understand their mandate — a flawed hakam process can unravel the eventual order.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Kes Hadhanah, Harta Sepencarian dan ex-parte Di Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Hadhanah, Jointly Acquired Property and Ex-Parte Cases in the High Syariah Court
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Menangani bidang kuasa dan prosedur bagi perkara keluarga ini bagi memastikan ia difailkan dan didengar di forum yang betul.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Addresses jurisdiction and procedure for these family matters to ensure they are filed and heard in the correct forum.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Memberi arahan mengenai pengendalian kes penjagaan (hadhanah), harta sepencarian dan permohonan ex-parte di Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides direction on the handling of custody (hadhanah), jointly acquired property (harta sepencarian) and ex-parte applications in the High Syariah Court.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Semak forum dan bidang kuasa semasa pemfailan — tuntutan hadhanah dan harta sepencarian yang difailkan di peringkat mahkamah yang salah menyebabkan kelewatan yang mahal. Untuk relief ex-parte, bersedia mewajarkan kesegeraan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Check forum and jurisdiction at filing — hadhanah and harta sepencarian claims filed at the wrong court level cause costly delay. For ex-parte relief, be ready to justify urgency.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Garis Panduan Prosiding Ex Parte Hadhanah dan Injunksi
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Guidelines for Ex-Parte Hadhanah and Injunction Proceedings
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi ambang pemberian relief ex-parte mendesak dan perlindungan yang diperlukan, termasuk kewajipan pendedahan penuh dan jujur.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the threshold for granting urgent ex-parte relief and the safeguards required, including the duty of full and frank disclosure.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan garis panduan bagi permohonan ex-parte dalam perkara penjagaan (hadhanah) dan injunksi.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets guidelines for ex-parte applications in custody (hadhanah) and injunction matters.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Dalam permohonan ex-parte anda terhutang kewajipan pendedahan penuh dan jujur — dedahkan juga fakta yang menentang klien anda. Tidak mendedahkan adalah cara terpantas untuk perintah ex-parte diketepikan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: On ex-parte applications you owe a duty of full and frank disclosure — disclose facts against your client too. Non-disclosure is the quickest way to have an ex-parte order set aside.
sya_practice_directions.related_legislation: Islamic Family Law enactments; Syariah Court Civil Procedure enactments

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penyelarasan Perintah Nafkah Dari Segi Cara Pembayaran Dan Terma-Terma Lengkap Perintah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Standardising Maintenance Orders: Mode of Payment and Complete Order Terms
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Bertujuan mengurangkan pertikaian penguatkuasaan kemudian dengan memastikan perintah nafkah menyatakan jumlah, kekerapan, cara dan tarikh mula dengan tepat.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Aims to reduce later enforcement disputes by ensuring maintenance orders specify amount, frequency, mode and start date precisely.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyeragamkan perintah nafkah, termasuk cara pembayaran dan memastikan terma perintah yang lengkap dan jelas.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Standardises maintenance (nafkah) orders, including the mode of payment and ensuring complete, clear order terms.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Apabila memohon perintah nafkah, cadangkan terma yang tepat — jumlah, saluran bayaran, tarikh akhir, dan mekanisme tunggakan. Perintah yang lengkap jauh lebih mudah dikuatkuasakan kemudian.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: When seeking a maintenance order, propose the exact terms — amount, payment channel, due date, and arrears mechanism. A complete order is far easier to enforce later.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penerimaan Nasihat Daripada Pegawai Kebajikan Masyarakat Atau Pakar Sebelum Mahkamah Membuat Perintah Mengenai Jagaan (Hadhanah) Atau Nafkah Seorang Kanak-kanak
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Welfare Officer / Expert Advice Before Custody (Hadhanah) or Child Maintenance Orders
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Memperkukuh prinsip kebajikan kanak-kanak dengan membawa penilaian profesional ke dalam keputusan yang menjejaskan kanak-kanak.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Reinforces the welfare-of-the-child principle by bringing professional assessment into decisions affecting children.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Membolehkan mahkamah menerima nasihat daripada pegawai kebajikan/pelindung yang diwartakan atau pakar berkaitan sebelum membuat perintah penjagaan (hadhanah) atau nafkah kanak-kanak.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Allows the court to receive advice from a gazetted welfare/protection officer or relevant expert before making custody (hadhanah) or child maintenance orders.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Tangani laporan kebajikan/sosial secara membina — mahkamah menimbangnya dengan berat. Jika anda mempertikaikannya, tangani dapatannya secara khusus dan bukan menyerang pegawai.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Engage with the welfare/social report constructively — courts weigh it heavily. If you dispute it, address its findings specifically rather than attacking the officer.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Pemakluman Kepada Isteri/ Isteri-isteri Sedia Ada Untuk Hadir Dalam Prosiding Permohonan Kebenaran Poligami Serta Permohonan Pengesahan Dan Pendaftaran Nikah Poligami
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Notice to Existing Wife/Wives to Attend Polygamy Permission and Registration Proceedings
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Melindungi hak isteri sedia ada dengan memastikan mereka mendapat notis dan peluang untuk didengar.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Protects the rights of existing wives by ensuring they have notice and an opportunity to be heard.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Mewajibkan isteri atau isteri-isteri sedia ada dimaklumkan untuk hadir dalam prosiding permohonan kebenaran berpoligami serta pengesahan dan pendaftaran nikah poligami.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Requires the existing wife or wives to be notified to attend proceedings on an application for permission to practise polygamy and registration of a polygamous marriage.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Jika bertindak untuk pemohon, pastikan penyampaian yang betul kepada isteri sedia ada lebih awal — notis yang cacat akan melengahkan atau menggagalkan permohonan. Jika bertindak untuk isteri sedia ada, pastikan haknya untuk didengar.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: If acting for the applicant, ensure proper service on existing wives early — defective notice will stall or defeat the application. If acting for an existing wife, secure her right to be heard.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Amalan Pengesahan Talaq Diluar Dan Tanpa Kebenaran Mahkamah Serta Penjelasan Terhadap Keengganan Bersumpah (Nukul)
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Confirmation of Talaq Pronounced Outside and Without Court Permission; Refusal to Take Oath (Nukul)
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi prosedur dan layanan keterangan apabila perceraian dilafazkan di luar proses mahkamah.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the procedure and evidentiary treatment when a divorce is pronounced outside the court process.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyediakan amalan pengesahan talaq yang dilafazkan di luar mahkamah dan tanpa kebenaran, serta menangani kesan keengganan bersumpah (nukul).
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides the practice for confirming a talaq pronounced outside court and without permission, and addresses the effect of refusal to take an oath (nukul).
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Nasihatkan klien bahawa melafazkan talaq di luar mahkamah membawa penalti dan masih memerlukan pengesahan. Fahami bagaimana keengganan bersumpah (nukul) boleh mengubah keputusan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Advise clients that pronouncing talaq outside court carries penalties and still requires confirmation. Understand how refusal to take an oath (nukul) can shift the outcome.
sya_practice_directions.related_legislation: Islamic Family Law enactments (divorce); Syariah Criminal Offences enactments

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Format Dan Pemakaian Borang Laporan Sosial/Akhlak Jabatan Kebajikan Masyarakat (JKM) Bagi Kes Permohonan Perkahwinan Bawah Umur
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Social/Conduct Report Form (JKM) for Underage Marriage Applications
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Membawa penilaian kebajikan berstruktur ke dalam pertimbangan mahkamah terhadap permohonan perkahwinan bawah umur.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Brings a structured welfare assessment into the court's consideration of underage marriage applications.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyediakan format dan penggunaan borang laporan sosial/akhlak Jabatan Kebajikan Masyarakat (JKM) dalam permohonan perkahwinan bawah umur.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides the format and use of the Welfare Department (JKM) social/conduct report in applications for underage marriage.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Jangkakan penelitian rapi dalam permohonan perkahwinan bawah umur. Pastikan laporan JKM diperoleh dan ditangani — mahkamah tidak akan teruskan tanpanya dan menimbangnya dengan berat.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Expect close scrutiny in underage marriage applications. Ensure the JKM report is obtained and addressed — the court will not proceed without it and weighs it heavily.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Keperluan Penyelesaian Kes Harta Sepencarian Terlebih Dahulu Sebelum Perbicaraan Kes Hibah, Wasiat Dan Pusaka Yang Melibatkan Harta Yang Sama
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Resolve Jointly Acquired Property Before Hibah, Wasiat and Inheritance Cases on the Same Property
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Memastikan harta pusaka ditakrifkan dengan betul — dengan mengasingkan dahulu bahagian harta sepencarian pasangan yang masih hidup — sebelum persoalan pembahagian diputuskan.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Ensures the estate is properly defined — by first separating the surviving spouse's matrimonial share — before distribution questions are decided.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Mewajibkan tuntutan harta sepencarian diselesaikan terlebih dahulu sebelum mendengar kes hibah, wasiat dan pusaka yang melibatkan harta yang sama.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Requires jointly acquired property (harta sepencarian) claims to be resolved before hearing hibah, wasiat and inheritance (pusaka) cases involving the same property.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Dalam pertikaian pusaka, selesaikan harta sepencarian dahulu. Membahagikan mengikut faraid sebelum mengasingkan bahagian harta sepencarian adalah kesilapan biasa yang boleh dibatalkan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: In estate disputes, deal with harta sepencarian first. Distributing under faraid before carving out the matrimonial share is a common and reversible error.
sya_practice_directions.related_legislation: Islamic Family Law enactments; Faraid / inheritance law

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Keperluan Menjadikan Semua Ahli Waris Yang Berhak Dan Berkepentingan Sebagai Pihak-pihak Dalam Kes Melibatkan Tuntutan Terhadap Harta Si Mati
sya_practice_directions.title_en: All Entitled Heirs Must Be Made Parties in Claims Against a Deceased's Property
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Mengelakkan perintah dibuat yang menjejaskan ahli waris yang tidak pernah hadir di mahkamah, melindungi hak mereka dan kemuktamadan perintah.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Prevents orders being made that affect heirs who were never before the court, protecting their rights and the finality of the order.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Mewajibkan semua ahli waris yang berhak dan berkepentingan disertakan sebagai pihak dalam kes yang melibatkan tuntutan terhadap harta si mati.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Requires all entitled and interested heirs to be joined as parties in cases involving claims against a deceased's property.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Kenal pasti dan sertakan setiap ahli waris yang berhak dari awal. Ahli waris yang tertinggal boleh mengetepikan perintah kemudian — petakan bahagian faraid sebelum anda memfailkan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Identify and join every entitled heir at the outset. A missing heir can later set the order aside — map the faraid shares before you file.
sya_practice_directions.related_legislation: Faraid / inheritance law; Syariah Court Civil Procedure enactments

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Keperluan Untuk Mengemukakan Carian Rasmi/Persendirian Geran Hak Milik Terkini Bagi Tuntutan/Permohonan Harta Tak Alih
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Current Title Search Required for Immovable Property Claims
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Memastikan mahkamah memutuskan berdasarkan pemilikan berdaftar terkini dan bebanan ke atas harta tersebut.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Ensures the court decides on the basis of the current registered ownership and encumbrances of the property.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Mewajibkan carian hak milik tanah rasmi/persendirian terkini dikemukakan semasa pendaftaran dan sebelum penghakiman bagi tuntutan yang melibatkan harta tak alih.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Requires a current official/private land title search to be produced at registration and before judgment in claims involving immovable property.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Sentiasa dapatkan carian hak milik baharu sebelum memfailkan dan kemas kini sebelum penghakiman — pemilikan, gadaian atau kaveat mungkin berubah dan boleh menggagalkan perintah yang dibuat atas maklumat lapuk.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Always obtain a fresh title search before filing and refresh it before judgment — ownership, charges or caveats may have changed and can derail an order made on stale information.
sya_practice_directions.related_legislation: Faraid / inheritance law; National Land Code (title)

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penyeragaman Format Perintah, Alasan Penghakiman Ringkas dan Surat Makluman Dalam Sistem e-Faraid
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Standardised Order Format and Brief Grounds in the e-Faraid System
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Menggalakkan keseragaman dan ketepatan dalam sijil faraid dan output mahkamah berkaitan yang dihasilkan secara elektronik.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Promotes consistency and accuracy in faraid certificates and related court outputs generated electronically.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyeragamkan format perintah, alasan penghakiman ringkas, dan surat makluman yang dihasilkan melalui sistem e-Faraid.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Standardises the order format, brief grounds of judgment, and notification letters produced through the e-Faraid system.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Semak output e-Faraid dengan teliti berbanding ahli waris dan bahagian yang anda plidkan — pengiraan automatik masih memerlukan semakan manusia sebelum sijil dipakai.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Check e-Faraid outputs carefully against the heirs and shares you pleaded — automated computations still require a human check before the certificate is relied upon.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Panduan Darihal Aduan Kesalahan Jenayah Syariah Kepada Hakim
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Guidance on Complaints of Syariah Criminal Offences to the Judge
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi saluran dan prosedur yang betul untuk memulakan aduan jenayah Syariah bagi memastikan proses yang sewajarnya.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the proper channel and procedure for initiating Syariah criminal complaints to ensure due process.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyediakan panduan tentang cara aduan kesalahan jenayah Syariah dibawa kepada dan dikendalikan oleh hakim.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides guidance on how complaints of Syariah criminal offences are brought before and handled by the judge.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Pastikan aduan dibentuk dan disalurkan dengan betul sebelum tertuduh dibawa ke mahkamah — kecacatan di peringkat aduan boleh memudaratkan pendakwaan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Ensure the complaint is properly constituted and channelled before the accused is brought up — defects at the complaint stage can be fatal to the prosecution.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penyediaan Dan Pengeluaran Perintah Bertulis Bagi Kes Jenayah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Preparation and Issuance of Written Orders in Syariah Criminal Cases
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Memastikan perintah jenayah dicatat secara bertulis dengan tepat dan dikeluarkan dengan segera untuk penguatkuasaan dan rayuan.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Ensures criminal orders are reduced to writing accurately and issued promptly for enforcement and appeal.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyeragamkan penyediaan dan pengeluaran perintah bertulis bagi kes jenayah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Standardises the preparation and issuance of written orders in Syariah criminal cases.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Dapatkan perintah bertulis yang dimeterai dengan segera — tempoh rayuan dan penguatkuasaan kedua-duanya berdasarkan perintah formal. Semak ia sepadan dengan apa yang diputuskan mahkamah.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Obtain the sealed written order promptly — appeal periods and enforcement both run off the formal order. Check it matches what the court pronounced.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penyediaan Waran Tangkap Dan Notis Kepada Penjamin Bagi Kes Jenayah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Preparation of Arrest Warrants and Notice to Bailor in Syariah Criminal Cases
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi prosedur apabila tertuduh gagal hadir, termasuk memaklumkan penjamin dan mengeluarkan waran.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the procedure when an accused fails to attend, including notifying the bailor and issuing a warrant.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Memperuntukkan penyediaan waran tangkap dan notis kepada penjamin dalam kes jenayah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides for the preparation of arrest warrants and notices to the bailor (guarantor) in Syariah criminal cases.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Maklumkan penjamin tentang risiko mereka dengan jelas. Jika klien anda berisiko dikenakan waran kerana tidak hadir, tanganinya sebelum tarikh — menyelesaikannya awal jauh lebih murah daripada selepas ditangkap.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Advise bailors of their exposure clearly. If your client is at risk of a warrant for non-attendance, address it before the date — purging early is far cheaper than after arrest.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Had Masa Pendaftaran Dan Sebutan Kes Jenayah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Time Limits for Registration and Mention of Syariah Criminal Cases
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Bertujuan memastikan perkara jenayah dibawa ke mahkamah dengan segera selepas pertuduhan sedia.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Aims to ensure criminal matters are brought before the court promptly after charges are ready.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan had masa bagi pendaftaran dan sebutan pertama kes jenayah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets time limits for the registration and first mention of Syariah criminal cases.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Pantau tarikh akhir pendaftaran dan sebutan dengan rapi — kelewatan yang tidak wajar boleh menjadi asas hujah prejudis bagi pembelaan dan boleh menjejaskan cara mahkamah menguruskan kes.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Track the registration and mention deadlines closely — undue delay can found an argument of prejudice for the defence and may affect how the court manages the case.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Pengemukaan Bukti Forensik Dalam Prosiding Di Mahkamah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Tendering Forensic Evidence in Syariah Court Proceedings
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi penerimaan bukti forensik dan saintifik, termasuk rantaian jagaan dan keterangan pakar.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the admission of forensic and scientific evidence, including chain of custody and expert testimony.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Memperuntukkan pengemukaan dan pengendalian bukti forensik dalam prosiding di Mahkamah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides for the tendering and handling of forensic evidence in Syariah Court proceedings.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Jika bergantung pada bukti forensik, pastikan rantaian jagaan dan kehadiran pakar lebih awal. Putus dalam rantaian jagaan adalah alasan paling biasa untuk mengecualikan bukti yang sebaliknya kukuh.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: If relying on forensic evidence, secure the chain of custody and the expert's availability early. A break in custody is the most common ground for excluding otherwise strong evidence.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Penyediaan Kronologi Kes Dan Ringkasan Penghujahan Bertulis Bagi Kes-Kes Rayuan Di Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah Dan Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Case Chronology and Written Submissions for Appeals
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Menyeragamkan dokumentasi rayuan untuk memberi tumpuan mahkamah kepada isu dan rekod.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Standardises appeal documentation to focus the court on the issues and the record.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Mewajibkan penyediaan kronologi kes dan ringkasan penghujahan bertulis bagi kes rayuan di Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah dan Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Requires preparation of a case chronology and written submissions for appeal cases in the High Syariah Court and Syariah Court of Appeal.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Laburkan dalam kronologi yang padat dan penghujahan bertulis yang fokus — rayuan dimenangi atas rekod dan isu, bukan dengan menghujah semula keseluruhan perbicaraan.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Invest in a tight chronology and focused written submissions — appeals are won on the record and the issues, not on re-arguing the whole trial.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Proses Kerja Rayuan Mal Mahkamah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Work Process for Mal Appeals in the Syariah Court
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi langkah dan tempoh masa dari pemfailan notis rayuan hingga pelupusan rayuan mal.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the steps and timelines from filing the notice of appeal to disposal of the mal appeal.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan proses kerja yang diseragamkan bagi rayuan mal di Mahkamah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets out the standardised work process for mal (civil) appeals in the Syariah Courts.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Catat setiap tarikh akhir rayuan dari tarikh keputusan. Terlepas tempoh notis atau rekod rayuan adalah cara paling biasa rayuan yang bermerit hilang atas teknikal prosedur.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Diary every appeal deadline from the date of decision. Missing the notice or record-of-appeal timelines is the most common way a meritorious appeal is lost on procedure.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Proses Kerja Rayuan Jenayah Mahkamah Syariah
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Work Process for Criminal Appeals in the Syariah Court
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi langkah dan tempoh masa bagi rayuan jenayah dari pemfailan hingga pelupusan.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the steps and timelines for criminal appeals from filing to disposal.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menetapkan proses kerja yang diseragamkan bagi rayuan jenayah Syariah.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Sets out the standardised work process for Syariah criminal appeals.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Untuk rayuan jenayah, dapatkan alasan keputusan dan nota prosiding lebih awal dan perhatikan tempoh rayuan yang singkat — kebebasan dan hukuman bergantung pada pematuhan yang ketat.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: For criminal appeals, secure the grounds of decision and notes of proceedings early and watch the short appeal windows — liberty and penalties turn on strict compliance.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Garis Panduan Kes Tuntutan/Saman Penghutang Penghakiman Dan Notis Penghakiman
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Guidelines on Judgment Debtor Claims/Summons and Judgment Notices
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Meliputi mekanisme untuk mengejar pihak yang tidak mematuhi perintah mahkamah, termasuk proses saman penghutang penghakiman.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Covers the mechanism for pursuing a party who has not satisfied a court order, including the judgment debtor summons process.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Menyediakan garis panduan bagi prosiding penghutang penghakiman (tuntutan/saman) dan pengeluaran notis penghakiman.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides guidelines for judgment debtor proceedings (claims/summons) and the issuance of judgment notices.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Dokumenkan tunggakan dengan tepat — tarikh, jumlah dan bukti tidak bayar menentukan kejayaan penguatkuasaan. Nasihatkan klien menyimpan rekod sejak perintah dibuat.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Document arrears precisely — dates, amounts and proof of non-payment make or break enforcement. Advise clients to keep records from the moment the order is made.

sya_practice_directions.title_bm: Perintah Mahkamah Syariah Melalui Potongan Pencen
sya_practice_directions.title_en: Syariah Court Orders Through Pension Deduction
sya_practice_directions.details_bm: Menawarkan laluan penguatkuasaan yang boleh dipercayai bagi perintah terhadap pesara dengan menyandar bayaran pencen.
sya_practice_directions.details_en: Offers a reliable enforcement route for orders against pensioners by attaching pension payments.
sya_practice_directions.summary_bm: Memperuntukkan penguatkuasaan perintah Mahkamah Syariah (seperti nafkah) melalui potongan daripada pencen.
sya_practice_directions.summary_en: Provides for enforcement of Syariah Court orders (such as maintenance) through deduction from a pension.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_bm: Apabila penghutang seorang pesara, potongan pencen boleh menjadi mekanisme penguatkuasaan paling berkesan — pastikan sumber dan jumlah pencen sebelum memohon.
sya_practice_directions.practical_notes_en: Where the debtor is a pensioner, pension deduction can be the most effective enforcement mechanism — establish the pension source and amount before applying.

sya_procedural_workflows.steps_json: [{"step":1,"titleEn":"Reading of the charge","titleBm":"Pembacaan pertuduhan","detailEn":"The charge is read and explained to the accused, who pleads guilty or not guilty.","detailBm":"Pertuduhan dibacakan dan diterangkan kepada tertuduh, yang mengaku salah atau tidak salah."},{"step":2,"titleEn":"Plea","titleBm":"Pengakuan","detailEn":"A guilty plea proceeds to mitigation and sentence; a not-guilty plea proceeds to trial.","detailBm":"Pengakuan salah meneruskan ke rayuan dan hukuman; pengakuan tidak salah meneruskan ke perbicaraan."},{"step":3,"titleEn":"Prosecution case","titleBm":"Kes pendakwaan","detailEn":"The Pendakwa Syarie calls witnesses and tenders evidence; defence cross-examines.","detailBm":"Pendakwa Syarie memanggil saksi dan mengemukakan keterangan; pembelaan memeriksa balas."},{"step":4,"titleEn":"Prima facie ruling","titleBm":"Keputusan prima facie","detailEn":"The court decides whether a prima facie case is made; if not, the accused is acquitted.","detailBm":"Mahkamah memutuskan sama ada kes prima facie dibuktikan; jika tidak, tertuduh dibebaskan."},{"step":5,"titleEn":"Defence case","titleBm":"Kes pembelaan","detailEn":"If called to enter a defence, the accused gives evidence and may call witnesses.","detailBm":"Jika dipanggil membela diri, tertuduh memberi keterangan dan boleh memanggil saksi."},{"step":6,"titleEn":"Judgment","titleBm":"Penghakiman","detailEn":"The court delivers a verdict of guilty or not guilty applying the beyond-reasonable-doubt standard.","detailBm":"Mahkamah menyampaikan keputusan bersalah atau tidak bersalah menerapkan standard melampaui keraguan munasabah."},{"step":7,"titleEn":"Mitigation & sentence","titleBm":"Rayuan & hukuman","detailEn":"On conviction, the defence pleads in mitigation before the court passes sentence.","detailBm":"Atas sabitan, pembelaan membuat rayuan pengurangan sebelum mahkamah menjatuhkan hukuman."}]
sya_procedural_workflows.description_bm: Tatacara menyeluruh bagi kes jenayah Syariah, dari pembacaan pertuduhan melalui perbicaraan hingga sabitan atau pembebasan dan penjatuhan hukuman.
sya_procedural_workflows.description_en: End-to-end procedure for a Syariah criminal case, from the reading of the charge through trial to conviction or acquittal and sentencing.
sya_procedural_workflows.estimated_timeline: 3–12 months depending on complexity and number of witnesses
sya_procedural_workflows.required_documents: Charge sheet, investigation papers, witness statements, exhibits

sya_procedural_workflows.steps_json: [{"step":1,"titleEn":"Assess bailability","titleBm":"Nilai kebolehjaminan","detailEn":"Determine whether the offence is bailable, and identify suitable sureties.","detailBm":"Tentukan sama ada kesalahan boleh dijamin, dan kenal pasti penjamin yang sesuai."},{"step":2,"titleEn":"File application","titleBm":"Failkan permohonan","detailEn":"Lodge the bail application with a supporting affidavit setting out grounds.","detailBm":"Failkan permohonan jaminan dengan afidavit sokongan yang menyatakan alasan."},{"step":3,"titleEn":"Hearing","titleBm":"Pendengaran","detailEn":"The court hears submissions on flight risk, residence, and surety adequacy.","detailBm":"Mahkamah mendengar hujahan tentang risiko melarikan diri, kediaman, dan kecukupan penjamin."},{"step":4,"titleEn":"Order & conditions","titleBm":"Perintah & syarat","detailEn":"If granted, the bail sum is set and conditions imposed; sureties execute the bond.","detailBm":"Jika diluluskan, jumlah jaminan ditetapkan dan syarat dikenakan; penjamin menandatangani bon."},{"step":5,"titleEn":"Release","titleBm":"Pembebasan","detailEn":"Upon perfecting the bail bond, the accused is released pending trial.","detailBm":"Setelah menyempurnakan bon jaminan, tertuduh dibebaskan sementara menunggu perbicaraan."}]
sya_procedural_workflows.description_bm: Tatacara memohon dan mendapatkan jaminan bagi tertuduh sementara menunggu pelupusan pertuduhan jenayah Syariah.
sya_procedural_workflows.description_en: Procedure for applying for and obtaining bail for an accused person pending the disposal of a Syariah criminal charge.
sya_procedural_workflows.estimated_timeline: Same day to a few days
sya_procedural_workflows.required_documents: Bail application, supporting affidavit, surety identification

sya_procedural_workflows.steps_json: [{"step":1,"titleEn":"File notice of appeal","titleBm":"Failkan notis rayuan","detailEn":"Lodge the notice of appeal within the statutory time limit from the decision.","detailBm":"Failkan notis rayuan dalam had masa statutori dari keputusan."},{"step":2,"titleEn":"Obtain grounds of judgment","titleBm":"Dapatkan alasan penghakiman","detailEn":"Request the written grounds of judgment and the certified record of appeal.","detailBm":"Mohon alasan penghakiman bertulis dan rekod rayuan yang diperakui."},{"step":3,"titleEn":"File petition of appeal","titleBm":"Failkan petisyen rayuan","detailEn":"Set out the specific grounds of appeal against conviction and/or sentence.","detailBm":"Nyatakan alasan rayuan yang khusus terhadap sabitan dan/atau hukuman."},{"step":4,"titleEn":"Hearing","titleBm":"Pendengaran","detailEn":"The appellate court hears submissions; it may affirm, reverse, or vary the decision.","detailBm":"Mahkamah rayuan mendengar hujahan; ia boleh mengesahkan, mengubah, atau membatalkan keputusan."},{"step":5,"titleEn":"Decision","titleBm":"Keputusan","detailEn":"The appellate court delivers its decision; further appeal may lie to the Syariah Appeal Court.","detailBm":"Mahkamah rayuan menyampaikan keputusannya; rayuan lanjut boleh dibuat ke Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah."}]
sya_procedural_workflows.description_bm: Tatacara merayu sabitan dan/atau hukuman dari Mahkamah Rendah Syariah ke Mahkamah Tinggi Syariah dan seterusnya ke Mahkamah Rayuan Syariah.
sya_procedural_workflows.description_en: Procedure for appealing a conviction and/or sentence from the Syariah Subordinate Court to the Syariah High Court and onward to the Syariah Appeal Court.
sya_procedural_workflows.required_documents: Notice of appeal, grounds of judgment, record of appeal, petition of appeal

sya_procedural_workflows.steps_json: [{"step":1,"titleEn":"Identify heirs","titleBm":"Kenal pasti waris","detailEn":"Establish the surviving heirs and their relationship to the deceased.","detailBm":"Tetapkan waris yang masih hidup dan hubungan mereka dengan si mati."},{"step":2,"titleEn":"Inventory the estate","titleBm":"Senaraikan harta pusaka","detailEn":"List all assets and liabilities; settle debts, funeral costs, and any valid wasiat (max 1/3).","detailBm":"Senaraikan semua aset dan liabiliti; selesaikan hutang, kos pengebumian, dan apa-apa wasiat sah (maksimum 1/3)."},{"step":3,"titleEn":"Compute faraid shares","titleBm":"Kira bahagian faraid","detailEn":"Calculate each heir's fixed and residuary share using the faraid rules.","detailBm":"Kira bahagian tetap dan baki setiap waris menggunakan kaedah faraid."},{"step":4,"titleEn":"Obtain faraid certificate","titleBm":"Dapatkan sijil faraid","detailEn":"Apply to the Syariah court for a faraid certificate confirming the shares.","detailBm":"Mohon kepada mahkamah Syariah untuk sijil faraid yang mengesahkan bahagian."},{"step":5,"titleEn":"Distribute","titleBm":"Agihkan","detailEn":"Distribute the estate per the certificate, via the relevant land/asset authorities.","detailBm":"Agihkan harta pusaka mengikut sijil, melalui pihak berkuasa tanah/aset yang berkaitan."}]
sya_procedural_workflows.description_bm: Proses khidmat nasihat untuk membimbing keluarga melalui penentuan dan pembahagian harta pusaka si mati Muslim mengikut faraid.
sya_procedural_workflows.description_en: The advisory process for guiding a family through the determination and distribution of a deceased Muslim's estate according to faraid.
sya_procedural_workflows.required_documents: Death certificate, heir identification, asset documents, debt records, any wasiat

sya_procedural_workflows.steps_json: [{"step":1,"titleEn":"Confirm capacity & intent","titleBm":"Sahkan keupayaan & niat","detailEn":"Verify the donor's legal capacity and genuine, uncoerced intention to gift.","detailBm":"Sahkan keupayaan undang-undang pemberi dan niat sebenar tanpa paksaan untuk menghibah."},{"step":2,"titleEn":"Identify property","titleBm":"Kenal pasti harta","detailEn":"Ascertain that the property is owned by the donor and clearly identifiable.","detailBm":"Pastikan harta dimiliki oleh pemberi dan dapat dikenal pasti dengan jelas."},{"step":3,"titleEn":"Execute offer & acceptance","titleBm":"Laksanakan ijab & qabul","detailEn":"Document the ijab (offer) and qabul (acceptance) in a hibah deed before witnesses.","detailBm":"Dokumenkan ijab (tawaran) dan qabul (penerimaan) dalam surat hibah di hadapan saksi."},{"step":4,"titleEn":"Effect delivery (qabd)","titleBm":"Laksanakan penyerahan (qabd)","detailEn":"Transfer possession/control to the donee, e.g., register the land transfer.","detailBm":"Pindahkan milikan/kawalan kepada penerima, cth. daftarkan pindah milik tanah."},{"step":5,"titleEn":"Retain evidence","titleBm":"Simpan bukti","detailEn":"Keep the executed deed and proof of delivery to resist later inheritance disputes.","detailBm":"Simpan surat yang disempurnakan dan bukti penyerahan untuk menangkis pertikaian pusaka kemudian."}]
sya_procedural_workflows.description_bm: Proses untuk mewujudkan dan menyempurnakan hibah secara sah supaya pemilikan berpindah dengan berkesan semasa hayat pemberi.
sya_procedural_workflows.description_en: The process for validly creating and perfecting a hibah so that ownership transfers effectively during the donor's lifetime.
sya_procedural_workflows.required_documents: Hibah deed, property ownership documents, witnesses, transfer/registration forms

sya_procedural_workflows.steps_json: [{"step":1,"titleEn":"Take instructions","titleBm":"Ambil arahan","detailEn":"Understand the testator's wishes, assets, and intended non-heir beneficiaries.","detailBm":"Fahami hasrat pewasiat, aset, dan penerima bukan waris yang dihasratkan."},{"step":2,"titleEn":"Apply the one-third rule","titleBm":"Terapkan kaedah satu pertiga","detailEn":"Ensure bequests to non-heirs do not exceed one-third without heir consent.","detailBm":"Pastikan wasiat kepada bukan waris tidak melebihi satu pertiga tanpa persetujuan waris."},{"step":3,"titleEn":"Appoint executor (wasi)","titleBm":"Lantik wasi","detailEn":"Name a trustworthy and capable executor to administer the wasiat.","detailBm":"Namakan wasi yang amanah dan berkemampuan untuk mentadbir wasiat."},{"step":4,"titleEn":"Execute & witness","titleBm":"Laksana & saksikan","detailEn":"Have the testator sign before competent witnesses as required.","detailBm":"Pastikan pewasiat menandatangani di hadapan saksi yang berkelayakan seperti yang diperlukan."},{"step":5,"titleEn":"Safekeeping","titleBm":"Penyimpanan","detailEn":"Store the wasiat securely (e.g., with a wasiat custodian) and inform the executor.","detailBm":"Simpan wasiat dengan selamat (cth. dengan kustodian wasiat) dan maklumkan wasi."}]
sya_procedural_workflows.description_bm: Proses khidmat nasihat untuk menyediakan wasiat yang patuh Syariah, memastikan ia kekal dalam had satu pertiga dan disaksikan serta disimpan dengan betul.
sya_procedural_workflows.description_en: The advisory process for drafting a Shariah-compliant wasiat, ensuring it stays within the one-third limit and is properly witnessed and stored.
sya_procedural_workflows.required_documents: Asset list, beneficiary details, executor consent, witness identification
